pa dang rje btsun rdo je phag mo'i gnas khyad par can gyi nye 'dabs yin 99zhes gsal bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /(gsum/)gling ge sar rgyal po'i 'khrungs lo/gling ge sar rgyal po'i 'khrungs lo ni/ rab byung dang po tshugs kha ma'i drug cu skor de'i nang yin te/ 〈mdo smad chos 'byung 〉las 66de nyid kyi 'khrungs lo lcags byi dang / chu sbrul la 'dod mkhan gnyis snang ba gang yin yang rab byung dang po tshugs kha ma'i drug cu skor der gtogs ha zhes dang /seng chen rgyal po'i rnam thar 〈rta rgyal 〉las/ 88pha yab ger mdzod gnyen po dang / ma 'gag bza' klu mo gnyis la/ sras lcags byi lo pa jo ru 'khrungs 99zhes gsal zhing / yang 〈bdud 'joms chos 'byung 〉las/ 66rab byung gnyis pro shar ba nas/ ma gcig lab sgron lcags 'brug lo nga bdun gling gi ge sar sa stag lo lnga bcu mi la lcags 'brug lo zhe brgyad lnga ces gsungs/de bzhin du 〈gdong gi thang yig〉las kyang 66snang ba mtha' yas chos sku kun tu bzang / lha klu mi dang 'brel ba'i sprul ba zhig stag gi mgo bo sprul gyi mjug ma can/ 'dzam gling ljongs 'dir seng chen mthur med smyo nya zhes stag gi lor sku 'khrungs pa dang / sprul gyi lor 'das pa bstan pa sogs cung zad mi 'dra yang gang ltar byi ba dang / stag sprul bcas kyi bar lo grangs kha shas sam bcu grangs re gnyis las khyad par med pas gling ge sar rgyal po'i 'khrungs lo ni rab byung dang po ste dus rabs bcu gcig par 'khrungs pa tshad mas/ grub bo/ /52
(bzhi/)gling ge sar rgyal po'i mi rigs dang gdung rgyud/gling ge sar rgyal po'i mi rigs ni bod rigs yin pa dang / gdung rgyud dam rigs rus ni 88smrag po ldong lta yin/'on te lo rgyus kyi blo mig mi gsal ba 'gas ge sar rgyal po bod rigs min zhes brjod pa ni go nor thebs pa kho nar nges pa ni mkhas dbang dmu dge bsam gtan gyis 66srong btsan dus kyi sog po ge sar dmag gi rgyal po dang / bod sil bur 'thor ba'i dus kyi bod mi ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gnyis gcig red snyam pa'i ri bong gnam rdib kyi dogs pa 'dra ba zhig skyes 'dug de ni rwa mgo lug sbyar yin zhes gsungs pa dang / da dung khong gi gling ge sar rgyal po'i gdung rgyud dam rigs rus thad 64gling gi mi rgyud ni/bod mi'u ldong drug gi nang tshan las/ smyag po ldong gi rigs rgyud red/ ldong89ra khra rgan po sa la bu gsum byung ba rnams kyis rma chu'i stod smad bar gsum du gzhi bzung nas bsdad pa la mi rgyud mang du 'phel te sde chen por chags nya zhes sogs gsungs pa ni legs bshad gser gyi nying khur 'khums so/ /yang 'ga' res88gleng ge sar rgyal po ni khri srong lde btsan red lta zer yang khri srong dang ge sar gnyis ming dang / phyag rjes/ 'khrungs lo/'khrungs yul/ srid kyi khyab khongs sogs gtan nas mi mthun pa mkhas pa rnams kyis mang du gsungs yod pas bden rdzun yod tshad la rna ba nyan pa'i ngal ba bya mi dgos so/ /(lnga/)gling ge sar rgyal po'i mdzad pa'am phyag rjes gtso bo ni bde 'jags kyi 53
ched du drang bden gyi dmag 'khrug byas te la nga du shor ba'i ngan pa tshar gcod mthar phyin byed pa de yin/ de'i thad mkhas dbang dmu dge bsam gtan gyis 66gling seng chen gyi phyag rjes gtso bo ni/ bod khra 'thor du song ba'i skabs su/ phyogs kyi rgyal po dag gis bod kyi rgyal srid nyams nas/ gcig gyur med pa shes te/ bod la brnyas gtse dang btsan sa nod byed pa yin la/gling ge sar gyis gnas tshul de mthong nas/gzhon ge sar gyi dus nas blo rno zhing dpa' sems mkha' la 'phyur te/gling gi dpa' brtul (dpa' thul ya nga zer )mang po rang dang sems kyi 'char sgo mthun pa'i grogs su bkug nas rnam par rgyal ba'i g.yul las sha stag byas te/ btsan gnod byed pa'i phyi'i rgyal khab kyi rdzong chen bco brgyad sogs bcom lta zhes dang / mkhas dbang nor stes 88ge sar gyi spyir gangs can bod yul/ sgos phra mo gling sde bde 'jags yong ba'i ched du rang dang blo mthun pa'i dpa' bo phu nu sum cu dang dpa' thul brgyad cu sogs dang mnyam gcig tu drang bden gyi dmag 'khrug grangs med pa zhig byas pa red nya ces gsungs/da dung rgya'i mkhas pa hong dbun phen gyis kyang 〈ge sa ra sgrung gi lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi gnad don 'ga' dpyad pa 〉zhes pa'i nang / 88ge sar sgrung gi brjod bya gtso bo ni dmag 'khrug red 9 ces gsungs pa ma zad khong gis dmag 'khrug de dag phyogs bsdus byas nas rigs gsum la dbye gnang yang mdzad yod/der brten gling ge sar rgyal po zhes bya ba ni/btsan po gnya' nas mnan/ nyam chung bde bas bskyangs/ bdud sde dam la btags/ mi dmangs bde bar bkod mkhan mi rigs kyi dpa' bo ༷ 54
zhig yin pas khong gi rlabs chen gyi mdzad rjes mtshon pa'i dpa' bo'i 'o rgyus snyan ngag ring mo 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉ces pa de dus yu na ring po'i nang bod rigs mi dmangs thun mong gis gsar rtsom byas pa 'ig yin nga snya 'o pa'i grags pa 'dzam gling yul gru kun la khyab pa 'ig kyang yin no/ /gsum pa/ 〈gling sgrung 〉gi sgyu rtsal gyi khud chos mdor bsdus slob khrid gnang dbos/de ya nga srid na 'gran zla bral ba'i 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉ni sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur 'bum gyis phyug pa zhig yin pas mtha' dag brjod par mi la nga yang cung khyab che zhing / go bde ba'i gsham gsal gyi don tshan rnams slob ma tshor slob khrid gnang na phan thogs che bar bsam pa ste/(gcig) lo rgyus snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal/( gnyis/) gzhas ma gtam gyi sgyu rtsal/(gsum/) thun min 'char yan gyi sgyu rtsal/( bzhi/) ngo mtshar sgrung mkhan gyi sgyu rtsal/(gcig)lo rgyus snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal/mkhyen gsal ltar lo rgyus snyan ngag ces pa ni lo rgyus dang snyan ngag zung 'brel byas pa dang / dpa' bo'i snyan ngag lo rgyus 'os pa ni snyan tshig la brten nas dpa' bo'i lo rgyus bshad pa de red/ 'jar man gyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba mkhas chen he ker gyis 〈mdzes rtsal rig pa〉zhes pa'i dpe deb tu lo rgyus snyan ngag gi ngo bo dang / khyad chos/ 'phel rim bcas kyi skor rgyas 55
bshad rgyud rim ldan pa zhig byas yod pa dang / 66lo rgyus snyan ngag spyir btang ba ji dang / 66lo rgyus snyan ngag dngos gzhi ma ga zhes khag gnyis su phye yod/gzhung lugs de dang bstun nas dpyad bsdur byas na 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉ni 66lo rgyus snyan ngag dngos gzhi ma 9 yin par bsnyon du med la gna' rabs zhi la'i 〈ho ma'i lo rgyus 〉snyan ngag dang / rgya sar gyi 〈rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod 〉 sogs kyang 66lo rgyus snyan ngag dngos gzhi ma'i 99 khongs su gtogs/de yang lo rgyus kyi snyan ngag de dag thog mar byung ba dang / bar du khyab gdal 'gro ba/ mtha' mar 'phel ba ni lo rgyus kyi go rim ha cang ring po zhig yin zhing / yangs shing rgya che ba'i lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs 'og lo rgyus dus rim nges can zhig gi nang mi rigs de'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba hril po phyogs mang po'i thog nas mtshon thub dper na 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉las rang mi rigs kyi gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus dang / dpal 'byor 'tsho ba/ thon skyed/dmag don/ chos lugs/ gso rig gnam gshis rig pa/ yul srol goms gshis cha lugs/ skad brda sogs tshan rig gi rin thang ldan pa'i dpyad gzhi mang po mthong thub pa ni phul du byung ba'i lo rgyus snyan ngag gi khyad chos sam sgyu rtsal zhig red/sgyu rtsal des mi rigs kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog gnas bab gal chen po zhig bzung yod par ma zad/ phyis 'byung gi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gong du 'phel ba la yang shugs rkyen gting zab mo thebs yod/gzhan yang lo rgyus snyan ngag gi brjod bya'i don ni mi sger gyi gnad don tsag tsig dang / rang nyid kyi bde sdug chags sdang tsam ma yin par rgyal khab ༷ 56
dang mi rigs kyi don gnad chen po sha stag yin pas mar khe sis kyang lo rgyus snyan ngag ni 66'dzam gling lo rgyus thog dus rabs kyi dbye mtshams gcod thub pa'i gna' rabs kyi sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa zhig red nya ces gsungs yod/der brten 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉gi rlabs che ba'i lo rgyus snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal dang khyad chos rags tsam shes pa bya rgyu ni shin tu gal che'o/ /(gnyis/)gzhas ma gtam gyi sgyu rtsal/de yang 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉ni shod pa dang glu len pa zung du 'brel ba'i gzhas ma gtam gyi sgyu rtsal ches khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin/de yang slob ma rnams kyis shes dgos pa zhig la mi rigs gang zhig la'ang gna' bo'i dus su glu dang snyan ngag ces dbye ba med pas phyis kyi snyan ngag tshang ma mna' bo'i glu gzhas sam mgur gyi rnam pa nas rim bzhin 'phel rgyas byung ba'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig yin/dper na/ rgya yi krig rgyal rabs kyi dus su byung ba'i snyan ngag 'dzam gling na grags che ba (hri cin 〉 〈)rla hā1〉 zhes par 'bod pa'i phal mo che dmangs gzhas kyi khongs su gtogs la khyad par de yi ya gyal du gyur ba 〈88hphi nga nya 〉〈khra〉zhes pa ni yongs rdzogs skabs de'i dmangs gzhas yin/ra ro cag bod mi rigs la'ang gna' snga mo nas sne mang phun sum tshogs pa'i dmangs gzhas dang mgur sogs grangs kyis mi lang ba yod pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog rim bzhin snyan ngag 'phel rgyas byung ba dang / 〈snyan ngag me long 〉bod du bsgyur rjes gzhi nas snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs shig byung ba red/ma gzhi 〈gling sgrung 〉ni dus phyis byung ba zhig yin na'ang de snyan ngag 57
khor rkyang zhig ma yin par gzhas ma gtam gyi 'khrab gzhung ches ring po 'ig kyang yin pa de ni 〈gling sgrung 〉la yod pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos sheg yin/des na nga tshos gangs can yul du lu gu lags skyes yin pa'i gzhas ma gtam gyi sgyu rtsal de la dpyad pa nan po byas na deng rabs kyi nang don ldan pa'i gzhas ma gtam gyi sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom byed dgos byung yang phan thogs shin tu che'o/ /(gsum/)lha sgrung gi sgyu rtsal/〈gling sgrung 〉nang don dngos dang lha sgrung mnyam bsres byas pa ha cang mang po zhig yod pa des dpa' bo'i gzugs brnyan gong du 'degs rgyur nus pa ha cang chen po thon yod/nga tshos dbye zhib byas na 〈gling sgrung nyinang gi mi sna gtso bo mi nyung ba zhig dang khyad par du gling ge sar rgyal po ni mi phyed lha phyed kyi dpa' bo zhig dang /mi dang lha'i spyod gnyis rtag par zung du 'brel nas bsdad yod pa dper na/mi la thun mong ma yin pa'i mthu stobs dang dpa' rtsal yod pa dang / rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston shes pa/ yar lha yul du 'gro thub la/ mar klu yul dang dmyal bar yang 'gro thub cing / tha na 'do ba cang shes dang / rno ba'i mtshon cha/ mtho ba'i ri bo/ ring ba'i gtsang po/ zab pa'i mtsho mo/ bya byi'u dang ri dwags sems can sogs tshud pa'i srog ldan dang srog med kyi dngos po mtha' dag la'ang mi'i 'du shes dang 'dod blo yod pa ni lha sgrung gi sgyu rtsal las ma 'das so/ /58
de'i thad mkhas dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtshos kyang 66mi'i rigs kyi bskal pa ya thob ska bas kyi nang don phun sum tshogs shing yid dbang 'phrog pa'i lha sgrung rnams kyis lo rgyus snyan ngag gong du 'phel bar dpyad gzhi phun sum tshogs pa 'ig gra sgrig byas pa dang /sgyu rtsal gyi rmang ga'i zab mo zhig bting yod pa'i dbang gis lo rgyus snyan ngag la lha sgrung gi shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod rta ces gsungs pa ni thugs shin tu mad pa'i gtam du 'khums/gzhan yang lha sgrung gi sgyu rtsal la gzhan dang mi 'dra bar kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog pa'i nus pa shugs chen yod pa ni/ dper na/ rang rgyal gyi grags can sgrung gtam ring mo (nub phyogs su bskyod pa'i rnam thar 〉bklags na'ang 'dra/ tshang mas ha cang dga' po byed don ni gtso bo de'i nang gi lha sgrung gi sgyu rtsal ha las dgos pa 'i gro yo da pa'i rkyen gyis red/ nye ba'i dus su 〈gling sgrung 〉brnyan 'phrin yang kun gyi 'dren byed yul du gyur yod/'on kyang des tshang ma'i yid dbang de tsam 'phrog mi nus pa de ni de'i nang lha sgrung gi sgyu rtsal bkol spyod byas med pas red snyam/ der brten lha sgrung zhes pa ni 'tsho ba dngos dang 'brel med kyi sgrung zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed rgyu med par tshad mtho'i sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa zhig yin pa nges par du shes dgos so/ /(bzhi/)sgrung mkhan gyi sgyu rtsal/sgrung mkhan phul byung rnams kyis 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉 dmangs 59
khrod du khyab gdal la 'gro ba'i go rim nang nus pa ha cang chen po bton yo da pas kho tsho ni gling sgrung thad gar gsar rtsom byed mtho/khan dang / rgyud 'dzin byed mkhan/ dar spel gtong mkhan bcas yin/de yang sgrung mkha na ma nga che bas yi ge mi shes kyang sgrung po ti mang po ngag thog nas chu rgyugs pa ltar shod thub pa'i ngo mtshar sgrung mkhan gyi sgyu rtsal de la rgyal khab phyi nang gi skye bo kun ha las shing / hon thor ba las de'i lkog gyur gyi gsang mthil da lta'ang brdol thub med/gling sgrung bshad dus rnyog dra chen po dang gra sgrig sogs gang yang byed mi dgos par ga dus ga sar bshad kyang chog mod 'ga' zhig la cha rkyen phran bu dgos pa'ang yod pa ni/sgrung mkhan la las sgrung ma bshad pa'i sngon la mchod pa bshams shing mdun du ge sar rgyal po dang / dpa' thul sum cu/ 'brug mo sogs ma sru rnams kyis thang ga bkal thog mar me spar ba dang / yon chab phul/ lha bsangs btang ba sogs dad gus chen pos gsol ba 'debs shing / de 'dra byed pa ni sgrung 'bebs pa'i ched du yin zhes bshad srol yod/yang sgrung mkhan la las rang nyid ni dpa' thul gang zhig gi sprul pa yin zer ba dper na/ mgo log gi sgrung mkhan ngag rig gis rang nyid mi chung kha bde'i sprul pa yin zer ba dang / tshe brten rdo rjes shan pa rme ru rtse'i sprul pa yin zer ba lta bu'o/ /sgrung shod tshul yang mi 'dra ba yod pa ni dper na/ la las thang la bsdad nas shod pa dang / la las sgrung zhwa 'khyer nas shod pa/ yang 'ga' zhig gis phreng ba 'khyer nas shod pa sogs sna tshogs yod pa ni dper na/ 60
sgrung mkhan gzhon nu ma g.yu sman gyis phreng ba gcig 'khyer nas bshad kyi yod/kho mos 88phreng ba khyer rgyu de goms gshis su chags nas gal srid ma 'khyer na bshad mi thub nya zer/yang 'ga' zhig gis shog bu stong pa zhig khyer te lta zhor dang bshad zhor byed cing / don du shog bu'i thog ka kha tsam yang med/de ltar 〈ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉zhes pa'i rlabs chen gyi lo rgyus snyan ngag de sgrung mkhan rnams kyi lus thog tu srung nyar byed cing gson por bsdad yod pas sgrung mkhan yod na sgrung yod pa dang / sgrung mkhan med na sgrung yang med pas phul du byung ba'i sgrung mkhan rnams ni nor bu dngos shig yin la ngo mtshar che ba'i sgrung mkhan gyi sgyu rtsal de ni dpog par dka' zhing ha las dgos pa zhig yin no/ /bzhi pa/ 〈gling sgrung 〉nang gi yul srol goms 'dris mdor bsdus slob khrid gnang dgos/de yang yul srol goms 'dris zhes pa ni gos rgyan dang / bza' btung /gnyen sgrig dur 'jug dus chen/ gus lugs thon skyed byed stangs/chos lugs sogs kun la go dgos kyang thams cad brjod par mi lang bas 'dir dmigs bsal re gcis ngo sprod zhu bar bya ste/(gcig)gos rgyan gyi skor/1 gling gi skyes pa rnams kyis dgun dus su tsha ru'i nang ma can gyi nang 'jam dang / sram gyis mtha' rgyan spras pa'i tshar slog dang gzig lpags kyi 61
gong ba spras pa'i slog pa sogs phyi gos su gyon/ mgo la wa zhwa dang rna bzhi dang phying zhwa sogs gon zhing / lus smad du pags pa dang / snam bu sogs kyi dor ma gyon pa dang / rkang la ko ltam dang phying ltam/ de bzhin gser dngul gyi rna rgyan dang mdzub dkris/ gser dang byu ru'i ske rgyan/ gser dngul ba so'i gdu bu/ glo zur dang / gri chung / phreng ba sogs kyi rgyan cha/ dbyar dus su mgo la lag ras dkri zhing / skabs re rgya zhwa le ba mo gon pa dang / mgo bo'i skra lo mi bzhar bar phrag steng khebs pa'i bar du 'jos lus la ther ma dang /snam phrug gos chen/ ras sogs kyi la ba gon/ chu gos dang rlung gos kyi nang 'jam dang rkang snam gon/ gzhan yang skye pags kyi rkang snam dang /snam bu'i la ba/ slo ga skya sogs kyang gon gyi yod do/ /2 gling gi bud med rnams kyis gos su nang 'jam/ phyi gos/ tshar slog slo ga skya/ ther ma/ gos chen/ snam phrug sogs bklubs pa dang /rkang la 'ja' lham/ phying lham/ ko lham sogs gon/ rgyan la g.yu byur nor bu'i mgo rgyan/ gser dngul zangs gsum gyi mdzub dkris/ gser dngul ba so'i gdu bu/ dngul gyi glo zur dang / bzho bzung / chab ma/ sgrog kor dang / dkor ril/ skra shing tsho/ ca la sogs skra rgyan gyis mdzes par spud pa yin te/ gling sgrung 〈rma shel brag 〉las/ 66gling mdo khams bod kyi dpon mo de mgo rgyan rab la nor bu sna tshogs/ lus gos rab la za 'og dgu brtsegs/med chings 'ja' tshon rang shar/ ser po spos shel dgu bsgrigs/ khra bo gzi byur dgu bsgrigs/ gser mgul 'gu ya gra 'grigs/ gser chab nor bu'i phra tshom/ gser rna mu tig btags lungs/ gser ga'u rin chen dgu bsgrigs/ glo zur nor 'dzin dgu bsgrigs/ mu tig zar lo rang 'grigs/ 62
dar lham 'ja' ris sum brtsegs/ ltam sgrog chu mig ( phyed mig ) dgu bsgrigs sogs rgyan rab phun sum tshogs pas spras te mdzes dgu lus la tshang bas pho sems mo la 'chor ba zhig yin nya zhes gsal ba ltar ro/ /3 gling gi dmag mi rnams kyis mgo la dung rmog dang / lcags rmog zangs rmog sogs gon zhing / de'i steng kha dog sna lnga'i 'phrul dar 'dzugs/brang la me long 'dogs/ lus su shel khyab/ g.yu khyab/ mthing khyab/lcags khrab/ gser khyab/ dngul khrab/ byir khyab/ mchong khyab sogs gyon/mtshon char mda' mdung gri gsum 'dzin zhing / g.yas kyi stag ral nang du gzhu mo 'jog pa dang / g.yon gyi gzig shubs nang du mda' mo 'jog lag tu mdung mo 'dzin pa sogs ni gling sgrung 〈khyung tsha spun lnga 〉las 66de nas tshes bcu'i nyin la gong gi dpon slob lnga po rang rang rta dmag lnga brgya re dang bcas/ seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul des/ nges bzung khra dkar me long btags/ stag ral g.yas la mchog dkar gzhu yis bkang / gzig shubs g.yon la nyag phran mda' yis brgyan/ dug ral pags pa sngon po gsol/mdung mo khams gsum dbang 'dul la/ stong gsum 'phrul gyi ba dan sprad/dgra lha'i 'phrul zhags gru la bkal/ dbu rmog rgyal ba'i thod dkar la/ lha tshang pa'i 'phru dar btsugs nya zhes sogs gsal ba las gling dmag gi go mtshon dang gos rgyan mtshon pa dang / de yang phub chen dang /: stag ral /mda'/ gzhu/ mdung / ral gri/ zhags pa/ 'khor lo/ star chen bcas la dgra lha'i go mtshon sna dgu zer zhing / gling dam ga rnams kyis dgra lha'i go mtshon sna dgu bzung nas phyogs bzhi dgra rnams brtul te 'bangs rnams bde la bkod pa dang / gzhan yang gling gi dmag dpon gyi dbu la dar 'phru 63
'dzugs shing dmag mi rnams kyi mgo la rmog gyon pa las dar 'phru mi 'dzugs pa'i khar/ dar 'phru'i kha dog la bltas nas dmag dpon che chung dang dmag shog gang yin sogs dbye ba 'byed par grags so/ /4 gling pa rnams gsang sngags kyi chos la dad pa ha cang chen po yod cing / gling la dbu bla sum cu yod pa dang / da dung sngags pa'ang ha cang mang po yod/sngags pa de dag gi mgo la 66sngags ral nya zhes pa'i ral pa chen po re 'jog cing / lus la le'u g.yung drung thig le can gyi chos gos dang / dbu la sgom zhwa/ tshe gos phod chen mthing nag stod gos rdo rje'i go cha/ sku sham mthing gos dmar po/ sku chings le rgan ljang khu/ chos gos gser gyi ha ris/zhabs phyags pad ma yar 'khyil/ ber chen 'dab ma stong ldan sogs bklabs pa dang / da dung rnying ma'i chos sgor zhugs pa rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i sman snod/ mar gad ljang khu'i maṇḍal/ iṇḍa ni la'i bum pa/ mu tig dang bad ma ra ga'i nang mchod/ shel gyi kong bu/ spos sheg dang byu ru'i chu skyes/phra men gyi phud snod sogs mchod chas sna tshogs spyod pa yin no/ /(gnyis/)bza' btung gi skor/gling pa rnams kyis bza' btung ci zhig longs su spyod pa yin zhe na/ de yang gling gi 'brog pa rnams kyis sha dang / mar / thud/ thug pa/ rtsam pa/phye mar/ sha mog mog ste sha 'tshos/ go re rlangs btsos/ 'bras/ gro ma/ sha mo/ 'o ja/ nas chang / zho/ 'o ma sogs ci dgar longs su spyod pa dang /gling gi rong pa rnams kyis thug pa dang / bo/ re/ bag leb/ go dmar/ sha 64
'tshos/ ra sgog gi 'tshos ma/ dkar nyog sran nyog g.yis/ tsong /g.yer ma/ sgog skya/ tshod dkar/ la phug rtsam pa/ 'o ja/ nas chang /chang ser/ 'bras thug gro 'bras/ sha/ shing tog sogs longs su spyod pa ni gling sgrung 〈rma shel brag 〉sogs las gsal bar bshad yod do/ /(gsum/)gnyen sgrig gi skor/gling gi bu rnams pho mo bco brgyad la son na blo pha la mi 'dri bar jus thag rang gis gcod cing / bu mo rnams mo lo bco lngar son na zas ma la mi slong bar bza' btung g.yos sbyor la goms dgos pa dang / na tshod de 'drar son na pho rnams kyis chung ma len zhing mo rnams bag mar 'gro ba yin/bag ma rnams skyel ba dang bsu ba sogs la'ang bye brag gi dbye ba mang du mchis kyang spyir gling pa rnams kyis thog mar gnyen dar 'then/ bar du gnyen rtags rgyag mthar slong chang ldud pa yin/ gnyen sgrig dngos su byed stangs ni bod rigs sa khul gzhan dang dbye ba de tsam mi snang /'on te gling pa'i skyes pa rnams kyis khyim thabs gsum bzhi tsam bsu chog cing / bud med kyis kyang khyo bo gsum bzhi tsam 'tshol chog pa dang /khyim gcig tu spun bzhi lnga tsam yod pa yang de rnams la khyim thabs gcig ma gtogs mi bsu ba'ang yod/de ni dper na gling sgrung nang gsal ba'i gling gi chos 'phel nag pos gser bza' dang / lam bza' dang / spyad bza' sogs khab tu bzhes pa lta bu'i/ 65
(bzhi/)dus chen gyi skor/yongs grags su gling pa rnams kyi dus chen ni/ lo gsar dang / bzhi pa'i bco lnga/ lnga pa'i tshes lnga/ drug pa'i lha rtse dang dmag rtse sogs yin/ /logs ra dang bzhi pa'i bco lnga sogs spyir bod kyi sa cha gzhan gyi dus chen dang 'dra bas 'dir lnga pa'i tshes lnga dang / drug pa'i lha rtse dang dmag rtse'i dus chen ngo sprod ches mdor bsdus zhu bar bya ste/1 lnga pa'i tshes lnga'i dus chen gyi skabs su gling pa rnams kyis me tog dang shing lo sogs btus te khyim gyi sgo la 'dzugs shing / de'i zhogs par nyi rtse ma shar gong la bud med rnams chu len par 'gro ba dang / zhogs pa de'i chu la sangs rgyas sman blas nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog pa'i sman btab yod zer nas rgan gzhon kun gyis 'thungs shing kha lag bkru/ byis pa rnams chu khar song nas chu rkyal byed pa yin/nyin de'i zhogs par sngo tshod kyi 'tshos ma longs su spyod/ byis pa rnams gos gsar pa gon zhing skyed du shing lo dang / me tog 'dzugs/ rgan pa rnams kyis skyed par me tog dang shing lo re btsugs te slad kyi na ba bzlog par smon lam 'debs/2 zla drug pa'i tshes nyi shu gsum ni drug pa'i lha rtse zhes bya ba'i dus chen yin zhing / gling pa rnams kyis nyin der gos rgyan phun sum tshogs pa bklubs te lha rtse dang / klu rtse/ dmag rtse sogs la rol/ de yang lha rtse ni gling ge sar rgyal po gong ma lha nas mi yul du tshe 'phros pa'i lo rgyus gar du rtsen pa zhig yin pa dang / klu rtse ni ma 'gog bza' klu yul nas slob dpon pad ma 'byung 66
gnas kyis spyan drangs pa'i lo rgyus gar du rtsen pa zhig yin/ dmag rtse ni gling seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyis phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi 'dul bar drag po dmag gi las byas tshul gar du rtsen pa zhig yin la de dag gi rgyun srol da lta'i bar du ma chad par gnas na yang nang don dang 'khyab ston byed stangs la 'gyur ba byung yong do/ /lnga pa/ 〈gling sgyang nyidang rtsom 'bri dngos zung 'brel gyis slob khrid mkhor bsdus gnang dgos/〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉 ni lam tsam bltas na go bde ba dang /zhig tu dpyad na gting zab pa/ mngon brjod dang brda rnying gis ma bcing kyang rjod byed tshig sbyor tshar du dngar ba/ gus tshig dang / gtam dpe/legs bshad sogs kyis yongs su phyug pa'i do zla bral ba'i rtsom rig chen mo zhig yin pa ma zad de'i nang don gcig la dpe mang sbyar ba'i bod kyi gna' rabs snyan ngag stsom srol dang / (tun hong snyang ngag lta bu )bod kyi sro la rgyun snyan ngag gi rgyan grangs las 'das pa (phal mo che don rgyan yin )zhig yod pa ma zad deng rabs rtsom rig gzhung lugs las bstan pa'i mi sna'i 'khrab chas zhib 'bri byed stangs dang / khor yug zhib 'bri byed stangs/ bya 'gul zhib 'bri byed stangs sogs dang mthun pa ha cang mang po yod pas de dag phan tshun zung 'brel gyis slob khrid gnang na phan pa shin tu che bar mthong / de yang 〈gling sgrung sminang gi srol rgyun snyan ngag 'bri stangs kyi dge mtshan len pa cung sla bas 'dir deng rabs rtsom rig gi rtsom srol 'ga' zhig zhu bar bya ste/1 mi sna'i 'khyab chas zhib 'bri byed stangs/ 67
'khyab chas zhes pa ni ma gzhi zlos gar dang / glog brnyan/ brnyan 'phrin sogs la nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad yin mod/ rtsom rig nang tha snyad de spyad nas mi sna zhib 'bri byed pa'i thabs shes shig gsal bar bshad pa'i tshe/mi snas nyer spyad kyi 'khyab chas zhib 'bri byed thabs de kho na nyid bsta na pa yin no/ /dper na 〈chu ngogs gtam rgyud〉 nang gi wu'u sung gi dbyug pa dang lis khos kyi sta re/ 〈rgyal khab gsum gyi sgrung〉nang gi kru'u ko ling gi bya sgro'i bsil yab/ 〈thog khang dmar po'i rmi lam〉nang gi ca po dbyi'i mgul bar btags pa'i bla 'brel dbyig gor sogs lta bu'o/ /〈 nub phyogs su bskyod pa'i rnam thar〉nang sun wu'u khung gi gser rgyug lta bu mngon gsal mang po yod/ ma gzhi sgrung rtsom sogs nang yod pa'i mi sna yod tshad la 'khrab chas bkod sgrig byed dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang / mi sna'i khyad chos dang / dgos dbang / zhi drag sogs la bstun nas 'khrab chas bkod sgrig byed mkhas po byung na des mi sna de'i gzugs brnyan gzhan dang mi 'dra bar gson bzhengs bya rgyur dgos pa ha cang chen po thon thub pa gong gsal zhus pa ltar lags/ 'on kyang mi sna zhig la 'khyab chas gang drag drag bkod sgrig byas na des mi sna'i bkod pa la gnod pa las phan pa 'byung mi srid pas/ mi sna de'i thob thang dang nyams myong / rang bzhin nam dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos sogs la bstun nas 'khyab chas bkod sgri tsa/ bya dgos la ma mthar yang bkod sgrig byas pa'i 'khrab chas des nus pa thon pa zhig bya dgos pa las don med kyi 'khyab chas bkod sgrig byed mi rung / de'i pad mkhas dbang chi kho phros 44gal te khyed kyis le'u dang po'i nang du rtseg ngor 68
me mda' 'ig bkal tshul bris yod na le'u gnyis pa'am gsum pa'i nang du khyed kyis nges par du me mda' kha grags su 'jug dgos/ gal srid kha ma grags na me mda' de rtsig ngor bkal ba'i dgos pa ci yang med par gyur ro ltazhes kha gsal zhing gnad la 'khel ba'i bslab bya gnang yod/de dag dang 'dra bar 〈gling sgrung nyinang du'ang 'dan ma'i mda' mo dang /stag seng gi ral gri leb chen/ mi nag stobs ldan gyi pha bong / khro thung gi mo chas sogs ha cang mang po yod pa ni dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed 〉las/ 'dan mas 66kho re shan pa rme ru rtse/ mda' 'phen na de 'dra 'phen pa min/ 'phen thag chod 'di 'dra 'phen pa yin/ ༷ zer nas mda' gcig brgyab pa dang / sdig gcod shan pa'i rmog khung gtor/ rtse lnga'i zur nas phud/ mo byang gi dkyil nas bton/ mgo ka li lag mthil tsam zhig rgya mthong kha phye ba 'dra 'ig byas pas shan pa yud tsam dran med du brgyal lo/nyanyazhes dang / yang 〈stag gling g.yul 'gyed 〉las 88blon chen 'dan ma de ngar chen gyi gdong la bud de gzhu chung dkar mo 'then skyed nang mda' 'gran med rgyal po'i phyag mda' chos skyong dngos rgyug zer ba de bzhag nas ༷ myur bar mda' de 'ur sgra dang bcas 'phang byung bas kur lding gi sgras gnam sa gas pa ltar gyis mda' de mdun gyi snying khar thebs te go cha dang srung bas ma brtan cing snying tshal pa brgyad du btang ste gri g.yug long med par glag mo thang la 'jum pa bzhin sras khra rgod zla ba rta thog nas lhung de shi nya zhes pa lta bu 〈gling sgrung 〉tshang ma'i nang 'dan ma'i mda' yang bshad bskyar bshad byas yod/de ltar mi sna de'i gshis ga'am 'jon thang dang mthun pa'i 'khyab chas 69
zhib 'bri byas na mi sna sngar bas gson nyams ldan pa dang 'bur du thon pa/blta na sdug pa bcas yong bar nus pa ha cang mngon gsal dod po thon pa ni gong gsal ltar ro/2 khor yug zhib 'bri byed stangs/de yang khor yug zhib 'bri byed stangs zhes pa la spyi tshogs khor yug gi zhib 'bri dang rang byung khor yug gi zhib 'bri gnyis 'dus yod/ mi sna gang 'dra zhig yin rung gong gros la khor yug nges can zhig gi nang du 'tsho ba las rang nyid hreng hreng du gnas thabs gtan nas med/ des na khor yug 'ib 'bri byed rgyu ni rtsom rig gi rnam pa kun la khyab cing gal ha cang che ba zhig yin/〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung nyi nang du khor yug zhib 'bri ha cang yag po byas yod pa dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed 〉las/ 88 shar khra bo glang gi sa cha/'brug lhang lhang nor bu'i gdan steng / snyan lhang lhang khu byug sgrog sa/ zhe lhang lhang co ga 'gyur sa/ bde mchog nor bu'i pho brang / gru bzhi sa yi gdan thog g.yu spra mthing shog gong dgu na/ skya lo seng lcam 'brug mo de nyid gnas shing yod pa na/rta zhes pa lta bu ni tshig nyung yang rna bar snyan zhing khor yug zhib 'bri byas pa zhin yin pa ni rtsom rig gsar pa grags can nang gi khor yug zhib 'bri dang cha 'dra bar mngon/ dper na lu'u zhun gyi brtsam bya 〈khung yi ci 〉zhes pa las/ 88lu'u krin grong rdal gyi chang khang gi bkod pa ni sa cha gzhan dang mi 'dra ste/ srang lam gyi kha gtad du grug khru'i dbyibs dang / ༷ ༷mtshungs pa'i cha sgam chen po zhig bzhag yod pa dang / de'i nang du chu tshan gra sgrig byas yod pas nam tshod nges med du chang bsros na chog las ka ba rnams nyin dgung ngam sa srod kyi dus su las ka grol rjes so sos dong tse 70
bzhi re bkol te chang dkar yol gang nyo nges yin/ ༷ cha sgam phyi rol du 'greng ste chang bzhes byas rjes ngal gso byed/ mgron po de dag mang shos lwa thung gyon pa red/ ༷ la ring gyon mkhan kho na da gzod chang khang gi khang ba mtshes ma'i nang du song nas chang dang tshod ma nyos te dal bzhugs dal bzhes byed pa red 〉 ces khor yug zhib 'bri gnang ba ji bzhin 〈gling sgrung sminang du'ang ches mang ngo / /3 bya 'gul zhib 'bri byed stangs/mi sna'i spyo da lam dang bya 'gul ni de'i bsam pa'i sna nga ba dang / rang bzhin bcas kyi tshod 'dzin dang kha lo sgyur nges yin la/ spyod lam dang bya 'gul gyi khrod du de'i bsam pa/ snang ba/ rang bzhin bcas phun sum tshogs pa'i ngang mtshon pa yin pas/ bya 'gul zhib 'bri byed pa ni mi sna zhib 'bri byed pa'i thabs dam pa zhig yin gshis kor cis kyang 66sgyu rtsal gyi rtsom rig la mi rnams kyi yid 'phrog pa'i slob gso'i yon tan zhig ldan dgos pa yin na/nges par du mi sna gtso bo de dag la don mang po sgrub pa dang skad cha nyung nyung bshad du 'jug dgos ’ gzhes gsu ngas yod/〈gling sgrung 〉gi nang mi sna'i bya 'gul zhib 'bri ha cang mang po zhig yod pa las 'dir dpe zhig drangs na 〈stag gling g.yul 'gyed 〉las/ 66de nyid stag rong tshang rma rgyal sbom ra bstod par 'gro rtsis kyis g.yog mo lha skyed dpal 'dzom des tha la ba sle gang khyer nas sgo la yong bar rta yi sna sgra zhig rna lam du thos pas ci yin snyam nas yar bltas pas stag rong dar sde khrag mo'i ru ba de rta dmag stong tsam gyi bskor tshar 'dug pa mthong bas la mo sbra nang du yar rgyug nas na re/ stag rong dpon dang lha rgod bcas pa mgyogs par yar 71
bzhengs/ nga rang tshang ge ru ba de rta dmag mang pos bskor tshar 'dug da ci byed zer nas bos pas a khus ༷ gcer bur langs nas phyur ba bskol sa'i khro chen po zhig yod pa de'i 'og la gab nas bsdad 97ces khro thung gis skad cha tshig gcig kyang bshad med kyang bya 'gul zhib 'bri byes pa de'i thog nas kho ni klad med dang / snying med sdar ma'i nang gi tha shal zhig yin pa mtshon thub/dus phyis kyi grags can rtsom yig mang po'i nang gi mi sna'i bya 'gul zhib 'bri byas te nus pa ha cang chen po thon yod pa ni dper na/〈a 'a rnam thar 〉las/ 66a 4 yis ri mo sgor sgor zhig 'bri bar brtsams kyang smyu gu 'dzin byed lag pa rang dbang med par 'dar 'dar byas/ mi des kho'i tshab tu shog bu thang la btings/ a khu mar sgur nas stobs shugs yod tshad kyis ri mo sgor sgor zhig bris/ kho mi gzhan gyis 'phya smod byed par dogs nas ri mo sgor sgor zhig 'bri 'dod yod kyang / ltas ngan du gyur ba'i smyu gu de shin tu lci bar ma zad/ kha lo sgyur sla ba zhig kyang ma yin pas/ 'dar 'dar byas pa'i dbang gis smyug rtse ni kha zum la yod pa'i ma tshams nas phyir shor te mtha' mar me tog nyi ma 'khor gyi 'bru gu dang 'dra ba'i ri mo sne ring zhig bris song /ga zhes sogs mi sna'i bya 'gul zhib 'bri byas pas skyo ba'i zlos gar gyi nang don sngar las lhag pa'i gting zab tu phyin nas klog pa po rnams kyi sems rnam par rigayo thub pa byung ba red/ des na gong gsal mi sna'i 'a/krib chas zhib 'bri dang /khor yug zhib 'bri/ bya 'gul zhib 'bri la sogs pa'i rtsom 'bri'i shes bya dang 〈gling sgrung 〉slob khrid zung 'brel gnang na slob ma'i bod yig rtsom 'bri'i shes bya de tshig rgyan kho na'i bkag rgya las thar te rim bzhin 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi phyogs su bskyod thub na ci ma rung snyam pa bcas 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i 72
sgrung 〉slob khrid gnang thabs skor la dpyad gzhir phul ba'i rang gi lta tshul re gnyis zhes pa 'di ni rig pa'i gnas kun la spyad dkyus ring ba'i mkhas dbang dag la thugs mkho ye nas ma mchis kyang myong ba zhan zhing / dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs dkon pa'i gsar bu re gnyis la phan pa cung zad re yong ba'i re ba dga' tshal spug skyes ming 'dzin pa'i blo gsar gyi ngan ba jus med jus 'khri des bris so/ /
bod kyi srol rgyun gzhas tshig dang gzhas tshig gsar rtsom skor cung zad gleng ba/gleng gzhi/mig sngar bsil ljongs sgyu rtsal gyi kun gsal sgeg mo'i ngos su zhabs bro dang / rol dbyangs/ gtam brjod/ lha mo sogs sna kha mi 'dra ba'i phul byung ge gsar rtsom brtsam bya skar tshogs bzhin du grangs kyis mi lang ba tho na dang thon bzhin yod pa dang chabs cig de dag la zhib 'jug gnang ba'i ched rtsom dang dpyad rtsom yang ha cang mang po mjal rgyu yod kyang bod kyi snga deng gzhas tshig la dpyad pa brjod pa'i rtsom yig cung cha tshang ba da phan 'dren byed yul du ma gyur pas rang gi da phan lo ngo nyi shu lhag tsam ring dmangs khrod gzhas tshig slob sbyong dang ched las sgyu rtsal tshogs pa'i nang gzhas tshig byas pa'i myong ba/ bya ba 'di ni mkhas dbang rnam pas kho bo'i bgo skal du 'jog gnang mdzad pa min nam snyan ste 'dir skabs su babs pa bod yig gzhas tshig skor chu brgya zam 'dus kyi brjod pa bzhi/dang po/ gzhag tshig dang snyan ngag bar gyi 'brel ba'i skor/gcig de yang deng gi dus su 'ga' zhig gis glu gzhas sam de'i 74
gzhan tshig ni dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig dang / snyan ngag ni rtsom pa po'i yig thog gi rtsom rig cig yin par 'dod pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis gsar rtsom gzhas tshig ni rtsom pa po'i yig thog rtsom rig yin par bsnyon du med kyang de snyan ngag ma yin par 'dod pa/ yang la las gzhas tshig ni dbyangs sbyar ba'i snyan ngag yin la/ snyan ngag la'ang dbyangs sbyar na gzhas tshig yin par 'dod/ da dung la las gzhas tshig ni snyan ngag yin pa ma zad ches dka' ba'i snyan ngag cig yin par 'dod pa bcas rtsa ba'i 'dod tshul bzhi yod par snang /ma gzhi de dag tshang mar rgyu mtshan nges can re yod pa smos mi dgos kyang kho bo'i bsam par dngos po gang zhig la brtag dus kyang thog mar dngos po de'i khyad chos sam rtags dang mtshan ma la brten nas shes par bya ba las dngos po'i khyad chos la ma brten pa'i dngos po rang mtshan zhig yod mi srid cing / da dung dngos po de'i 'byung khungs dang / 'phel rim sogs ji bzhin khong du chud na gzhi nas phu thag chod pa zhig yong ba las rang rang lta ba nyi tshe ba re bzung ba ni shin tu gu dog par mthong / des na 'dir sngon la gzhas tshig dang snyan ngag gi byung ba mdor bsdus sheg gzhus na 'di lta ste/rgyal khab dang mi rigs gang zhig yin min la ma ltos par snyan ngag yod do cog gna' bo'i glu ga 'as sam mgur gyi rnam pa nas 'phel rgyas byung ba'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig yin te/ de yang thog mar glu gzhas dang / zhabs bro/snyan ngag bcas gsum ni dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu 'dus la/ khyad par du snyan ngag dang gzhas tshig ni de bas phar khyab tshur khyab yin mod phyis so sor gyes pa da lta 'dzam gling rtsom rig khyab khongs su mgrin pa gcig yin/ dper 75
na/ rgya yi khrun chi'u dus rabs kyi dus su byung ba'i snyan ngag 'dzam gling na grags che ba 〈 hri cin 〉〈sgo phre1〉zhes pa de'i nang gi phal mo che dang / khyad par du de yi ya gyal du gyur pa 66hran 93 (khra) zhes pa yongs rdzogs skabs de'i dmangs gzhas sha stag yin pa dang / da dung rgya'i gtsug lag las 〈snyan ngag chen mo'i gleng gzhi 〉zhes par/ 46yid 'gyur rnam pa 'gyu tshe ngag tu brjod/brjod pa tsam gyis ma tshims dbyangs su 'gugs/ dbyangs su bkug pas mi tshims glu ru len/ des kyang da dung tshims pa med pas na/ lag pas stangs stabs rkang pas zhabs bro rdung nya zhes gsal ba ltar na de dus snyan ngag dang glu gzhas tsam ma zad rol dbyangs dang / zhabs bro'ang tha dad min zhing /khyad par du de skabs kyi glu tshig ni thog ma'i snyan ngag yin te/ brjod pa bde zhing dbyangs su gyer chog pa zhig tu mngon/ de bzhin rang re'i bod du'ang gna' dus su snyan tshig dang / gzhas tshig gnyis su med pa dper na/ rgyal sras spu de gung rgyal phying ba stag rtser phebs pa na/ khong gi yab gri gum btsan po blon po lo ngam gyis bkrongs pas gong na dpon po med cing / 'og na 'bangs thor ba'i tshul gzigs pas thugs shin tu skyo ste/ 66yul yab kyi rje rmyacibzhugs na/ pye 'brog de gdengs dpyol dpyol gyis 'phya'o/ dog yab kyi chab ma mchis te/ sa bon bu spur khog khog rta ces skyo glu blangs pa dang / phyis dgra sha blangs/ srid dbang phyag tu son pa'i tshe'ang dga' ba'i 'gyur ba mtshon pa'i glu dbyangs blangs pa sogs ni gzhas tshig yin la snyan ngag kyang yin pa dang / de bzhin gnam ri srong btsan gyi dus rgyal po'i blon po khyung po spung sad zu tse dang / mang po rje zhang snang gnyis rgyal po'i mdun du glu shags byas pa'i tshe khyung po spung sad zu tses glu blangs pa/ 76
na ning ni gzhes ning snga/ / ti se ni gangs drung nas/ /sha dang ni rkyang byer ba 'a(ba)/ / sham po ni stsa (rtsa )la byer/ /de ring ni sang lta na/ / sham po ni gnyan gyi rtsa/ /sha rkyang ni tshas ma nyan(ngan)/ / sha rkyang ni tshas ngan na/ /ti se ni gangs kyis (kyi ) brun/ zhes pa sogs gzhas tshig yin la snyan ngag kyang yin pa ma zad da lta'i snyan gzhung ltar na'ang bsdus brjod kyi rgyan dang / 'gog pa'i rgyan 'dres pa'i nyams yod pa dang / de'i lan du mang po rje zhang snang gis glu blangs par/ /na ning ni gzhes ning snga/ / chab chab ni pha rol na/ /yar chab ni pha rol na/ / dgu gri ni zing po rje/ /nya las ni kham du dkong / / kham mas ni rmeg du bta' (btang)/ /skyi nas ni nya 'don pa/ / dbyi tshab ni pangs to re/ / zhes pa'ang gzhas tshig yin pa smos med thog da lta'i snyan gzhung ltar na dpe rgyan yin pa lta bu shin tu mang ba dang / da dung srong btsan sgam po'i sring mo sad mar kur zhang zhung rgyal po'i bag mar btang rjes/ des rgyal po la zhang zhung mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa'i dus la babs pa dang / dus las yol na zhang zhung de rgyal khab gzhan dag gi mnga' 'og tu 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod lugs kyi gsang brda glu ru blangs pa dang / rgyal po 'dus sro nga mang po rje'i dus su blon po mgar gyi bu zhig rgyal po la blo log pa'i skabs rgyal pos glu blangs pa/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas gtsug la ga khang bzhengs grub rjes thugs dgyes pa'i glu blangs pa/ de ba'i na mar pa dang mi la sogs kyi gsung mgur dang / ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung glu sogs nang gi gzhas tshig tshang ma ni snyan ngag yin la/77
snyan ngag tshang ma ni gzhas tshig yin/ lhag par du rig 'dzin tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu ni/ gcig nas grags can gyi snyan ngag yin zhes rang rgyal tsam ma zad phyi'i rgyal khab mang por khyab yod pa dang / gnyis nas yongs khyab kyi gzhas tshig tu 'gyur nas ched las dang las zhor gyi rig rtsal las don pas dbyangs su gyer ba ma zad gangs ri'i ljongs kyi yi ge mi shes pa'i skye bo pho mo mang pos 'khon 'khon thogs thogs med par gzhas tshig nang gtong dang gtong mus yin pa ni kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar lags/ des na kho bo'i lta bar thog mar gna' bo'i dmangs gzhas kyi gzhas tshig las snyan ngag dar ba dang / bar du rim bzhin 'phel rgyas phyin te phan tshun yin khyab mnyam du gyur/ dus da lta rtsa ba gcig la yal ga gsum yod pa'i shing sdong ltar snyan ngag yin la gzhas tshig yin pa dang / snyan ngag yin la ga las tshig ma yin pa/gzhas tshig yin la snyan ngag ma yin pa bcas mu gsum du gyes par 'dod/gnyis/ spyir snyan ngag ces pa ni rna bar snyan pa'i ngag la go dgos kyang gang zhig rna bar snyan min yul can so so 'i snang ngor thad dad du snang ba yin/de dang 'dra bar gzhas tshig kyang snyan zhing 'jebs pa zhig dgos mod glu gzhas nyan pa po'i sgra 'dzin lam du gang zhig snyan 'jebs ldan min gcig mthun yin mi srid/rgyu mtshan de lta na snyan ngag dang gzhas tshig gi mtshan nyid dang / byed nus kyang cha 'dra ba red/ 'on kyang deng char gzhas tshig la snyan ngag lta bu'i gdan thob med kyang kho ba'i myong ba ltar na gzhas tshig ni snyan ngag las kyang 'bri dka' bar mngon/ gang lags she na/ spyir bod kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag ni/ gzhan gyis go ba len thub min la bsam gzhigs de tsam mi byed la ring 78
thung yang rang 'dod ltar 'bri chog pa dang / mngon brjod dang brda rnying ji ltar sbyar yang choggzhas tshig ni de 'dra ma yin par snyan po dgos la go bde po'ang dgos pa dang / don zab mo dgos la tshig thung thung yang dgos pa zhig yin pas snyan ngag mkhan po phal mo ches gzhas tshig 'bri rgyu ni las sla po rang min pa'i ngos 'dzin gnang gi yod/des na ga 'as tshig 'bri mkhan ni tshor ba rno po zhig dgos pa dang / rgya khyon khru gang gi nang du dpa' rtsal ngoms thub pa zhig dgos te/ tshig thung thung zhig gi nang nas brjod par 'dod pa'i gzugs brnyan gcig gam/mdzes nyams gcig yang na bsngags brjod gcig gam/ yul ljongs gcig bsam blo gsar pa gcig gam/ brtse gdung gcig yang na re smon gcig sogs gsal por brjod thub pa byas te tshig thung yang bcu go gcig chod dang /ring ba las rnam par rgyal ba/ tshig 'bru re res za 'phrug langs sa de rang la 'phur 'phur bya thub pa byed dgos/ der brten mig sngar bod yig la snyan gzhung cha tshang zhig yod kyang phul byung gi ga 'as tshig mang po thon mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan la rang re tshang mas thun mong thog bsam blo mi gtong ka med red/'on kyang phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na snyan ngag dang gzhas tshig dbar sha khrag lta bu'i 'brel ba yod pa ste/phul byung gi gzhas tshig la snyan ngag gi rgyan med pa mi srid cing / lhag par du dpe rgyan dang / gzugs rgyan/ rab btags rgyan/ gsal byed rgyan sogs de bas bed spyod mang bar mngon/ dper na/ nye dus kho bos bris pa'i 〈sa mtho'i mu tig go yar 'brog g.yu mtsho 〉zhes pa'i brnyan 'phrin nang ༷ 79
gi gtso gtong glu'i gzhas tshig dum bu dang por/'dzam gling yang rtse'i rgya phebs/ /bsil ljongs chos ldan zhing khams/ /gangs ri dngul gyi mchod rten/ /gtsang chu g.yu 'brug sngon mo/ /zhes par gzugs rgyan rkyang pa bed spyod byas yod pas de snyan ngag gi dper brjod du bkod kyang shin tu 'os so snyam/ 'on kyang kho bos gzhas tshig ge dgos mkho'am cha rkyen ltar gzhas tshig 'di'i nang go dka' ba'i mngon brjod dang / khyab chung ba'i dpe gcig kyang bkod med pa de rgyun gtan gzhas tshig 'bri mkhan rnam pas ma gtogs do snang yong khrag tsam red/dper na/ gong gsal gzhas tshig sho lo ka de'i tshig rkang dang por/ 66'dzam gling yang rtse'i rgya phebs ha zhes pho brang gi yang rtse rgya phibs yin pa kun gyis mkhyen gsal yin pas bod ljongs 'di bzhin 'dzam gling gi rgya phebs yin pa'i gzugs su bkod pa dang / tshig rkang gnyis par 88 bsil ljongs chos ldan zhing khams ha zhes dpe gzugs gang yang ma sbyar bar bsil ljongs zhes pa'i mngon brjod bo bza cing khyab che ba zhig sbyar ba dang / chos ldan zhing kham sa zhes pa'i tha snyad spyad de bod ljongs 'di nyid nang pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i yul gru zhig yin pa bstan pa dang / thing khams de na gnas pa'i mi rnams ni gshis rgyud bzang zhing / byams dang snying rje ldan pa sogs shugs las bstan/ tshig rkang gsum par 88 gangs ri dngul gyi mchod rten ha zhes gangs ri ni dkar po yin pas dngul dang mdog mtshungs pa dang / gangs ri'i dbyibs mchod rten gyi gzugs su bkod na dpe don 80
mtshams la dngul gyi mchod rten zhes pa'i tha snyad kun gyis go bde ba dang /da dung tshig rkang bzhi par 66 gtsang chu g.yu 'brug sngon mo nya zhes gangs ri bzhur ba'i chu rgyun ni kha dog sngo zhing dwangs la skabs re kha thug dang skabs re kyag kyog gis rgyugs kyi yod pas chu mo de g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i gzugs su bkod nas kha dog dang ku zugs gnyis ka mthun pa'am mtshon par byas pa lta bu'o/ de bzhin phul byung gi gzhas tshig mang po'i nang dpe rgyan dang /gsal byed rgyan sogs shin tu mang yang tshang ma go bde zhing rna bar 'jebs pa'i rtsa don las 'gal ba med/gang ltar snyan ngag dang gzhas tshig dbar la 'gal ba med kyang gzhas tshig 'bri dus nges par du kha gsal po dang / dpe go bde ba/ tshig sbyor spu gra snyoms pa/ tshig thung yang don tsho po dang / gson nyams dod po dgos pa ni ma mthar yang dgos pa'i cha rkyen yin/ der ma zad snyan ngag 'bri dus dmigs bsal nyung shas phud/ de min dper brjod dam snyan rtsom gang 'ig gi skabs su'ang tha snyad dang tshig phrad sogs zlos skyon la do snang byed pa las sgra gdangs sam skye gnas la bsam blo zhib phra rang gtong mi dgos kyang gzhas tshig 'bri dus ha cang gzab nan ma byas na gzhas gtong dka' la/ snyan cha mi thon zhing / don yang mi gsal ba ni snyan ngag gi skabs su skyon du mi 'gro ba'am skyon chung ngu yin yang gzhas tshig ge skabs su skyon ha cang chen par gyur gyi yod/mdor na snyan ngag dang gzhas tshig gnyis sngar nas da bar 'brel ba shin tu che la phyis kyang 'brel ba chad med du gnas nges yin pas rang cag gzhas tshig rtsom pa po tshang mas gcig nas snyang ngag gi shes bya'am gzhung 81
lugs slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug bya rgyu shin tu gal che zhing / gnyis nas mtha' gcig tu srol rgyun snyan ngag gi shul du ma rgyugs par deng rabs ga 'as tshig gsar rtsom gyi shes bya gsar par slob sbyong bya rgyu ni de bas gal chen 'ig red snyam mo/ /gser sbrang g.yu sbrang pad ma'i tshal la dga'/ /nya chung gser mig dwangs gtsang mtsho mor dga'/ /bu mo gzhon nu mdzes pa'i rgyan la dga'/ /bdag ni nam yang 'dod pa'i glu la dga'/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs su bzhad gad slong ba'i tshigs bcad do/ / gnyis pa/ sna mang phun sum tshogs pa'i dmangs khrod gzhas tshig gi skor/rang cag bod la 6 glu gar gyi rgya mtsho 〉 zhes pa'i mtshan snyan thob pa ni/rgad mo 'gram so na ba'i 'o 'dod min par rgyu mtshan don la gnas pa'i bden gtam zhig yin zhing / 'dir brtsam bya dngos kyi brjod don dang 'brel ba'i gzhas tshig kho na'i steng nas brjod na/ sna mang phun sum tshogs pa'i gangs ri'i ljongs kyi dmangs khrod brtsams chos ni/ grangs mang zhing / don sna 'dzoms pa/ tshig sbyor snyan zhing go bde ba/ sa mtho'i khyad chos 'bur du thon pa dang yongs khyab kyi rang bzhin ldan pa sogs dge mtshan 'bum gyis phyug pa zhig yin pas ngo ma mi rigs gzhan gyis do dka' ba zhig red/ der ma zad rtsom chos tshig de dag snga phyir bod kyi rgya che'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs tshos gral rim 'thab rtsod dang / thon skyed 'thab rtsod nang nas brtsams pa zhig yin pas bcos ma'i gzhas tshig 'gyig gi me tog lta bu ma yin par bod 82
mi dam/ngas kyi bsam blo'i 'du shes dang / goms pa'i gshis lugs/ chos dad/ gnyen sgrig thon skyed/ phugs bsam sogs kyi dri mngar rab tu 'thul ba'i pad ma dkar po dang yongs su mtshungs pa ste/ dmangs khrod gzhas tshig gi brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed tshig sbyor gnyis pa'i cha nas grags can gyi yig thog snyan ngag las dman pa gtan nas med pa de rig pa 'di la spyan dkyus ring ba'i mkhas dbang rnam pas mi mkhyen pa ga la srid kyang / gal po che la nan tan gyi dpe ltar 'dir tshig tog 'ga' zhig smra bar 'dod pa ste/gcig dmangs khrod gzhas tshig gi brjod bya'i don ni sna mang la/gnad du 'khol ba/ go bde zhing / bcos ma med pa/ sa mtho'i dmangs kyi sems khams ngam ngam shugs shugs kyis mtshon pa 'ig yin pa ni/ dper na/dmangs ga 'as /bu mo lo na chung chung / /gtan grogs mi rgan rgya'u/ /las la bskos pa ma red/ /rgya'u sa dbang yod btang byung / /zhes pa lta bu ni rang nyid kyi tshe 'di'i 'dun ma'i thad la rang dbang med par btsan po dbang yod kyi chag sgo byung tshul skyo glur blangs nas btsan shed kyis gnyen sgrig byed par ngo rgol dang / gnyen sgrig rang dbang dgos pa'i re 'bod shugs chen byas pa zhig yin pa dang /yang /dang po ka kha slob dus/ / 83
dka' las de la song na/ /gzhon pa'i snag bum smyu gu /sa la bzhag pa phangs song /zhes pa ni thog mar ka kha nas 'go btsugs te yun ring 'bad brtson chen pos slob sbyong byed myong ba'i gzhon nu pho mo gang rung zhig phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen ga ge mo zhig gi bar chad kyis rig gnas sbyang rgyu'i las skal chad stabs sems gting nas 'gyod pa tshad med skye ba'i bsam tshul ji ma ji bzhin glu ru blangs pa de ni slob gso'i rang bzhin ches ldan pa zhig yin la dus da lta'ang spyi tshogs thog gnas tshul 'di 'dra ha cang mang po yod pas dmangs gzhas de'i brjod don ni/ mkhas pa'i legs bshad bzhin du slob gso'i nus pa ldan pa dang / rtsom pa po'i snyan ngag bzhin du 'tsho ba gson po mtshon pa/tshul gsum tshad ma bzhin du rjes dpag gi nus pa ldan pa bcas yin par 'khums/de bzhin/a lcag lha mo lha red/ /lha mo'i thug pa chu red/ /rgya nag shel sgo mi dgos/ /thug pa'i nang nas gzigs dang / /ces pa'i dmangs gzhas de ni gzhan la ched du bzhad gad slong ba'i ched du ma yin par a lce lha mo'i 'tsho ba'i thad dka' ngal che bas btung bya'i thug pa de'ang chu dang shel bzhin shin tu sla bar bshad nas dka' sdug tshad med myong tshul gsal por bstan yod/ 84
yang 'jam po'i bal gyi bzos pa'i/ /kur rdo phyed mig dgu sgril/ / (chu mig)chu mig gdong nas brgyab pas/ /dbyin ji'i sna la thebs song / /zhes pa las/ dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis rang re'i bod ljongs la 'dre lag brkyangs te btsan 'dzul thengs mang byas par bod mi dmangs kyis dpa' ngar chen pos rang srung rgol lan slog pa'i dpa' stobs mtshon yod/yang /lo mang sgug pa'i snying gtam/ /nyi ma de ring bshad byung / /nam mkha'i bla ma dkon mchog /gnyid lam min pa shog cig /ces pa ni/ gzhon nu zhig gis rang sems rbad de shor ba'i mdzes ma zhig don du gnyer ba'i phyir ci tsam 'bad par byas shing / yun ring re ba don du ma smin yang yid thang mi chad par mu mthud mdzes ma de kho na las gzhan rmi lam nang du'ang med par ngang sgug byed bzhin pa'i skabs der mdzes mas 66da ni khyed kyi re ba ltar nga gnyis mdza' gcugs byed par dam bca'o gzhes pa'i bka' mol mngar mo sbra nga rtsi 'dra ba de rna ba'i bu gar lhung rjes (6a tsi 'di ni rmi lam ma yin nam/ dngos gnas yin na de 'dra'i dga' ba la/ nam mkha'i bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen no/ rmi lam min pa shog 85
wa wacig ga ces khrag dron tsha po rlangs pa 'phyur ba'i rang sems dga' bas myos pa'i skad cha mtha' dag gzhas tshig dum bu de'i nang nas mtshon pa ni ji 'dra'i gson nyams ldan pa zhig mi 'dug gam/da dung /a lcag ster bzo dod po/ /mi la g.yar ba'i rgyan cha/ /skra dang skra shubs ma gtogs/ /mi la sprod rgyu red 'dug /lta bu dma' 'bebs dang /dgon pa smin grol gling gi /rtse mo yar 'a gzigs dang / /rtse mo thug dang rgyal mtshan/ /g.yon gyis 'gran zla mi thub/ /lta bu bstod bsngags dang /sarba ta tha ga ta/ /bu mo'i lus la 'khor bzhag /rdo rdze dril bu btsongs nas/ /skye gos 'thag rogs gnang dang / /lta bu bzhad gad dang /brag la brdung ka rgyag par/ /lcags kyi rwa co dgos kyis/ /khyed kyi ra mgo lug mgos/ / 86
brdung ka yong sa ma red/ /lta bu dpa' stobs dang /ra sgreng sprul sku'i yang srid/ /rmi la ma nang la rmis pas/ /lha lcam pad ma lags kyi/ /rkub la du dregs chas/sa bzhag /lta bu zur za dang / ('di lha sa'i gzhas tshig de dang cung zad mi 'dra )rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga/ /rgyal sras 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ /gsol ba bod nas btab pas/ /thugs rje rgya nas gnang byung / /lta bu chos dad la sogs brjod don ji 'dra zhig yin na'ang dmangs gzhas kyi gzhas tshig nang med pa ha lam med do/ /gnyis / dmangs khrod gzhas tshig gi brjod byed tshig sbyor ni brjod pa bde la rna bar 'jebs pa/ snyan ngag gi rgyan phun sum tshogs pos smras pa zhig yin pa ni/ dper na/brgyab pa'i mu tig 'tshem bu/ /'grol ba gnang nas gang yong / /mi 'byar rdo la pin sbyar/ / (spyin)sbyar pa gnang nas gang yong / /tshes pa de'i nang mdza' gcugs phan tshun gnyis mos brtse dung bral mi bzod pa la na mu tig 'tshem bu nya zhes pa'i tha snyad snyan zhing go bde ba de sbyar/87
de gzhan gyis btsan pos bkag nas blo 'dod med pa'i mi dang u tshugs kyis gnyen sgrig byed du 'jug tsis byed pa de la 66rdo la spyin sbyar nya zhes dmangs khrod kha rgyun du gnas pa'i mi mthun mthun sgrig byed mkhan mtshon pa'i dpe'am tha snyad sbyar bas gong gsal gzhas tshig de ni rna bar snyan la don zab cing go bde la bod skad kyi thun min khyad chos mtshon pa zhig byung ba dang /yang /phar la mig gcig bltas pas/ /tshur la spyan gcig gzigs byung / /spyan mig gnyis po'i bar la/ /las 'phro'i mdud pa thebs song / /zhes pa de'i nang 64phar la mig lnga dang / 66tshur la spyan 9 zhes zhe tshig spyad pa des gcig nas zlos skyon bkag pa dang / gnyis nas gus zhabs mtshon pa/ gsum nas brtse dung gson po mtshon pa ste/ phar la dga' ba'i mig bltas pa'i lan du tshur la'ang dga' ba'am mos pa'i spyan gzigs pas mig dang spyan gyi bar la las 'phro'i mdud pa dam du thebs song zhes tshad brgal gyi ngo bstod ma yin la go dka' ba'i tha snyad kyang ma spyad rung gang ltar don gyi snying po phan tshun mig gi mdangs las brtse dung mtshon pa ni gna' snga mo nas da lta'i bar na gzhon pho mo'i brtse dung mtshon thabs gtso bo de yin pas gzhas tshig de ni brtse dung gi chos nyid dang mthun zhing / mkhregs tshig ma yin la kha skad phal pa'ang ma yin la kha skad phal pa'ang ma yin pa'i khya da ’chos 'bur du thon 'dugde bzhin rgyan gyi steng nas bshad kyang snyan ngag mkhan pos ched du rgyan 88
sbyar ba dang yongs su mtshungs pa ha cang mang po yod pa ni/dper na/dgung bsangs mthon po gser gyi gzhong pa 'dra/ /drin can nyi ma g.yu yi phra rgyan bzhin/ /lta bu dpe rgyan dang /sems la kham sdong bsam byung / /las la me tog bkod song / /'bras bu ma smin bar du/ /sad dang ser ba ma gtong / /lta bu gzugs rgyan dang /stod sgur thog khar ma 'gro zhig /thog kha'i steng nas mchongs mkhan 'dra/ /lta bu bzhad gad kyi nyams dang /nyi ma shar ba'i dang po/ /brag stod yar la shar song / /nga ni brag ri ya gi'i/ /rgod po yin na dga' ba/ /lta bu skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan dang /bdag gi chung 'dris byams pa/ /rdza ri'i 'og gi chu red/ /chu sgra sim sim ma gtogs/ /chu rgyun mthong rgyu mi 'dug / 89
mkhas grub kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod bdam sa sgrigwa wa ge—wa walta bu chos can 'bog pa'i rgyan dang /bltas bltas blta sa pa'i la mo/ /nyag nyag nyag la phyin song / /sgug sgug sgug pa'i chung 'dris/ /phebs mkhan gtan nas mi 'dug /lta bu sgra rgyan dang /sha yi khug ma'i nang nas/ /rtsam rlung lha nga lha nga ldang byung / /lus med dri mas khengs song / /shangs la thugs lcag gnang shog /lta bu gab tshig gi rgyan dang /lho phyogs sprin pa nag po/ /brgyab pa'i lhan pa ma red/ /nyi ma sprin pa'i 'og nas/ /dwangs pa'i dus gcig shar yong / /lta bu re ba dang bcas pa'i dga' ba'i rgyan dang /ri bo 'dra ba'i grong sde dang / /me tog 'dra ba'i mi dam/ngas dang / /gser bzang 'dra ba'i lo tog gsum/ /sa dog mo'i steng gi bzang gsum red/ /lta bu mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan dang / ( 'di dung dkar rin po ches rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan du bzhed ) 90
ya gi'i dgung bas ngas phyogs la/ /ga 'as gcig rgyag gar phyin pas/ /dgung bsangs drin can nyi mas/ /yar la shog dang gsungs kyis/ /yar la phyin pa'i dus su/ /drin can nub la thad song / /dgung bsangs drin can gnyis po/ /zhal rtsod byor ba min nam/ /lta bu rab rtog gi rgyan sogs shin tu mang bas snyan gzhung 〈me long 〉'chad 'khrid byed dus dper brjod gsar pa mi rnyed pa'i sems khral byed mi dgos/gsum pa/ dmangs khrod gzhag tshig dang gsar rtsom gzhag tshig dbar gyi 'brel ba'i skor/kho bo'i bsam par phun sum tshogs pa'i dmangs khrod kyi gzhas tshig de dag ni gzhas tshig gsar rtsom rtsom pa po rnams la drin du che ba'i dge rgan chen mo zhig dang mtshungs pa'am/ yang na gsar rtsom gzhas tshig gzhal med khang bzang bzhengs pa'i rtsig rmang lta bur 'dod/ de ltar mi 'dod na mar dang rtsam pa'i ri bro ba yo da pa'i ga 'as tshig cig yong bar ha cang dka'/ ngas tshod dpag byas pa nor med na tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho mchog sis mdzad pa'i grags can gyi mgur glu de dag gi rmang ga'i 'ang dmangs khrod kyi gzhas tshig yin bzo 'dug rgyu mtshan ni/ dper na/ dmangs ga 'as/ 91
'phyongs rgyas nub ma'i nub chu/ /yar lha sham po'i sham chu/ /'khrungs sa 'khrungs yul mi gcig /'dzoms sa sne gdong zam pa/ /zhes pa pa/mgur glu/rgya gar shar gyi rma bya/ /kong yul mthil gyi ne tso/ /'khrungs sa 'khrungs yul mi gcig /'dzoms sa chos 'khor lha sa/ /zhes pa gnyis kyi brjod bya'i don gcig mtshungs yin pa dang / rjod byed tshig gi dpe sbyar stangs mi 'dra ba la brtags par bya rgyu 'di yod de/64'phyongs rgyas nub ma'i nub chu zhes pa'i dmangs gzhas de'i nang 66'phyongs rgyas nub ma'i nub chu nya dang 66yar lha sham po'i sham chu ha gnyis dpe'am gzugs su bkod pa dang / 'dzoms sa'ang ((sne gdong zam pa lta zhes zer ba de'i thog nas dmangs gzhas 'di thog mar yar klung khul nas byung ba zhig yin pa lam tsam shes thub pa dang / gzhan yang dmangs khrod gzhas tshig gi rtsom pa po phal mo che yi ge mi shes pa yin pas kho tshos sbyar ba'i dpe ni rang gi thag nye sar dngos su mthong rgyu yong pa'am/ 'tsho ba'i nang dngos su byung ba'am/ rgyun gtan ngag la 'jags pa sha stag yin pa bltas pa tsam gyis shes thub la de ni dmangs khrod gzhas tshig gi thun min khyad chos kyang yin/ 92
tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho mchog gi mgur glu/ 44rgya gar shar gyi rma bya lta zhes pa'i nang / 66rgya gar gyi rma bya 9 dang 66kong yul gyi ne tso ha gnyis dpe'am gzugs su bkod pa dang / 'dzoms sa'ang 66chos 'khor lha sa nya zhes gsal ba ni mgur glu de snyan ngag mkhan pos ched du brtsams pa zhig yin pas dpe yang rgya che ba'am/ 'ud che ba dang / rtsom pa po mchog bod kyi rig gnas dang dpal 'byor sogs kyi lte gnas lha sar bzhugs pas khor yug gis bag chags zab mo thebs pa yin nam snyam/'on kyang dpe mi 'dra ba tsam las don ni gong zhus ltar phyogs gang nas go ba blangs kyang gnyis su mi snang /da dung / dmangs gzhas/ las 'phro yod dus zhus yod/ las 'phro med par gang byas/ las 'phro khab dang skud pas/ 'tshem bu rgyag thabs mi 'dug ces pa dang /mgur glu/me tog nam zla yal song / /g.yu sbrang sems pa ma skyo/ /byams pa'i las 'phro zad par/ /nga ni skyo rgyu mi 'dug /ces pa gnyis shin tu 'dra ba sogs dpe mang po 'dren rgyu yod pa de'i thog nas mkhas dbang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos kyang 'dzad mtha' med pa'i dmangs khrod kyi gzhas tshig las snying bcud len gnang mdzad pa shes thub/de brten skabs de dus nas dmangs khrod gzhas tshig dang gsar rtsom gzhas tshig dbar 'brel ba chen po yod ces bshad chog pa 'dug 93
khyad par du deng dus kyi gzhas tshig rtsom pa po rnams kyis dmangs kod gzhas tshig gi thun min khyad chos sogs gang sa ra slob sbyong dang / zhib 'jug gnang nas phul du byung ba'i gzhas tshig mang po zhig gsar rtsom gnang ba de tshor mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang / dus rabs kyi nyams 'gyur gnyis ka ldan yod kyang khong rnam pas gsar rtsom gnang dus dmangs khrod kyi gzhas tshig dang 'brel ba ji ltar gnang yod med sogs ri mor 'god pa'i spobs pa bdag la med pas 'dir kho bo rang nyid kyis gzhas tshig gsar rtsom byas pa'i nang dmangs khrod ga 'as tshig dang 'brel ba ji ltar byas tshul gyi myong ba re gnyis zhus na/kho bos tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho mchog gis mdzad pa'i mgur glu'i rtsom gshis ltar 〈mdza' glu 'dod pa'i lcags klu 〉 zhes pa zhig brtsams shing /de'i nang nas mi nyung ba zhig la ga 'as gdangs rtsom pa po rnam pas gdangs brtsams nas dbyangs su gyer dang gyer bzhin lags/kho bos 'dir dpe 'ga' zhig drangs na/ glu gzhas 〈 skad cig gi 'ja' tshon 〉zhes pa de'i nang gi gzhas tshig dum bu gcig ste/mdzes pa'i skar ma smin drug /'dzin 'dod blo la yod kyang / /gnam la skas 'dzeg 'dzugs pa'i/ /thabs shes nga la mi 'dug /ces pa de rtsom dus/ kho bos sngon la dmangs khrod kyi gzhas tshiggnam dang sprin pa'i gseb la/ /rgya gar gser gyi mchod rten/ / 94
skor ba bsags 'dod 'dug kyang / /lam yul sprin pas bsgribs song / /zhes pa de rmang gzhir bzung / de nas gom pa gang mdun du spos te dmangs gzhas nang gi 64gser gyi mchod rten la skor ba bsags 'dod yod pa de lta 66skar ma smin drug 'dzin 'dod yod lta ces 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gnas su spar/de bzhin 88skar ma smin drug nya dang / 64skas 'dzeg 9 ces pa'i go bde ba'i yongs khyab kyi tha snyad thabs mkhas pos sbyar ba dang / skar ma smin drug 'dzin 'dod yod pa dang / gnam la skas 'dzeg 'dzugs thabs med pa de gtan tshig dang mthun par bkod nas rtsom pa po'i dung 'en yig 'bru re re'i bar nas lhog lhog 'phyur ba'i sgyu rtsal la brten nas thog mar glu gzhas gtong mkhan gyi sems la'ang g.yo 'gul thebs su bcug pa'am skyo shas dbang med du skye ba'i thabs la 'bad pas re ba ji bzhin don du 'khyol nas rtsom pa po'i dung zhen zab mo rdo lag 'khyud byas pa ltar rgya che'i ltad mo ba'i phyag tu 'byor bas glu gzhas de mgyogs nas myur du rgya che'i zhing 'brog sa khul du sa khyab rdo khyab tu dar thub pa byung song /ma gzhi de ni gzhas gdangs rtsom mkhan dang lhan du thob pa'i 'bras bu zhig yin rung 'dir gzhas gdangs skor skabs su ma babs pas rgyas par mi spro/ de bzhin dmangs gzhas/chung 'dris byams pa'i thog la/ /sdug po phyi sdug nang sdug /phyi sdug sngon gyi las red/ /
nang sdug gtong ba ma gnang / /zhes pa sogs kyi khyad chos dang mthun pa'i gsar rtsom gzhas tshig 〈brtse dung gi rnyog dra 〉zhes pa'i nang gi dum bu gcig ste/blo 'dod byams pa 'tshol bar/ /pha mas bka' bkyon ma gnang / /pha ma dgung lo chung dus/ /thugs la dran pa gnang dang / / ’zhes pa'i brjod don rtsa ba'i cha nas mtshungs pa yin/ 'on kyang gong gsal gsar rtsom gzhas tshig de dag nang dmangs khrod gzhas tshig gi khyad chos dam bzung byas pa las 'dra bshus byas pa zhig gtan nas min la sgyu rtsal dang brjod don gnyis ku'i cha nas rin thang gong mthor btegs nas gsar rtsom gyi rang bzhin mngon gang thub byas yod pa dper na/ gong gi dmangs gzhas 66chung 'dris byams pa'i thog la ha zhes pa de'i brjod don gtso bo ni/rang gi 'dod blor yod pa'i chung 'dris byams pa de pha ma'i thugs la med pas bkag 'gog nan po gnang bar brten byams pa'i ched du phyi nang gang sar sdug po myong dgos byung stabs sdug skad shor ba ste/ 86kye pha ma mchog nga rang byams pa'i ched du sdug po phyi sdug myong dgos pa de sngon gyi las yin yang de'i steng du sdug po nang sdug ma gtong bar mdzod/ sku mkhyen : zhes pa tsam las bsam gzhigs byed dgos pa'i don rgya che ba gang yang med/'on kyang kho bo'i gzhas tshigblo 'dod byams pa 'tshol bar/ /pha mas bka' bkyon ma gnang / /༷ 96
pha ma dgung lo chung dus/ /thugs la dran pa gnang dang / /zhes pa'i nang gi tshig rkang dang po dang gnyis pa ni gong gi dmangs gzhas kyi brjod don dang 'dra bar 66rang gi blo 'dod yod pa'i chung 'dris byams pa 'tshol ba la pha mas bka' bkyon ma gnang rogs 〉zhes zhu ba 'then pa'am re 'bod byas pa dang / 9tshig rkang gsum pa dang bzhi par 66pha ma gnyis kyang dgung lo chung dus rang gi blo 'dod yod pa'i chung 'dris byams pa'i ched du 'bad pa ji tsam gnang ba dang / lhad med kyi brtse gdung don du ji tsam ngal ba spyad pa/ 'dod pa'i brtse dung gi me tog la mi 'dod sad ser gyi bar chad ji tsam byung ba sogs thugs la dran pa gnang dgos pa ste/ dran gso zhig gnang na/ bdag gi brtse dung 'di yang dwangs gtsang dang / lugs mthun gyi brtse dung zhig yin pa mkhyen thub la/ nga'i brtse dung la bkag 'gog gnang na sems la ngal ba ji 'dra yod min yang mkhyen thub ces rgyu mtshan dang bcas brjod pa de ni go shes can gyi pha ma zhig yin na pha ma'i mdun du pus mo btsugs nas ngus pa las nus pa ldab kha shas kyis che ba zhig thon par gdon mi za/des na dmangs khrod gzhas tshig gi khyad chos dang / nyams 'gyur/ tha snyad sogs la slob sbyong ma byas na mi 'grig la/ sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur dang /brjod bya'i don snying sogs tshad mtho ru ma btang na de bas mi 'grig snyam mo/de bzhin dmangs khrod sgor gzhas kyi gzhas tshigshar la ri bzang ri bo'i rtse mo ru/ /rtse mo yi la sprin pa'i dbu zhwa bzhes/ / 97
sked pa kha la ba lu'i sham thabs dkris/ /rtsa ba mar la chu mos g.yas slor brgyab/ /de la gser bya ngang pas g.yon skor brgyab/ /zhes pa rmang gzhir byas pa'i gsar rtsom gzhas tshigshang shang yar lha sham chu'i shar phyogs su/ /bzad chags yid 'ong rtsed thang mgon po ri/ /dngul gyi mchod rten 'dra ba'i bang rim la/ /nyi gzhon 'phros pas 'od zer ltam lham 'bar/ /rtse mor rang byung spre'u brag phug mdzes/ /sked par rab mdzes sprin gyi ska rags bcings/ /rtsa ba sngo ljang spang gi khri la bzhugs/ /phyogs bzhi mdzes pa'i grong gis yongs su bskor/ /zhes pa lta bu dang / yang dmangs gzhas/tshig khobs g.yu phra'i mda' bskongs/ /mdzu gu btsir ba ma gnang / /mdzu gu de la ran pa'i/ /mdzub rgyan las kyis 'khor yong / /zhes pa rmang gzhir byas pa'i gsar rtsom gzhas tshig 〈rnam shes yal ba'i tshig khebs 〉 zhes pa sogs gang ltar kho bo'i myong ba ltar na dmangs khrod gzhas tshig dang gsar rtsom gzhas tshig dbar phan tshun bral thabs med pa'i 'brel ba ha cang zab mo zhig yod la yod dgos nges kyang yin par mthong 98
ngo / /dmangs khrod rtsom rig sa chur mi brten par/ /gzhan gyi lad mo brag ca'i spun zla bzhin/ /mkhas rlom gsar rtsom nam mkha'i me tog la/ /mi rigs khyad chos zer ba yod re skan/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs su ngal gso ba'i tshigs bcad do/ /bzhi pa/ dus rabs dang mthun zhing 'dzam gling la kha phyogs te phul byung gi gzhag tshig gsar rtsom byed dgos pa'i skor/de yang gong du zhus pa de dag ni bod yig gzhas tshig gi lo rgyus dang / 'phel rim/ de bzhin rang nyid ngo mas da phan gzhas tshig gsar rtsom gyi bya bar zhugs pa'i myong ba tsam yin pa las da lta'i char gzhas tshig gsar rtsom gyi re ba ni gong gsal dang gtan nas mi 'dra bar dus rabs dang mthun zhing /'dzam gling la kha phyogs pa'i chu tshad dgos te/ mkhas dbang he thu man gyis 66'dzam gling gsar pa dang / dus rabs gsar pa/ mi rigs gsar pa dang thug na/ de dang dus mtshungs su lce dbang gsar pa zhig los dgos/99 zhes gsungs pa ltar/ deng 'dir gzhas tshig tshud pa'i 'dzam gling rtsom rig gis nga tsho bod kyi rtsom rig la bar stong chen po zhig bzos nas bskyur te yod pa ni don dngos shig yin pa khas mi len ka med red na/ nga tshos rig pa bsgrims te bar stong de gsab pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa las rang nyid kyi mos pa kho na dang / 'dod blo khengs nas bsdad na de bas rjes su lus rgyu yin pa smos ci/ 99
des na sngon chad kho bos bsam blo nyal langs sgur gsum btang mthar gzhas tshig gsar rtsom thad yin min cha ma 'tshal ba'i dran 'char 'ga' zhig byung ba 'dir gros mol gyi tshul du bkod par bya ste/gcig mig sngar bod yig gzhas yig rtsom pa po mang po zhig la srol rgyun snyan ngag rtsom srol gyi bag chags zab mo yod pas de'i shan zhugs te gzhas tshig 'bri dus phyi ngos kyi yul la yid gzab byed pa las nang ngos yul can gyi brtse dung ngam tshor 'du (tsho ṣṭha)gson 'bri byed rgyur zhan cha zhig rgyun 'jags su gnas yod/de yang 66yul lta zhes pa ni gzhas tshig rtsom pa pos brjod par 'dod pa'i phyi rol gyi yul ljongs sam brjod bya gang zhig la tshig sbyor dang rgyan gyis spras pa de la zer/ dper na gzhas tshig rtsom pa po zhig gis 〈sa mtho'i dgun kha 〉zhes pa'i gzhas tshig dum bu gcig ste/smin drug zla ba'i tshes pa gsar du shar/ /dwangs bsil chu bo g.yang ṭa'i khang par nyal/ /lhab lhub kha ba'i me tog dkar po yis/ /:yangs pa'i nor 'dzin dpal mor mdzes rgyan spras/ /zhes bris par dpe bzhag na/ de'i (6yul lta ni bod ljongs kyi dgun kha yin zhing / 66yul 9 de la rtsom pa pos tshar du dngar ba'i tshig rgyan spyad nas bsngags brjod byas yod la bsngags brjod de ni snyan ngag mkhan pos dpyid dbyar ston gsum la gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis bsngags pa las ldab kyis legs pa yod/ 'on kyang bsngags brjod de'i nang yul can ( rtsom pa po )rang nyid kyi bsam pa'i brtse dung ngam chags sdang sogs zung tsam yang mtshon ༷ 100
thub med/des na gong gsal gzhas tshig dum bu de'i nang gi tshig sbyor snyan zhing 'jibs pa dang / dpe don spyin gyis sbyar ba bzhin 'brel chags pa/ bsil dus kyi rnam pa ji ma ji bzhin ri mo'i lam nas gsal thub pa sogs ni srol rgyun snyan ngag gi bka' drin la brten nas thob pa'i 'bras bu zhig yin pa dang / gzhas tshig dum bu de'i nang rtsom pa pos sa mtho'i dgun khar bcangs pa'i dung zhen spu tsam yang mngon rgyu med par gzhas tshig de 66 sha drod med pa'i mdzes ma 〉〉zhig tu gyur pa ni srol rgyun snyan ngag las 'gos pa'i na tsha zhig yin/gang lags she na/ srol rgyun snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs snyan gzhung 〈me long 〉'chad 'khrid byed skabs rgyan dang tshig sbyor kho na nan bshad byed pa las yul can gyi tshor 'du'am dung zhen 'bri bar skul slong mi byed cing / la las snyan ngag gi srog ces gal po cher bzung gin yod mod de'ang snyan ngag gi brjod bya'i don zab mo zhig dgos par go ba len pa las yul can gyi dung sems 'bri dgos par ngos 'dzin ha cang nyung /'o na yul can gyi dung sems zhes pa ci 'dra zhig la zer ram zhe na/'dir gong gi gzhas tshig 88sa mtho'i dgun kha ha zhes pa bskyar 'bri zhig byas na/bar snang dbyings su skyi bser rlung bu 'tshub/ /chu phran brel bas g.yang ṭi'i khang par nyal/ /ljong shing yal 'dab kha bas btums pa'i dus/ /bdag gi skyed ma bgres mo'i dbu skra dran/ /101
zhes pa lta bu la mtshon na/ sa mtho'i dgun gyi mdzes nyams sam khyad chos brjod pa tsam gyis mi tshad par da dung ljon shing gi yal 'dab kha bas btums nas dkar por gyur ba de mthong ba'i dus thag ring na bzhugs pa'i rang gi a ma bgres mo'i dbu skra dkar po de dran byung zhes yul can gyi dung sems brjod gzhi yul gyi steng nas ngam ngam shugs shugs kyis mtshon pa lta bu'o/ /ma gzhi gzhas tshig yod do cog nang rtsom pa po'i dung sems 'bri dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang / yul gyi ngos kho nar gzhol che drags nas ri mthong na ri rkyang pa dang / chu mthong na chu rkyang pa 'bri ba'i srol nas gom pa gang mdun du spo thub kyang de la dge mtshan gom pa gang yod snyam mo/ /gnyis/ da phan kho bo tshud pa'i gzhas tshig rtsom pa po mi nyung ba zhig gis rang gi brjod par 'dod pa'i brjod don de gzhas tshig nang rang gi lta ba ltar thag gcod rkyang byed kyi yod pas de'i 'bras bur gzhas tshig de legs bshad dam/ man ngag lta bu zhig la 'gyur gyi yod/yang 'ga' res gzhas tshig tshang ma 66klu brgya dbyangs gcig ga gis yar bstod na 'tshang kha shig shig gis bstod pa dang / mar kha ta slob gso byed na'ang hab thob shig shig rgyag pa de ni sgyu rtsal 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho dang ha cang mi 'tsham pa zhig red/des na skabs 'gar rgya che'i ltad mo ba rnams la'ang rang gis bris pa'i gzhas tshig der mnyam du bsam gzhigs bya rgyu'i go skabs shig sprod thub na gzhas tshig de'i nub pa de bas khyab che ru 'gro bar nges/dper na/102
mdzes pa'i gos la ral rgyu yod/ /rin chen rgyan char brlag rgyu yod/ /rin bral nor bu rig gnas red/ /sngon gyi dbyangs mkhan tshig la mkhas/ /da lta'i rnams ni dbyangs la sbyong / /phyi ma'i dus kyi dbyangs mkhan rnams/ /mi mkhas blo chung glu la dga'/ /ci yang med kyang 'tsher 'gyur snyam/ /de phyir rig gnas sbyong ba gal/ /zhes pa lta bu zhig bris na ma gzhi di'i nang don zab mo yod kyang skabs 'dir gzhas tshig yin pa las slob 'khrid min pas de la gzhas tshig sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ci yang mi snang ba dang /gal te/yid 'ong mdzes ldan lha mos/ /mu tig mgul rgyan btags pas/ /'od zer lham lham 'bar bzhin/ /kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog song / /dgongs pa bzhes dang mdzes ldan lha mo la gas/ /mu tig mgul rgyan nor bu yin nam min/ /rab mdzes stag shar gzhon pas/ / 103
gser gyi mdzub dkris bzhes pas/ /'od zer ltam lham 'bar bzhin/ /kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog song / /dgongs pa bzhes dang stag shar gzhon pa lags/ /gser gyi mdzub dkris nor bu yin nam min/ /zhes bris na der brjod don zab mo yod kyang thad 'bri ma byas par gzhan la bsam gzhigs bya rgyu'i dri tshig bkod yod pas gong ge gzhas tshig dang bsdur na sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang che cher ldan yod/mi rigs gzhan gyi gzhas tshig rtsom pa po mkhas pa tshos gzhas tshig gi rgyab ljongs yag po zhig 'bri rgyu'i thad nus pa gang yod 'don gyin yod/der brten nga tshos rgyal nang gi spun zla mi rigs tsho'i phul byung gzhas tshig 'bri stangs la slob sbyong bya dgos pa ma zad phyi'i rgyal khab gag gi phul byung gzhas tshig rtsom srol la slob sbyong byas kyang mi 'grig pa med de/ ji skad du/ sa paṇa gyis/dri zhim byung na ri dwags kyis/ /lte ba las kyang gla tsho len/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/gzhan du na/byung na zhes pa'i tshig la ma dpyad par/ /yod tshad blangs na gla rtsi ga la yin/ /zhes kyang zhar la brjod par bya'o/ /104
gsum/ deng char bod kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag la 66gnyen nye gsar pa 99rang mos snyan ngag ces pa zhig rnyed pa des snyan rtsom 'phel rgyas 'gro bar nas pa ha cang chen po thon dang thon mus lags na nga tsho'i srol rgyun gzhas tshig la'ang 66gnyen nye gsar pa ’ nyarang mos gzhas tshig cig rnyed na ci ma rung /a cang ku re zhus pa yin te/ nga tshos rang mos snyan ngag ltar tshig rkang dang tsheg bar gyi bkag rgya las thar ba'i gzhas tshig gsar rtsom byed pa'i thabs lam zhig btsal na rang cag bod yig gi gzhas tshig de bas kyang phun sum tshogs su 'gro nges yin/'on kyang bya ba gang zhig gsar du dar dus kyang der dka' ngal dang 'gal ba mang po 'phrad srid kyang bya ba der phan yod kyi rin thang ldan pa dang dus rabs kyi nyams 'gyur ldan na de rim bzhin dar khyab dang 'phel rgyas phyin nas ring min rgyun gtan can du 'gyur nges lags/'ga' zhig gi thugs la tsheg bar do mi mnyam pa ni snyan ngag gi sdeb sbyor nyams pa'i skyon yin pas de 'dra'i gzhas tshig bris na snyan po yong mi srid dgongs nges lags kyang tshod lta zhig byas par skyon e yod snyam/dper na/me tog gur khang gi dbus su/glog phreng 'ja' ltar bkra/zhal dkar sngo bsangs nang nas/rgun chang wu dkar gyi me tog bzhad/pho gzhon rnams dpa' stobs che la/ 105
mdzes ma rnams sku sked ldem/ngo mtshar cha 'grig dang cha 'grig gi zhabs bro/rbod po lding ba 'dra byung /zhes pa lta bu ni snyan zhing 'jibs pa'i gras su brtsi mi chog gam/'on kyang gang zhig la snyan zhing 'jibs pa zhes zer min shod dka' ste/yul gcig yin yang yul can so so'i snang ngor tha dad yin pa ni/ dper na/yul bud med ga 'on nu ma gcig la yul can pho gzhon mang po'i lta tshul mi 'dra ba mang du byung ba ni yul can gyi ngos nas yin pa la sa yul bud med gcig pu de rang yin pas mi 'dra ba med pa lta bu'o/ de ltar kho bos gang dran ri mor bkod pa 'di la 'gal 'khrul ci mchis 'brel yod/ mkhas dbang rnam pas bka' slob dang dgongs 'char gnang rgyu'i re ba snyim pa brang khar zum ste zhu'o/ /dpyad gzhi byed yul/(1) snyan ngag gsar rnying gi thog ma'i gshib bsdur/( bdud lha rgyal gyis mdzad)(2) bod kyi rgya'/ rabs skor/ (tun hong gi yig rigs)(3) tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed/ (dung dkar rin po ches mdzad)(4)lho kha'i yul glu pod dang po/ (dmangs khrod rtsom rig)(5) bod kyi dmangs gzhas skor rags tsam gleng ba/ (rdo rje dang thung cin hwas mdzad) 106
bod rigs kyi ming gi skor cung zad gleng ba/de yang rang cag bod gangs can pa'i ming 'dogs stangs la thun mong ma yin pa'i sa mtho'i khyad chos ldan yod pa dang / yun ring ba'i lo rgyus nang spyi tshogs kyi 'khor bskyod dang mthun par ming gi rnam grangs kyang rim bzhin 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ldog byung nas sna mang phun sum tshogs por gyur yod pa de dag ni gangs can rig gnas shes bya'i bye brag cig yin par bsnyon du med pas 'dir kho bos gsar bu rnams la ngo sprod kyi tshul du ming gi shes bya phran tshegs chu brgya zam 'dus kyi ri mor bkod pa la nang gses nyi shu ste/dang po/ rus ming dang sbyar nas ming 'dogs srol/sngar gyi dus su rang cag gangs can pa la'ang rus ming yod pa ni bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther khag las gsal por shes thub pa ste/ dper na/ 〈dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs 〉las (4bod mi'i rgyal khams su gyur te/ ye sang dkar po gnam gyi 'ju thig can dang gcig ye smon nag po khro chu'i pha wang 'dra ba dang gnyis/ spyan khrig ye shes lha'i sgron me dang gsu ma/ mon rdzu nag po khyi'i rnga ljang can dang bzhir dbyer ba byung ngo lta zhes thog ma'i rus chen bzhi yod par gsungs pa dang / da dung lo rgyus 'ga' zhig las 66'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung / stag lung gzi'i gdung / sa skya 'khon gyi gdung / chos rgyal bya'i gdung / 'od gsal lha'i gdung / sne'u gdong gong ma lha'i gdung dang drug 107
go zhes gsung yod pa ma zad tun hong yig rnying las byung ba'i bod btsan po'i dus skabs kyi bod kyi blon rabs rnams la'ang so so'i rus sam gdung rgyud gsal bar bris yod pa sogs mdor na thog mar rang cag bod rigs la rus chen bzhi 'am drug yod pa nas phyis yul ming rus la thogs pa sogs rim bzhin rus mang por 'phel te bod mi spyi dang / khyab par du sngon byon mkhas dbang rnam pa'i mtshan dngos kyi thog mar rus sbyar nas 'bod srol rgya khyab tu dar ba ni/ dper na/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ gnyags snyo na ku ma ra dza/ zur sha kya 'byung gnas/ myang ting 'dzin bzang po/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ glan ye shes 'bar/ ༷ lo tsa ba dge ba'i blo gros/ gnyos rgyal ba lha nang pa/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ bse ngag dbang bkra shis/ mchims nam mkha' 'brug grags/ lta bu'i mtshan dngos kyi gong du sbyar ba'i gnubs dang / gnyags/zur/ myang / 'khon/ 'gos/ rngog glan/ rma/ gnyos/ chag bse/mchims bcas ni rus ming yin par bsnyon du med pa dang / da dung rmu dang /lho/ 'dar/ khu/ 'bal/ thon/ 'bro/ gnyal/ mgar/ mdzeng /rngegs/ zhang / ldong / dbon/ dpyal/ dab 'as/ sga/ mong / khyung po/sna nam/ shud pu/ ngan lam/ 'o ma lde/ lta bu shin tu mang / 'on te dus da lta bod rigs kyi rus ming ha lam nges bzung med pas/ 'bod mkhan med kyang bar skabs shig na bod rigs blo mthun re gnyis kyis rang gi ming ngos kyi thog mar rgya rigs kyi rus ming sbyar nas/ krang zla ba/ li'i g.yu sgron/ ba'o chos ldan/ wang rnam rgyal sogs 'bod mkhan yang byung yod do/ /༷ 108
gnyis pa/ mtshan zur nas drag te ming 'dogs tshul/'di ni gtso bo bod kyi btsan po rim byung gi mtshan 'dogs srol zhig ste/dper na/ bod rgyal thog ma'i mtshan la gnya' khri btsan po zhes zhu bas de nas rim bzhin/ mu khri btsan po/ deng khri btsan po/ si khri btsan po/ mer khri btsan po/ gdags khri btsan po/ srib khri btsan po zhes gnya' khri btsan po'i mtshan gyi zur 66khri nya zhes pa dras nas btsan po bdun gyi mtshan la gsol bar yongs grags su gnam gyi khri bdun zer ba dang /de nas stod kyi steng gnyis 'das pa'i rjes/ ‘ na e sho legs/ha zhes pa'i mtshan gyi zur 66legs nya zhes pa de dras nas/ de sho legs/ thi sho legs/gong du legs/ 'brong zhir legs/ i sho legs bcas kyi mtshan du gsol bar bar gyi legs drug ces zer/de bzhin/ lde brgyad dang 'og gi btsan lnga dag kyang thog ma'i mtshan gyi zur dras nas rjes ma rnams la gsol ba las ma 'das so/dus da lta de 'dra'i ming 'dogs srol dngos su med kyang pha ma la las rang gi phru gur pha ma'i tshig zur dras nas ming 'dogs kyin yod pa de'i 'byung khungs kyang gong gi btsan po'i mtshan 'dogs stangs nas yin pa'am yang na de dang cha 'dra ba zhig red snyam mo/ /gsum pa/ che ba brjod pa'am bsngags brjod kyi mtshan 'dogs srol/de yang rang cag bod kyi lo rgyus thog gi rgyal blon nam bla sku che gras/yang na 'gran zla bral ba'i mkhas chen dam pa re gnyis la ched du de'i yon 109
tan gyi che ba brjod pa'am dad gus kyis bsngags pa brjod pa'i mtshan chen po 'dogs srol yod pa ni dper na/bod rgyal gser ri'i phreng ba'i dbus snyan pa 'brug ltar ldir zhing mdzad rjes nyi zla ltar gsal ba'i gnam ri srong btsan gyi sras la 66srong btsan sgam po ha zhes ched du gsol ba'i mtshan 'grel ni ji skad du/ 66rgyal po chen po mi'i lta'am yang na skye bo mi srun pa gdul dka' ba rnams lugs gnyis kyi srol bzang po'i lam du nan gyis srong zhing / mdza' ba dang mi mdza' ba dang bar ma rnams la thugs rab tu snyoms pa'i phyogs su ma lhung ba'i phyir shin tu drang ba'i bka' khrims btsan po'i gnas las mnga' 'og pa rnams 'da' ba'i skabs med pa dang / phyi nang gi bya ba'i gnas thams cad ma 'chol zhing 'khrugs pa med par dpyad gsum gyis gtan la 'bebs shing mdzangs par grags pa rnams kyis kyang dgongs pa'i gting dpog pa med pa'i phyir sgam po ste srong btsan sgam po zhes mtshan snyan par grags pa nyid skye dgu'i dpal du shar ro ga zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ de bzhin sa skya ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan rje rin po che/ kun mkhyen klong chen po/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ kurma dus gsum mkhyen pa sogs kyang dam pa tsho'i sku yon la dad pa'am che ba brjod pa'i mtshan kho nar mthong ngo / /bzhi pa/ rab tu byung rjes chos ming 'dogs tshul/bod gangs can ljongs kyi skye bo phal mo che chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan zhig yin pas rab tu byung ste dam pa'i chos sgor zhugs mkhan ha cang mang po yod pa smos ci/110
de dag tshang mar thog ma nas ming re yod kyang rab tu byung rjes grwa pa'am btsun ma su yin rung chos ming re nges par du zhu dgos pa ma zad skya 'gyur ba phud/ de byings tshang mar mi tshe bar chos ming kho na 'bod pa las spyir skya ming 'bod srol med/dper na/ yab 'dabs sha kya rdo rjes dang yum li mo le shes sgron gnyis kyi sras stag tshab 'bar rab tu byung rjes mtshan tshul khrims 'bar zhes gsol te phyis dge bshes spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar zhes yongs su grags/de ba'i na yab tshe ring dpal 'byor dang yum 'dzom chog gnyis kyi sras bkra shis don grub rab tu byung rjes mtshan blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho 'es gsol zhing / phyis yongs 'dzin gu ge ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho 'es bod khams yongs su snyan pa 'phur/ gzhan yang mnga' ris kyi lha btsun pa byang chub 'od rab tu ma byung gong gi mtshan la bkra shis 'od ces zhu ba dang /'bri gung pa/ skyabs pa 'jig rten mgon po'i mtshan la btsun pa skyabs zhu ba lta bu'o/ /da dung bod kyi lo rgyus thog byung ba'i sngon byon mkhas pa rab byung ba phal mo cher rab tu ma byung gong gi mtshan re yod kyang lo rgyus deb ther khrag nang de dag gi thog ma'i mtshan 'khod pa mang po rang med/'on kyang rab tu byung rjes chos ming gsol ba'i lugs de dus da lta'ang mi nyams par gnas mus yin pa ma zad de dag skya ma 'gyur na sku tshe bar chos ming kho na 'bod srol yod do/ /
lnga pa/ dgon pa'i ming dang sbyar nas ming 'bod srol/de snga'am yang na 'tsho bzhugs bla sprul grags che ba mi nyung ba zhig la khong rang nyid kyi chos lugs grub mtha'am dgon pa'i ming de mtshan gyi thog mar sbyar nas 'bod srol sngar nas da bar rgya khyab tu dar yod pa ni/ dper na/sa skya ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ zha lu chos skyong bzang po/rdzogs chen pad ma rig 'dzin/ snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pa/gser tog blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ kurma si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas/'phags pa lta dge legs rnam rgyal/ bsam sding rdo rje phag mo/tshe brtan zhabs drung / dmu dge bsam gtan/rdo rje brag rig 'dzin chen mo/ rgyal tshogs dpa' bo rin po che lta bu shin ru mang yang go sla bas thams cad kyi mtshan 'dren pa'i ngal ba ma byas so/ /drug pa/ khyim tshang gi ming dang sbyar nas ming 'bod srol/—bod rigs kyi ming khrod du rang gi ming dngos kyi gong du khyim tshang gi ming sbyar nas 'bod srol yod pa ni/ dper na/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/lta klu tshe dbang rdo rdze/ chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs/ lha smon bsod nams lhun grub/ thang smad dkon mchog pad mo/ bshad sgra dga' ldan dpal 'byor/ sle zur 'jigs med dbang phyug bkras mthong bsod nams lha mo/brag gdong tshe dbang lhun grub/ pe hor 'jigs med dbang po lta bu grags che 112
