ba'i khyim tshang gi mtho rim mi sna dang /da dung dmangs khrod du'ang rang so'i ming dngos kyi sngon du khyim ming sbyar nas 'bod srol yod pa ni/ dper na/ldum rwa khang gsar gyi rdo rje/ lha yag gi bstan 'phel/gling srung gi nor bu/ gad 'og gi tshul khrims sgrol ma/klu sding gi rin ldan/ lcang gseb kyi lha skyed lta bu shin tu mang ngo / /bdun pa/ yul ming dang sbyar nas ming 'bod srol/yang 'ga' zhig gi ming dngos kyi gong du sa so'i pha yul lam grong tsho'i ming sbyar nas 'bod srol yod pa ni dper na/ lho brag grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ gter ston grwa ba mngon shes rje tsong kha pa/ yar klung dung mtsho ras pa/ 'brug pa nam mkha' dpal bzang / bya yul ba sangs rgyas sgom pa/za ra ba skal ldan ye shes/ gra phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho/sde dge skal bzang dbang 'dus/ rnam sras gling 'phrin las tshe dbang /gnyal smad rig 'dzin dbang rgyal lta bu sngar nas da bar rgya khyab tu dar yod/brgyad pa/ go gnas dang sbyar nas ming 'bod srol/da dung 'ga' zhig gi ming ngo ma'i thog mar so so'i go gnas sbyar nas 'bod srol yod pa ni/ dper na/sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab ra sgreng /mda' dpon lha sding pa/ rtsis dpon lung shar/113
yong 'dzin blo bzang dpal ldan/ gsang ba nga phod/srid blon glang mdun/ bka' blon bla ma bstan pa'i 'jam dbyangs/tha'i ji bsam pho/ dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan/rtse 'gron thub bstan tshe ring / rtse dung mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin/dmag smo skal tshul/ mkhan chung dge 'dun ye shes/bsher dpang tshe brtan dbang phyug ru dpon bsod nams dbang chen/bka' tshab g.yu thog pa/ drung 'khor rdo rje dbang phyugmgron gnyer bstan 'dzin chos rgyal lta bu snga dus kyi go gnas ming dang /yang / rgya mtsho hru'u ci/ rdzong dpon dpal 'byor/ shang krang rnam rgyal/kru'u ren bsam grub/ rtsis pa bkra shis lta bu deng dus kyang 'bod mus yin tse(/ /dgu pa/ bu rkyang pa'i ming /bod rigs kyi ming khrod du bu rkyang pa'i ming dang / bu mo rkyang pa'i ming /pho mo gnyis 'jug gi ming bcas rtsa ba'i dbye ba gsum yod pa las/bu rkyang pa'i ming ni/ dper na/nor bu dgra 'dul/ dpal 'byor rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub/'jigs med rdo rje/ dga' ldan dpal 'byor/ dbang phyugrin chen phun tshogs/ dge legs/ stobs rgyal lta bu ni bu kho na las bu mor 'bod srol med do/ /bcu pa/ bu mo rkyang pa'i ming /bu mo kho na las bu'i ming la mi 'jug pa ni/ dper na/114
mkha' 'gro/ me tog sgrol ma/ lha mo/lha 'dzoms/ dbyangs skyid/ g.yang 'dzoms/ tshe dbyangs/gangs skyed/ g.yu sgrol/ lha skyed/ mtsho mo/ chos sgron/bsam skyid/ chos 'dzoms/ bde skyid/ sgrol dkar lta bu ches mang ngo / /bcu gcig pa/ pho mo gnyis 'jug gi ming /bu dang bu mo gnyis ga'i ming la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/tshe ring / bkra shis/ bsam gtan/ skal bzang /shes rab/ tshe brtan/ sangs rgyas/ skal ldan/dkon mchog don grub/ ngag dbang / ye shes/bsod nams/ chos ldan/ rig 'dzin/ nyi zla/'chi med/ rnam grol/ chung bdag lta bu'o/bcu gnyis pa/ res gza' gang skyes ltar brtags pa'i ming /pha ma mi nyung ba zhig gis rang ge phru gur ched du ming ma zhus par res gza' gang skyes ltar ming 'dogs kyi yod pa ste/nyi ma/ zla ba/ mig dmar/ lhag pa/phur bu/ pa sangs/ spen pa lta bu ni pho mo gnyis ga'i ming la 'jug pa yin/ 'on te res gza' de dag gi rjes su ming grogs sbyar na 'ga' zhig bu la 'jug pa dang / 'ga' zhig bu mor 'jug pa las gnyis ba'i ming la gtan nas mi 'jug go /115
bcu gsum pa/ res gza'i rjes ming grogs sbyar bas bu la 'jug pa/gong zhus ltar ma gzhi res gza' bdun po ni bu dang bu mo gnyis ku'i ming la 'jug kyang de dag gis rjes ming grogs sbyar na 'gyur ba yong gi yod pa ni/ dper na res gza'i bdun po'i rjes su ming grogs 66tshe ring ha zhes pa sbyar na bu'i ming la 'jug pa ni/nyi ma tshe ring / zla ba tshe ring / mig dmar tshe ring /lhag pa tshe ring / phur bu tshe ring / pa sangs tshe ring /spen pa tshe ring lta bu'o/ /bcu bzhi pa/ reg gza'i rjes ming grogs sbyar bas bu mor 'jug pa/yang res gza'i bdun po'i rjes su ming grogs 66sgrol ma/nya zhes pa sbyar na bu mo'i ming du 'jug pa ni/ dper na/nyi ma sgrol ma/ zla ba sgrol ma/ mig dmar sgrol ma/lhag pa sgrol ma/ phur bu sgrol ma/ pa sangs sgrol ma/spen pa sgrol ma lta bu'o/ /bco lnga pa/ gzungs dang dbang po sogs la bltas nas btags pa'i ming / bod rigs dmangs khrod kyi ming nyung shas shis/ ni phru gu'i gdong dang /gzugs dpyad/ stobs che chung / dbang po sogs la bltas nas btags pa'ang yod pa ste/ dper na/116
sha rgyags po yod pas/ rgyag lod/skra bzang po yod pas/ skra bzang /mig khra sgor sgor yin pas/ khra sgor/gdong dkar po yod pas/ zla dkar/stobs chen po yod pas/ stobs chen/shi nas slar log pas/ shi logskye dus shin tu chung bas/ skye chung zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu drug pa/ ming 'dogs sam mtshang ming /ming 'dogs sam mtshang ming 'dogs stangs sna tshogs yod kyang bsdu na rtsa ba'i dbye ba gnyis yod pa ste/ gcig ni mdog dang dbyibs la bltas nas btags pa dang / cig shos ni bya ba dang spyod lam la bltas nas btags pa zhig red/de yang dang po mdog dang dbyibs la bltas nas btags pa ni/dper na/mgo bo chen po yod pas/ 66mgo chen 99am cog ther ther yin pas/ 66am ther nyagmgo la skra med pas/ 66mar skogs nya mig 'bor 'bor yin pas/ 66mig 'bor nya skra zing zing yin pas/ ((srin po'am srin mo ha sha skam po yin pas/ 66spre'u nya lta bu dang /gnyis pa bya ba dang spyod par bltas nas btags pa ni/ dper na/ phyi 117
la zhi mi nang ba'i na 'gro mkhas pa dang sdod mkhas pa dang / nang la stag nang bzhin ngar po'am gyong po yod pa'i mi la mtshang ming /66stag zhim ga zhes dang /de bzhin kha bu ram las mngar zhing lag pa rdo las dam pa'i mi la mtshang ming 64rdo bu ram nya lta bu shin tu mang ba dang / da dung deng dus spyi tshogs thog gsar du thon pa'i mtshang ming dgod bro po mi nyung ba zhig kyang yod pa ni/dper na/lung pa zhig la mang tshogs kyis gnas tshul lam re ba brgya tsam zhus kyang mgo bo 'jog tsam 'jog tsam byed pa las thag gcod gtan nas mi byed mkhan gyi tshun krang zhig yod pa der mang tshogs kyis mtshang ming 66brgya mgo 'jog nya ces btags pa dang / yang sa khul zhig gi khrom ra'i thog mar 'tshong mkhan a cag cig yod pa des mar rgya ma re bkyag dus srang gnyis re ma longs par 'tshong gi yod pas de'i mtshang ming la 8(a cag srang brgyad ha ces btags shing / da dung / 66tshong dpon mis bzos g.yag ko 〉〉dang /1 66zur 'then pho brang 9966bod skyor zhi mi ga sogs dgod bro la gnang du 'khol ba'i ming 'dogs sam mtshang ming ha cang mang ngo /bcu bdun pa/ pha ma'i re 'dod ltar btags pa'i ming /dmangs khrod kyi ming ches nyung shas shig ni pha ma'i 'dod don 'grub rgyu'i re smon la gzhigs te btags pa zhig yin pa ni/ dper na/pha ma 'ga' zhig gis rang la phru gu bu mo kho na las bu ma skyes na bu mo rjes ma der 66bu khrid ga ces btags nas rjes su bu zhig khrid yong ba ste bu zhig skyes 118
rgyu'i re smon byed pa dang /yang 'ga' zhig gis rang gi phru gu snga ma re gnyis tshe ma zin na phru gu phyi ma de'i ming la/ khyi skyag dang / phag skyag sogs btags nas bar chad sel rgyu'i re smon byed kyi yod pa lta bu la pha ma/'i re 'dod ltar btags pa'i ming zhes brjod par 'dod/btso brgyad pa/ ches grangs gang skyes ltar btags pa'i ming /'di ni phru gu tshes gang gi nyin skyes pa ltar btags pa'i ming zhig yin te/dper na/tshes gcig la skyes pas/ tshes gcigtshes gsum la skyes pas/ tshes gsum/tshes brgyad la skyes pas/ tshes brgyad/tshes bco lngar skyes pas/ bco lnga/tshes sum cur skyes pas/ gnam gang lta bu la zer yang tshes grangs yod tshad mi'i ming nang yod par ma nges so/bcu dgu pa/ ched du ma btags pa'i ming /dmangs khrod kyi ming ches nyung shas shig ni phru gu skyes ma thag nas pha mas bu yin na bu chung dang / bu mo yin na as tog lta bur 'bod pa las ming dngos 'dogs rgyu ma byung bar brten phyis rgyun chags su gyur pa la ched du ma btags pa'i ming zhes bya ste/ dper na/ bu chung / bu tog bum chung /as tog as chung lta bu'o/ / 119
———wa bgego ge —nyi shu pa/ gsang mtshan nam ming tshang/'di ni gtso bo rtsom pa po 'ga' cig gis rang gis brtsams pa'i deb bam/ brtsam byar rang ming ngo ma ma bkod pa ming gzhan 'i gre bkod pa la zer ba ste/ dper na/mi la'i rnam thar rgod tshang pas mdzad pa'i mdzad byang du/rnam 'byor pa rus pa'i rgyan zhes brkod yod pa dang /stag phu chos kyi dbang phyug gi gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig gi mjug tu/gtad med sprang btson gar dbang smyon pa zhes bkod pa lta bu mang /de ba'i na deng dus kyang rtsom pa pos ming tshab bed spyod gnang ba yod de/chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyis brtsams pa la/ kun dges brtsams zhes dang /don grub rgyal gyis brtsams pa la/ rang grol gyis brtsams zhes/nor sdes brtsams pa la/ 'jam dbyangs kun khyab kyis brtsams 'es/lhag pa phun tshogs kyis brtsams pa la / rnam grol gyis brtsams tshes/mkhas grub kyis brtsams pa la/ ser skyas brtsams lta bu dang /da dung rtsom pa po kha shas la gsang mtshan nam ming tshab mang po'ang yod pa ni/ dper na/tā ma'i bla ma sku skreng lnga par/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho zhu yang /rtsom yig si mdzad byang khag nang /tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rje dang /༷ 120
za hor gyi bshe gang shar rang grol/bshe zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal lta bu'o/de ltar kho bos bod rigs kyi ming skor cung zad gleng ba 'di ni rgya mtsho chen po'i chu thigs dang / gang gā'i bye ma'i rdog gcig tsam yin pa las/gzhan du na rang cag bod rigs kyi ming ni sa mtho'i khyad chos 'bum gyis phyug cing / lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa/ khyad par du sna mang phun sum tshogs pa mkha' yi skar tshogs ltar grangs kyis mi lang ba 'ig yin stabs mtha' dag brjod pa'i spobs pa bdag la med cing /rang blos gang spobs gleng ba 'di dag la'ang 'gal 'khrul nor gsum yong ba ldog tu med pas tshad thub mkhas pa rnams kyis dag bcos gnang rgyu'i re ba snyim pa brang khar zum ste zhu'o/ /
rab btags rgyan gyi che ba rags tsam brjod pa lag len rgya mcho bsrubs pa'i zla gzhon/yid 'ong ma dzes pa'i sku dang snying rje'i thugs/ /thugs rje'i chu gter las/ 'khrungs bdud rtsi'i ngag /ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dbyangs can ma/ /ma sa yel bdag sor gar la ram skyor mdzod/ /mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /bdag blo'i zhing sa skam por 'dren mdzad de/ /shes rig myu gu spel ba'i byed po dngos/ /bshes gnyen dam pa kun la slar btud nas/ /rgyal rabs rim byung gser gyi phreng ba'i nang / /mkhas dbang bye ba du ma byon pa las/ /bye brag snyan ngag mkhan po'i bzhed dgongs te/ /de'i yang cha shas ri mor 'dod la spro/ /mtha' yas snyan gzhung klu dbang bzhi ba'i gnas/ /mdzad med ma ṇi ka yi 'jug ngogs na/ /122
legs par 'khrungs pa'i rab btags nor bu'i rgyan/ /snyan rtsom gzhal med khang bzang mdzes pa'i tog /rgyan gyi dbye ba gang ga'i bye ma dag /blo chung sor rtse'i phreng bas bgrang dka' yang / /kun rdzob dpe cha'i yon tan tsam min par/ /don dam lag pa'i shul rjes 'jog pa gal/ /'di na gangs can rtsom rig rgya mtsho dang / /khyad par dkar nag rgya yi snyan rtsom la/ /mig gis bltas shing blo yis brtag pa'i 'bras/ /chung yang 'phel gdung ril bu'i mtshan nyid rdzogs/ /de phyir snyan rtsom rgya bza' kong jo nyid/ /'gugs 'dod blo gsar blon po mgar ba khyed/ /lkog gyur dpyad rtsom bu mo lnga brgya'i dbus/ /ma nor 'dren byed mda' mo 'dir tshugs shig /ces pa'i 'go rtsom sho lo ka bdun tshar gcig gis sngon bsus te 'dir rab btags rgyan gyi che ba'am khyad chos rags tsam brjod par bya ste/dang po/ gleng bar bya ba'i gzhi/rang cag bod mi dmangs la dus yun ring ba'i lo rgyus dang / ngo mtshar 123
che ba'i rig gnas shig yod cing / snga phyir mkhas dbang mang po'i pir rtse las thon pa'i snyan gzhung gi dper brjod dang / snyan tshig sgrung gtam/ de min dmangs khrod kyi rtsom rig sna tshogs sogs grangs kyis mi lang ba yod pa de dag rang rgyal tsam du ma zad 'dzam gling rtsom rig skyed tshal yangs po'i dbus su'ang mtho sgang gi mdangs ris ngoms bzhin kun gyi 'dren byed mda' mo 'phangs pa'i yul du gyur yod/ khyad par du tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su bod kyi rtsom rig dbyar mtsho rgyas pa ltar gong 'phel byung zhing / gzhon skyes rtsom pa po'ang char rjes kyi smyug ma ji bzhin 'tshar longs byung ba de dag gis rang gi skad dang yi ge la brten nas gson nyams ldan pa'i dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba mtshon zhing /bag 'khums kyi bkag rgya gtong te dus rabs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rtsom yig dbyar gyi chu ltar 'jo ba de ni bod kyi rtsom rig theg rim de gnas tshad gsar pa zhig tu slebs pa'i mtshon rtags red/'on te nga tsho'i rtsom rig de sngon thon gyi mi rigs gzhan dang bsdur na da dung rgyang thag nges can zhig yod pas nga tshos nges par du ji ltar byas nas bod kyi rtsom rig gong 'phel gtong rgyu'i thad bsam blo mi gtong ka med red/'dir skabs su babs pa snyan rtsom 'bri stangs las 'phros pa'i gtam ste/rab btags rgyan gyi khyad chos sam de'i nus pa ni gzhan las khyab che zhing /snyan cha dod pas yid dbang 'phrog shugs che ba/ dpe mang ba sogs khyad chos du ma zhig 'dug par mthong la deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang gi snyan rtsom mkhas pa phal mo ches rgyan der dar bzo gnang tshod 'dug pas nga tshos kyang der do snang khyed dgos pa 'dug snyam/ de yang 'dzir kho bas slob gso'i dus deb 124
thog rtsom yig skor gyi dpyad rtsom spel bar ya mtshan gnang mi dgos te/ deng char mtho 'bring slob grwa ba mang pos bris pa'i rtsom yig brjod bya legs kyang tshig sbyor mi bde ba dang / rgyan 'jug po med pa mang du mthong zhing / lhag par du nye lam slob mjug yig tshad nang slob 'bring zhig gi dma' 'bring lo rim gnyis pa'i 'dzin grwa zhig gi yig tshad rgyugs shog nang ( rgya yig ) rtsom yig 'bri bar skar 30yod kyang mtho shos gcig la skar 18rag pa phud/ phal mo cher skar khu las ma rag pa dngos su mthong byung bas ma mthar yang de dag dang 'dra ba rnams la cung zad phan na ci ma rung snyam te bris pa lags so/ /gnyis pa/ rab btags kyi rgyan zhes pa'i go don/snyan gzhung le'u gnyis pa don rgyan nang gsal ba'i nang gses bcu gnyis pa rab btags ( rab rtog )kyi rgyan zhes pa ni/ sems ldan nam yang na sems med kyi khyad chos dngos yod ji ltar gnas pa de las rnam pa gzhan du sgro btags pa'i rab btags gsal byed kyi sgra dang ldan pa zhig la go dgos te/ dper na/snyan gzhung rtsa ba las de'i dper brjod thog ma sems ldan rab btags la/nyin gung nyi mas gdung ba yi/ /glang po dag ni mtshor 'jug pa/ /nyi ma'i phyogs gyur pad ma rnams/ /gzhon par 'dod pa ma yin nam/ /
zhes pa'i go don ni/ nyin mo'i gung la nyi ma'i tsha bas shin tu gdung ba'i glang po rnams pad ma'i mtshor 'jug pa ni nyi ma la 'khon lan nam 'gran ya byed ma nus pas nyi ma'i mthun phyogs su gyur pa'i pad ma rnams gzhom par 'dod pa ma yin nam 'es glang po che mtshor zhugs nas khrus bya ba'am/ chu 'dod pa/ yang na pad ma'i rtsa ba'i za ba'i dngos yod de rnam pa gzhan du sgro btags nas glang po ches nyi ma la 'khon lan nam 'thab ya byed ched pad ma'i mtsho nang du zhugs pa zhes sgro btags pa'o/ /rgyan 'di dag la had de bltas na byis gtam 'dra ba zhig mthong yang zhib tu dpyad na snyan cha dod cing / ngo mtshar che la dgod kyang bro ba sogs kyi khyad chos mi mngon par gnas yod/mdor na rab btags kyi rgyan zhes pa ni/ brjod par 'dod pa'i don dang 'bri bar 'dod pa'i snyan rtsom de de bas ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / sgyu rtsal ldan pa/ gzhan gyi yid dbang 'phrog shugs che ru gtong ba la med du mi rung ba zhig yin no/ /gsum pa/ snyan gzhung dang snyan rtsom/rang cag bod kyi snyan gzhung ni rgya gar gyi slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa'i me long 'di kho na yin la gzhung 'di 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bka' ltar shong lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du cha tshang bsgyur gnang mdzad cing / de rjes rim par dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa dang / zha lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po sogs kyis dag bcos dang 'chad nyan legs par mdzad cing / lhag par du kurma si tu bstan pa'i nyin ༷ 126
byed kyis rgya 'grel rgya dpe ma gnyis dang bsdur nas zhus dag legs par mdzad pa'i gzhung 〈me long ma skad gnyis shan sbyar 〉 ni sde dger si ru'i bka' 'bum khrod du'ang bzhugs/ phyis bod kyi chos lugs ris med kyi mkhas pa mang pos snyan 'grel ha cang mang po mdzad pas me long 'di nyid bod kyi skad yig dang je mthun du gyur pa'i snyan gzhung du grub cing /sngar snyan 'grel de dag las 〈bod mkhas pa'i snyan 'grel 〉 dang 〈dbyangs can dgyes glu 〉ni mang che bas tshad mar 'dzin cing gzhung de nyid la brten nas snyan ngag sbyangs pa byed/da lta'i mkhas pa tshos 〈snyan 'grel dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho 〉ni gzhan las khyad du 'phags par bzhed/ cideng char snyan gzhung me long la slob sbyong dang dpyad zhib gnang mkhan mang du yod thog bzhed pa'ang 'dra min yod pa las gtso bo ni khag gnyis te/(rang mos snyan ngag gi skor skabs su ma babs pas 'dir brjod par mi bya )(1)kha gcig gis bod yig gi snyan ngag sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa dgos na snyan gzhung me long zhib cing phra ba sbyangs dgos shing / snyan tshig 'bri dus kyang de las ma 'das pas me long ni bod kyi snyan gzhung cha tshang ba yin zhes ma gsungs kyang gsungs pa dang gcig tu bzhed pa de yin/ bzhed pa 'di ni don dngos shig yin la mes po dgyes pa'i mchod sprin yang yin te/ snyan gzhung me long ma'i sa bon de bod kyi rtsom rig sa rgyu gshin po'i khrod du yun ring rtsa ba tshugs pa dang / me tog bzhad pa/ 'bras bu g.yur du za ba smin zin pas gzhung lugs kyi sdong rgan de nyid rtsa bkog gtong thabs bral/(2) bzhed pa cig shos des snyan gzhung me long ma 'di nyid 'phags 127
yul gyi snyan gzhung zhig yin pas bod yig gi khyad chos dang mi mthun pa ma zad 'ga' zhig gtan nas mthun thabs med pas me long ma bod kyi snyan gzhung cha tshang ba zhig min par bzhed pa de la'ang rgyu mtshan med pa min te/dper na/ le'u dang po'i nang gi rgyan 'ga' zhig la bod kyi mkhas pa rnam pas mkhyen rtsal la brten nas u tshugs kyis dper brjod mdzad pa las don du bod kyi skad yig dang mthun po med pa ni gsal po red/ 'dir dpe zhig drangs na/ le'u dang po thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan bcu'i nang gses dang po sbyar ba'i rgyan las 'phros pa'i yi ge rnams kyi srog chen srog chung ngos 'dzin byed stangs ni rgya gar skad kyi dbang du bya pa yin pas rgya gar gyi skad dang /bod kyi skad/ de bzhin rgya gar gyi yi ge dang bod kyi yi ge ni sgra gzugs gnyis ka nas khyad chos tha dad par smos cing / dper na/ rgya gar shar phyogs pa rnams kyis bzhed pa'i sbyar rgyan ni/ srog chung gi yi ge shas che ba zhig yin par ma zad/ gsal byed kyi yi ge gcig nyid yang yang du bskor ba'i rjes su khrid pa zhig la 'dod de/ de'i mtshan gzhi dper brjod rtsa ba las/lhod pa mā la twe mā la/ /lo lta li ka li lā bzhin/ zhes pa la yig la bskor ba'i rjes khrid yin par gsungs kyang de ni rgya gar yi ge'i sgra bod yig tu bris pa zhig yin pas bod yig lam nas snyan rtsom 'bri dus de la lad mo byed don cang e yod/gong gi dper brjod de'i go don bod skad du bsgyur na/ dza ti'i me tog gi phreng bar sred pa'i bung ba 'khor ba zhes yin pas de la yi ge srog chung srog chung ji ltar dbye min dang / de la yig la bskor ba'i rjes khrid yin min bsam shes bya dgos snyam/༷ 128
gzhan yang 'di rgya gar gyi skad yig dbang du byas na sbyar rgyan rjes khrid can du grub kyang rgya gar skad yig gi sgra bod yig tu bris pa ni rgya gar gyi skad shes pa las yi ge mi shes pa'i mi zhig rgya gar gyi tshogs 'dur zhugs nas rgya gar gyi dpon po'i gsung bshad kyi sgra de bod yig thog nas zin bris brgyab pa dang 'dra bas zin bris de rgya gar gyi skad mi shes pa'i bod yig mkhas can zhig gis bltas tshe don go ba phar phyog klog par yang dka' bar nges so/'dir dpe gsal tsam bkod na/deng dus rgya nag gi sngon byon nam da lta'i mkhas pa tsho'i grags ldan snyan rtsom slob sbyong byed dgos na rgya yig steng nas slob sbyong byed dgos pa'am/yang na rgya yig gi snyan rtsom de bod yig tu bsgyur ba zhig nas slob sbyong byed dgos pa las rgya skad kyi sgra de bod yid tu bris nas slob sbyong byed mkhan ga la yod/ dper na/ ( lko cho/] 5 ( gi ) zhes pa'i sgra bod yig tu bris te/66khrong chan ming g.yos kong /nya zhes pa rgya skad mi shes pa'i bod yig mkhas pa zhig la spyan 'bul zhus na dbu g.yugs g.yugs gnang nges yin pa de bzhin no/ 'o na bod kyi 'das dang da lta'i mkhas pa mang pos de dag la dper brjod cha tshang mdzad med dam zhe na/ dper brjod mdzad yod kyang dper brjod de dag la zhib par brtag tshe snyan gzhung le'u gsum pa sgra rgyan gyi khongs su 'gro ba'i nyams shig kyang thon gyin 'duggzhan yang yi ge srog chen srog chung zhes pa'ang rgya gar gyi yi ge dang bod kyi yi ge mi mthun pa ni/ dper na/ bod kyi sum rtags las/ ka tsa ta pa bzhi pho'i yi ge ste/ sgra gdangs shugs che bar bzhag kyang skabs 'dir rgya gar gyi skad yig la bstun na 'jam pa'i yi ge yin pa lta bu'o/ /129
de'i thad ta la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa dang / khams sprul chos kyi nyi mas srog chen srog chung gi skabs su sum rtags kyi gzhung ltar byas na legs zhes gsungs kyang de ltar snyan rtsom nang la'ang yi ge pho mo ma ning sogs dbye dgos na bya byed las gsum dang dus gsum sogs kyang dbye dgos par 'gyur bas shin tu mgo bo 'thoms pa las gzhan med do/ /mdor na me long ma 'di nyid bod kyi snyan gzhung gtso bor gyur pa snyan ngag rtsom pa po shing mkhan dag gi thig shing med du mi rung ba zhig yin na'ang da dung de las ches cha tshang ba'i snyan gzhung zhig chags rgyur rang re bod kyi snyan ngag ming byang 'dzin pa kun gyis 'bad brtson byed dgos la gzhan du na snyan rtsom dngos su 'bri dus gang la de mtsham gyi rgyan sbyar chog pa las gu dog po byed mi dgos pa mkhyen gsal ltar ro/ /bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi snyam rtsom zhig dbe ru drangs pa/'dir rgya gar gyi gna' rtsom grags can 〈snyan ngag sprin gyi pho nya 〉las dum bu re gnyis dpe ru 'dren par 'dod de/ dgos pa ni snyan ngag ring mo de'i mgo nas mjug bar rab btags kyi rgyan yin pas ched mngags rgyan de'i nus pa dang / khyad chos/ khyab che chung sogs shes pa'i ched du yin no/de yang 〈snyan ngag sprin gyi pho nya 〉ni rgya gar gyi snyan ngag mkhan po kā lī dā sa ste nag mo'i khol gyis mdzad pa dang / bod 'gyur la sho lo ka brgya dang bcu bdun dang / rgya nag pa'i 'gyur du sho lo ka brgya dang bco lnga yod/'dir skabs su babs pa rtsom pa po nag mo'i khol ngo sprod rags tsam zhu na/ sngon 'phags yul gyi grong khyer wa rā ṇa sī ra rgyal po bhi ma shi kā la zhes par 130
shin tu mdzes pa'i sras mo dpyid ldan ma zer ba zhig yod/sras mo de rig gnas phal mo cher mkhas par gyur pa'i tshe yab rgyal pos sgra sogs shin tu mkhas pa'i bram ze mchog sred ces bya ba dpyid ldan ma'i slob dpon du gdan drangs/ rim bzhin bram ze mchog sred sras mo la rab tu chags kyang sras mos 'dod don ma 'grub pas ngan jus shar nas rgyal por/da ni khyed kyi sras mor mag pa len ran pas bdag gis mag pa phul du byung ba zhig 'tshol du 'gro zhes zhus par rgyal pos bka' gnang /bram zes phyogs kun tu rgyu ba na gzhon nu glang rdzi zhig g.yang gzar ngos su skyes pa'i sdong po zhig gi rtser 'dzigs te sta res shing de'i rtsa ba gcod kyin 'dug pa mthong nas bram ze'i sems la/ 'jig rten na 'di las blun pa zhig med snyam nas glang rdzi pho brang du gdan drangs te 'jig rten na dkon pa'i mag pa zhig rnyed do zhes dril bsgrags/ rgyal pos bzang ngan brtag pa'i tshig 'ga' smras pa thams cad bram zes lan btab ste rgyal po 'khrul bar byas shing ring min bram ze mchog sred lho phyogs su bros/ mthar dpyid ldan mas kyang bram zes bslus par shes nas shin tu yid mug cing sgra sogs bslab kyang ci yang ma shes/ de nas dpyid ldan mas thabs shig rnyed de lha mo'i lha khang zhig yod par g.yog mo gcig mngags te lha mo'i rgyab tu yibs nas 'di dang ༷ ༷ 'di ltar byed dgos zhes gdams/ de nas khyo bor khyed lha khang du song nas mchod bkur gyis dang lha mos dngos grub gnang nges yin zhes bshad/ khyo bo lha khang du song nas phyag 'tshal skabs g.yog mos la du ( spos mang po btab pa'i za ma dri zhim ) mang po gtor bas dngos grub bstsal bar rtogs nas shin tu dga' bar gyur/131
de nas bzung rig pa je gsal du song nas rig gnas kun la gsan sbyangs mdzad cing mthar phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag mkhan por gyur bar ma zad bzo rig dang ri mo la'ang shin tu mkhas par gyur pas rgyal pos rang gi btsun mo ri mor 'bri dgos pa'i bka' bsgos/nag mo'i khol gyis btsun mo de ri mor 'bri skabs lus la gyon pa'i ka shi'i gos dang de las mthong ba'i sme ba nag po de yang ji bzhin bris pas rgyal blon thams cad ngo mtshar skyes/'on kyang blon po phra ma mkhan 'gas rgyal por/ btsun mo dang nag mo'i khol gnyis lus 'brel yod par 'dug gal te med na btsun mo'i lus kyi sme ba ji ltar mthong ngam zhus par rgyal po mgo rmongs te bden par rlom nas nag mo'i khol smyugs pas yul 'khyams 'tsho bar mi rol ka med byung /phyis rgyal pos nag mo'i khol nyes med yin pa shes nas 'tshol phyir/mtsho yi nang gi pad ma de/ /g.yo bar byed pa'i rgyu gang zhig /ces pa'i snyan ngag kun tu bkrams nas 'dir lan 'debs nus na rgyal srid phyed ka ster zhes bsgrags/ nyin zhig nag mo'i khol rgya gar byang phyogs sa cha'i chang khang zhig la 'byor dus gnas tshul de shes pas nag mo'i khol gyis der lan 'debs pa sla/bung ba zhugs tshe nyi ma nub/ /'phur bar 'dod pa 'dar ba'i rgyu/ /zhes lan bris pas chang tshong mas ngan jus bshams te nag mo'i khol bkrongs/ 'on kyang rgyal srid phyed ka thob rgyu phar bzhag rdzun rkub brdol te phyi ༷ 132
srog kyang shor/de ltar rtsom pa po khong rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba'i nang kyag kyog mang zhing /lhag par du snying nas gces pa'i grogs dang bral dgos byung ba'i brtse gdung gi skyo glu de 〈sprin gyi pho nya'i snyamagrin las blangs pa'ang srid/snyan ngag 〈sprin gyi pho nya'i nyi nang don mdor bsdus ni/ rgya gar byang phyogs kyi nor lha ste/ gnod sbyin ku pe ra bya ba la mdzod gnyer ba zhig yod pa des rtag par bdag po'i bka' bzhin ma 'grub pas nor lha ku pe ra khros te pho brang las mthar bskrad de lo gcig ring rgya gar lho phyogs kyi ri bo zhig gi steng 'dug dgos pa'i bka' btsan phab pas mdzod gnyer de rang gi snying sdug chung ma dang bral nas mi 'gro ka med byung /mdzod gnyer de lho phyogs ri bo'i steng slebs nas bzung pha yul du lus pa'i snying sdug rab tu dran pa'i gdung bas mnar te lus stobs kyang rim bzhin nyams/ zla ba bdun par sprin rnams byang gi phyogs su dal bar chas pa mthong nas byang phyogs su lus pa'i snying sdug lhag par dran te chu 'dzin la dga' mar 'phrin yig bskur ba de yin no/ chu 'dzin la 'phrin yig bskur skabs rtsom pa pos rtog pa 'char yan gyi smyug rtsal spyad nas rab dkar sprin la 'du shes dang dran reg yod la/ dga' sdang dang chags sems yod pa sogs sprin de smra shes don go ba'i sems ldan zhig tu rtog btags mdzad nas snyan ngag 'di'i mgo nas mjug bar rab btags kyi rgyan spyad nas ngo mtshar yid dbang 'phrog pa'i tshig sbyor bskrun yod pa ni blo yul las 'das pa zhig yin te/dper na sho lo ka bcu gsum pa la mtshon na/ka ye chu 'dzin re zhig khyod ni lam la bgrod pa'i thabs kyi gtam ni 133
mnyan par mdzod de yi rjes su bdag gi 'phrin ni rna ba'i bde skyes khyed kyis rna bas bzung bar mdzod/ shin tu ngal zhing rab tu ngal tshe ri bo'i rtse rkang bkod ngal ba bsal nas gshegs gang du skom zhing shin tu skom na nyung ngu'i chu dang che ba'i mtsho la'ang btung bar bya/zhes pa'i don ni/ kye chu 'dzin lags/ dus tshod cung zad tsam gyi ring la khyed kyis khyed nyid lam gang brgyud nas 'gro dgos pa dang / lam du ji bgrod dgos pa sogs kyi thabs lam mchog gi skad cha 'di la legs par gsan nas thugs la legs par gzung bar mdzod/ khyed nyid byang du skyod lam la/ shin tu ngal zhing rab tu thang chad pa'i dus ri bo'i rtse mor rkang pa bkod pa'am tsog pur bzhugs la re zhig ngal bsos shing ngal dub sangs rjes mu mthud gshegs par 'tshal/ gal srid gnas gang du kha skom zhing shin tu skom nas bskyod par mi nus tshe/ dwangs shing bsil ba'i chu klung dang chu phran nam/ sngo mer 'khyil ba'i mtsho dang mtshe'u sogs gang thug kyang de tshims par 'thung nas skom pa sel bar gyis la de nas sngar bzhin byang phyogs su bskyod cing ces rab btags kyi rgyan ji 'dra'i snyan po sbyar mi 'dug gam/yang dper na sho lo ka so dgu pa ste/de na bdag po'i gnas su mchog gi btsun mo rnams ni rab dga' snyeg par byed pa na/ mtshan mo'i mun pa stug po rnams kyis mi yi bdag po'i lam gyi snang ba 'gog byed pas/ khyed kyi glog 'od gser mdog 'od kyi snang bas sa gzhi'i lam ni kun nas bstan par mdzod/ chu char 'brug dbyangs sgra chen mang po ma byed mdzes ma de rnams skrag cing 'chi bar 'gyur/zhes pa'i don ni/ gnas de na mchog tu mdzes shing 'dod pa'i bya ba la 134
zhugs par rab tu spro ba'i btsun mo'am gzhon nu ma rnams mtshan mo'i dus su/gsang stabs kyis rang gi bdag po'i sar rab tu dga' pos rkang 'jab lag 'jab byas nas 'gro ba na/ mtshan mo'i mun smag stug po rnams kyis bsam nag byas bzhin du lam gyi snang ba yongs su bsgribs pas/ phyogs gang la 'gro dgos pa'ang mi shes par rmongs pa'i gnas su lhung ba na/ chu 'dzin khyed kyis glog zhags gser mdog gi 'od snang des bdag po'i sa gzhi'i steng gi lam gsal por bstan nas 'gro bar 'jug rgyu mkhyen mkhyen/ 'on kyang chu 'dzin lags/ khyed kyis drag char bsnyil ba'am mi sems la zhed snang skyed pa'i 'brug sgra chen po sgrogs par ma mdzad pa mkhyen mkhyen/ gal srid khyed kyis de ltar byas nas mdzes ma de rnams ches cher skrag par 'gyur zhing / 'jigs skrag des rkyen byas nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba'ang srid do zhes gson nyams ldan pa'i dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba der rmad du byung ba'i rtog pa 'char yan gyi sgyu rtsal gyis rnam par brgyan nas brjod don nyams 'gyur ldan la mdzes sdug ldan pa'i sgo nas mtshon par byas pa lta bu'o/ /lnga pa/ rgya nag gi snyan rtsom zhig dpe ru drangs pa/snga deng gi rgya nag pa'i snyan ngag mkhan po rnams kyis kyang rab btags kyi rgyan bed spyod mang po gnang yod pa dang / rgyan sbyor tshul yang bod kyi snyan gzhung nang gsal rab btags kyi rgyan dang gcig mtshungs yin par mngon/ma gzhi rgya yig dang bod yig gtan nas mi 'dra yang bod yig snyan gzhung nang rab btags gsal byed kyi tshig phrad bzhin sgra dang bcas dgu ste/snyam/ dogs/ nges/ 'dra/ rtog mig nam/ cis ma yin/ ji 135
ltar min/ bzhin/ bcas yod pa de bzhin du rgya yig gi nang yang rab btags gsal byed kyi sgra shin tu mang la rgya'i snyan ngag mkhas rnams kyis rgyan 'di spyad nas bris pa'i grags can snyam rtsom ches mang de/'dir sa bcad ma stong tsam du sho la ka gcig dpe ru drangs na/gi cho/] yo( phra ga 1 74rsālha snro45 ( 3 4khya〉 ṣṭhaṣṭha khya 0zhes pa'i snyan rtsom bod skad du bsgyur na/'od dkar zhun ma mal khri'i mdun 'phros pa/ /rab dkar ba mo sa gzhir babs sam snyam/ /'od gsal zla bar mgo bo gtegs nas ltas/ /rab gsal yid la pha yul 'gog med dran/ /zhes pa'i snyan rtsom nang rab btags kyi rgyan mkhas pos sbyar yod de/don du sa gzhir zla 'od 'phrog pa ba mo babs pa dang nor ga la srid/ 'on kyang rtsom pa pos ba mo babs pa dang nor bar rbad de thag gcod med de/(snyam )zhes pa'i rab btags gsal byed kyi sgra sbyar yod pas rgya yig nang gi (lho rsha)zhes pa rab btags gsal byed kyi sgra yin pa gsal shes byung ngo / de dang de 'dra ba rgya yig mang ches nang yang re zhig 'di gas 'thus par bya'o/ /drug pa/ bod kyi snyan ngag dper brjod 'ga' zhigsnga phyir bod kyi mkhas pa mang pos snyan gzhung me long ma'i 'grel ba rgyas bsdus sna tshogs brtsams gnang mdzad pa'i dper brjod nang rab btags rgyan gyi dper brjod ni ches snyan la ngo mtshar che bar mthong bas 'dir mkhas 136
pa'i dper brjod 'ga' zhig 'dren par 'dod de/tshe tan zhabs drung gis/rab dkar mu tig nya phyis gur khang du/ /snyoms 'jug las kyis gtan sdod sun pa na/ /mchongs gar cig gis khyed zhal pad ma'i lhor/ /chags pa'i tshems phreng mdzum dkar dgod pa bzhin/ /zhes pa'i don ni mdzes ma khyed kyi tshems phreng mu tig bzhin du dkar ba des khyed zhal pad ma de bas mdzes par byas so/ zhes yin mod rtsom pa pos shin tu mkhas pos rab btags kyi rgyan spyad pa ste/rab tu dkar ba'i mu tig nya phyis kyi gur khang du gtan du sdod par ches sun nas mchongs thengs gcig gis khyed zhal pad ma'i ngos su zhugs pa bzhin zhes mdzes ma'i mdzum dkar zer phreng 'phro ba'i tshems la bstod par byas pa ni ji 'dra'i snyan po mi 'dug gam/de bzhin bod mkhas pas/ ('di man gsal 'grel mi bya )g.yem la rjes chags sngo bsangs mkha'i bu mo'i/ /rgyu skar do shal thag pa chad pa'i tshe/ /skya rengs snang ba dang 'grogs srid pa'i mig /bgrad nas gling bzhi kun tu 'tshol bzhin rgyu/ / zhes dang zhwa dmar pa paṇa ṭi tas/gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po 'di rnams kyi/ /lung rigs rtsod pa'i ngag la phrag dog nas/ /137
dbyar rnga gsang mthor bsgrags kyang ma 'gran tshe/ /skyengs par chu 'dzin gos su gyon par nges/ /dbyangs can dga' blos/ind+ra ni la bzhus pa'i khu ba yis/ /dri bral ston gyi mkha' la byugs pa bzhin/ /geg ldan zla ba'i bzhin ras ngom pa na/ /kun da gzhon nu dga' nas mdzum pa bzhin/ /paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis/gzhon nu khyed kyi mkhur tshos la/ /smug rtse'i thig le 'god pa ni/ /chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor las/ /mdzes phul che bar 'dod dam snyam/ /dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis/sngo ljang lo ma'i gos gyon ljon shing rtser/ /dmar ser bzhin ras mdzum pa'i shing 'bras rnams/ /'jam gnyen yal 'dab lag pa rkyong bzhin du/ /phyogs bzhi'i mgron la bsu ba zhus pa 'dra/ /de dag la sogs pa'i rab btags kyi rgyan sbyar stangs la zhib tu brtag tshe gzhi nas rgyan de'i thun min gyi khyad chos wa ler gsal bar nges so/ /138
bdun pa/ gsar du brtsams pa'i snyan rtsom nang /deng char gsar du brtsams pa'i snyan rtsom mang po'i nang rab btags kyi rgyan spyad de tshig nyams phun sum tshogs po bton yod pa ni grangs kyis mi lang bas 'dir kho bo rang gi brtsams chos 'ga' zhig steng nas dpe kha shas zhu bar bya'o/ de yang yin te/ skye bo su yin rung rang la rang rgyus mnga' che shos yod pa ji bzhin du rang gi brtsams chos legs sam zhan yang rang la rgyus mnga' che shos yod pa'i phyir ro/ /〈dus bzhi'i so nam byed lugs 〉las 86e ma char ldan dbyar gyi dus 'di'i zhing thang yangs po'i mdzes chos la/ nam 'kha'i lha mo'ang rab tu chags nas mi yul bag mar yong 'dod nas/ tshos sna lnga ldan 'ja' yi skas 'dzegs sa la ga ler btsugs pa de/ mig stong can gyis de mar rtogs nas rdo rje bsnun pas 'khyog por gyur/lta zhes pa'i don ni/ dbyar dus kyi zhing thang yangs po ni mdzes shing blta na sdug pa zhig yod pa de'i thog da dung tshos sna lnga dang ldan pa'i 'ja' tshon gyis gnam sa 'brel bar byas pas/ ji ltar shin tu dkar ba'i khang bzang la bsil zer bye ba'i 'od 'phros pa bzhin de bas mdzes par gyur/ zhes pa de yin yang 'dir rab btags kyi rgyan spyad de/ dbyar dus kyi zhing thang shin tu mdzes par mi rnams lta ci/ nam mkha'i lha mo'ang rab tu chags pa ste/sems shor nas tshos sna lnga ldan gyi 'ja' yi skas ka zhig dal bus btsugs te mi yul du babs par 'dod kyang gsang ba de mig stong can te brgya byin gyis phral du rtogs rjes rab tu khros nas la ga nang gi rdo rje de shugs chen pos 139
bsnun pas 'ja' yi skas kur phog te 'khyog por gyur zhes ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa'i tshig sbyor du gyur pa ni rab btags rgyan gyi nus pa'o/ /yang 〈bde skyed kyi gnyen sgrig las 〉 (6skabs der chu 'dzin dkar po'i gseb nas mtshan mo'i mgon po dal bu dal bus 'jig rten stad mor byon pa'i dus/brtse ba'i mdza' gcugs zung de phan tshun shed shugs 'gran pa ji bzhin dam du 'khyud pa gsal bar gzigs pa na/cung zad skyengs te myur ba myur bar nam mkha'i glang po'i pham tu re zhig zol gyis yibs pa'i tshul bstan yang /yid smon skyes te ga ler zur nas gzigs tsam gzigs tsam gnang ba de la rgyu skar tshogs rnams bzhad gad shod/lta zhes pa'i don ni/ brtse gdung gi zhags pas bcings pa'i gzhon nu pho mo gnyis lcang gseb gling kha'i nang phan tshun snying gtam smra bzhin gnyis mos sems gcig tu 'brel nas shed shugs 'gran sdur te sbe ga 'gran skabs phan tshun dam du 'khyud pa ji bzhin dam por 'khyud res byas te gnas so zhes pa la/ rab btags kyi rgyan spud de/ chu 'dzin te sprin pa dkar po'i gseb nas mtshan mo'i mgon po ste zla ba dal bus byon dus dma' ba'i sa gzhi'i ngogs shig na mdza' gcugs gnyis po phan tshun 'khyud res byas te bsdad pa gsal ba mthong bas zla ba kho rang yang cung zad skyeng te myung pos nam mkha'i glang po ste sprin pa'i gseb tu yibs pa'i zol bstan yang sems gting nas mdza' gcugs de gnyis la yid smon chen po skyes te sprin pa'i zur nas ga ler 140
gzigs tsam gzigs tsam gnang ba de skar ma'i tshogs rnams kyis mthong bas bzhad gad shor ro/ zhes zla ba de sems dang ldan pa zhig tu sgro btags pa'o/ /de bzhin 〈yid gdung mchi ma'i thigs sgra 〉las/bsil ldan yul gyi nor 'dzin dpal mo yang / /bzhin ras ma las mchi mas rab brlan zhing / /ri dang ljon pas mgo bo rab dud de/ /dad gus ches pos mya ngan mtshon thabs byas/ / zhes pa dang /〈dpa' bor bstod pa 〉las/gcig min kun gyis chu bo chen po'i 'jing / /mchongs shing ka gdung gcig la gcig 'brel gyis/ /myur bar mthud pa'i phul byung rkyal rtsal la/ /gser mig nya yang skyengs te gyen du bros/ / zhes pa la sogs/mang du yod pa de dag la zhib tu gzigs nas snyig 'dor bcud len yod par 'tshal/brgyad pa/ mjug byang /kho bos gong gsal rang gi bgrang bya bcu lhag tsam ring snyan rtsom 'bri rgyu slob sbyong byed ring gi nyams myong dang bshes gnyen dam pa rnams kyi gsung rgyun gzhir bcas rab btags rgyan gyi nus pa'am che ba mdor bsdus su zhus pa de ni/ rgyan de spyad na snyan rtsom 'bri bde zhing / tshig sbyor snyan pa/ dgod kyang bro la go yang bde ba sogs kyi khyad chos mang po mthong gshis gang bsam 141
ri mor bkod pa tsam las/ rgyan 'di ni mchog yin no/ gzhan rnams ni shin tu dman pa'o/ 'di ni nas pa che'o/ gzhan rnams ni nus med yin no/zhes zhus pa gtan nas min la rgyan 'di yod pa'i snyam rtsom las lhag pa med pas snyan rtsom phul du byung ba 'bri dgos na nges par du rgyan 'di sbyar dgos zhes zhus pa de bas kyang min/ /
snyan gzhung le'u gsum pa'i rtsa ba gsar pa chu brgya zam 'dus dang rang 'grel phra mthong che shel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ston pa zla med zas gtsang sras/ /skyabs pa dam chos sde snod gsum/ /'dren pa ngur smrig dge 'dun bcas/ /bslu med gsum la gus btud nas/ /mkhas pa'i thugs dgongs gangs ri las/ /babs pa'i sgra rgyan chu phran brgya/ /gcig tu 'du ba'i gser zam zhig /bskrun pa'i bgo skal kho bor thob/ /sgra yi rgyan de grangs mang yang /gtso bo nang gses bzhi ru bsdu/ /bya sla bya 'bring bya dka' dang / /dmigs bsal gcig bcas dbye ba bzhi/ /༷ 143
bya sla sgra rgyan nang gses gsum/ /rkang re'i mdun tshig gnyis 'dras gcig /rkang bzhi'i mdun tshig 'dra bas gnyis/ /rkang bzhi'i mjug tshig 'dra bas gsum/ /bya 'bring sgra rgyan nang gses bdun/ /nges med tshig gnyis mtshungs pas gcig /bar dang thog ma mtshungs pas gnyis/ /mtha' dang thog ma mtshungs pas gsum/ /bar dang mtha' ma mtshungs pas bzhi/ /mtha' thog dbus gsum mtshungs pas lnga/ /mtha' dang thog ma sbyar bas drug /rab spel zung ldan bcas bdun no/ /bya dka' sgra rgyan nang gses drug /'dra min kun bzang 'khor los gcig /tshig gam rkang pa bzlog pas gnyis/ ༈nges bzhi bcas drug yin no/ /bod yig gsal byed sum cu ste/ /ka mad star la brgyus pa'i phreng / /144
rtsom tshul dka' sla sna tshogs pa/ /bod kyi dmigs bsal sgra rgyan yin/ /de ltar sgra rgyan mu tig phreng / /rtsom gyi mgul du ches mdzes kyang / /tshig sbyor snyan zhing 'jibs pa las/ /rdo chag btsan sgrig byed mi rung / /gab tshig ces pa sgra yi rgyan/ /dngos min rig pa'i dri tshig tsam/ /dbye ba bcu drug gsungs nas yang / /bsdu na dka' dang sla ba gnyis/ /skyon sel le'u dang po'i khongs/ /bzhag na 'os shing mtshams pa ste/ /tshig rgyan gang dang gang la yang /thog mar skyon sel shes pa gal/ /de skad sgra rgyan chu phran brgya/ /'du ba'i gser zam gsar pa'i steng ༈ /tshig rgyan rig pa'i sku mgron rnams/ /mgyogs nas myur du phebs par smon/ /145
rtsa ba/ston pa zla med zas gtsang sras/ /skyabs pa dam chos sde snod gsum/ /'dren pa ngur smrig dge 'dun bcas/ /bslu med gsum la gus btud nas/ /de yang phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi ni rgyal ba'i bsta na pa rin po che kho na las ma 'das pas bdag cag gi ston pa srid gsum na 'gran zla med pa zas gtsang gi sras don kun grub pa'am yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / des gsungs pa'i skyabs pa dam chos sde snod gsum du 'du ba'i chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong / de dag nyams su blangs shing gzhan la spel bar mdzad nas nyam thag 'dren pa'i pho nya ngur smrig dmangs ldan 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bcas bslu ba med pa'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la sgo gsum gus pas btud par bya'o/ ༷ ༷ nas zhes pa ni lhag ma 'dren pa'i tshig go /rtsa ba/mkhas pa'i thugs dgongs gangs ri las/ /babs pa'i sgra rgyan chu phran brgya/ /gcig tu 'du ba'i gser zam zhig /bskrun pa'i bgo skal kho bor thob/ /tshig rgyan rig pa la rab tu mkhas pa'i 'phags bod paṇa grub mang po'i thugs dgongs gangs ri dkar po las babs pa'i sgra yi rgyan ni dbyar dus kyi chu phran dang 'dra bar brgya phrag mang po mchis pa rnams gcig tu rtsa 'grel 146
gsar pa gser gyi zam pa dang 'dra ba zhig bskrun pa'i bgo skal de sngon byon mkhas dbang rnam pas kho bor ched du bzhag pa min nam snyam ste dngos su thob pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa ba/sgra yi rgyan de grangs mang yang / /gtso bo nang gses bzhi ru bsdu/ /bya sla bya 'bring bya dka' dang / /dmigs bsal gcig bcas dbye ba bzhi/ /spyir sgra yi rgyan zhes pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar grangs mang yang gsar bu rnams blo la nges bde ba'i phyir gtso bo nang gses bzhi ru bsdu bar bya ste/dang po/ bya sla ba'i sgra rgyan dang /gnyis pa/ bya 'bring ba'i sgra rgyan/gsum pa/ bya dka' ba'i sgra rgyan/bzhi pa/ dmigs bsal gyi sgra rgyan bcas dbye ba bzhi ru 'dod do/ /rtsa ba/bya sla sgra rgyan nang gses gsum/ /rkang re'i mdun tshig gnyis 'dras gcig /rkang bzhi'i mdun tshig 'dra bas gnyis/ /rkang bzhi'i mjug tshig 'dra bas gsum/ /
dang po/ bya sla ba'i sgra rgyan nang gses gsum yod de/1 tshig rkang re'i mdun tshig gnyis re 'dra ba'i zung ldan/2 tshig rkang bzhi pa'i mdun tshig gcig gam gnyis 'dra ba'i zung ldan/3 tshig rkang bzhi ga'i mjug tshig gcig gam gnyis 'dra ba'i zung ldan/gcig tshig rkang re'i mdun tshig gnyis re 'dra ba'i dper brjod ni/sngo sngo rtsa thang g.yu yi gzhong pa'i nang / /dkar dkar lu gu mu tig phreng ba mdzes/ /'jam 'jam bal las grub pa'i gyon chas la/ /yangs yangs 'dzam gling 'di na 'gran zla su/ /lta bu'o/ /gnyis/ tshig rkang bzhi ga'i mdun tshig gcig gam gnyis 'dra ba'i dper brjod/ma bris rang byung ri mo mig gi dpyid/ /ma bcos lhun chags sa 'dzin mu khyud can/ /ma btab nags kyis mdzes rgyan rab spras pa'i/ /ma smad bod ljongs 'dzam gling dbu rtser 'gying / /lta bu mdun tshig gcig 'dra ba dang /grags can jo mo glang mar dar dmar btsugs/ /grags can yar klung gtsang por lcags zam bskrun/ /grags can khra ko la la gzhung lam bzos/ /grags can yangs pa can du glog khang brgyab/ /148
lta bu mdun tshig gnyis 'dra ba'o/ /gsum/ tshig rkang bzhi ba'i mjug tshig gcig gam gnyis 'dra ba'i dper brjod ni/ smra ba'i 'bab stegs grol ba 'chad par mkhas/ /rgol ngan phye mar 'thag pa'i rtsod par mkhas/ /sdeb legs tshig sbyor rmad byung rtsom la mkhas/ /de phyir khyed ni 'chad rtsod rtsom la mkhas/ /lta bu mjug tshig gcig 'dra ba dang /mtha' yas zhing thang gnam las rgya che che/ /lo tog gser gyi rba rlabs mgo ldem ldem/ /zhing las 'phrul chas sna mang sgra 'ur 'ur/ /'bru sna lnga yi bang mdzod kun byur byur/ /lta bu mjug tshig gnyis 'dra ba'o/ /rtsa ba/bya 'bring sgra rgyan nang gses bdun/ /nges med tshig gnyis mtshungs pas gcig /bar dang thog mar mtshungs pas gnyis/ /mtha' dang thog ma mtshungs pas gsum/ /bar dang mtha' ma mtshungs pas bzhi/ /mtha' thog dbus gsum mtshungs pas lnga/ /mtha' dang thog ma sbyar bas drug /rab spel zung ldan bcas bdun no/ /149
bya sla ba dang dka' ba gnyis ka ma yin pa'i bya 'bring ba'i sgra rgyan la nang gses bdun yod de/1 tshig rkang re'i bar gyi tshig gnyis nges med mtshungs pa/2 thog ma'i tshig dang bar tshig gcig gam gnyis mtshungs pa/3 thog ma'i tshig dang mtha' ma'i tshig gcig ma gnyis mtshungs pa/4 bar gyi tshig dang mtha' ma'i tshig gcig gam gnyis mtshungs pa/5 mtha' thog dbus gsum tshig gcig gam gnyis mtshungs pa/6 mtha' dang thog ma'i tshig gcig gam gnyis sbyar ba/7 gang rung mnyam du bsres pa rab spel gyi zung ldan bcas so/ /gcig tshig rkang re'i bar gyi tshig gnyis nges med mtshungs pa'i dper brjod ni/lag shes shes bya'i thon zog sna kha mang / /brje tshong tshong ra'i thog tu nyo tshong 'khrug /dbul bcos bcos ma min pa'i phyug po'i lam/ /mig sngar sngar dang mi 'dra kun la rnyed/ /lta bu dang / tshig rkang ngam tsheg bar gzhan dag gnyis mtshungs pa'ang rig pas bsgre bar bya'o/ /gnyis/ thog ma'i tshig dang bar tshig gcig gam gnyis mtshungs pa'i dper brjod ni/mkha' lding mkha' la bgrod pa'i bdag po dang / /nor bu nor gyi dwangs ma bsam 'phel sogs/ /yongs rdzogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i bka' drin gyis/ /150
'gran yang 'gran par mi bzod sam bho ṭa/ /lta bu tshig gcig mtshungs pa dang /mdzes mdzes dbu dang mdzes mdzes dbu skra'i ngos/ /mtshar mtshar gos dang mtshar mtshar rgyan gyis spras/ /dkar dkar tshems dang dkar dkar zhal ras ni/ /gsal gsal zla dang gsal gsal nyi ma bzhin/ /lta bu tshig gnyis re mtshungs pa'o/ /gsum/ thog ma'i tshig dang mtha' ma'i tshig gcig gam gnyis mtshungs pa'i dper brjod ni/mdzes sdug yar klung nub tu 'phyongs rgyas mdzes/ /mdzes ma'i gtsug rgyan zla ba sgrol ma mdzes/ /mdzes ris bkra ba'i srong btsan bang so mdzes/ /mdzes ldan yar lha sham po'i sham chu mdzes/ /lta bu tshig gcig mtshungs pa dang /lhang lhang slob khrid 'chad pa'i sgra lhang lhang / /lhang lhang lung rigs rtsod pa'i dbyangs lhang lhang / /lhang lhang sdeb legs rtsom gyi tshig lhang lhang / /lhang lhang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gtam lhang lhang / /lta bu tshig gnyis mtshungs pa'o/ /bzhi/ bar gyi tshig dang mtha' ma'i tshig gcig gam gnyis mtshungs pa'i dper brjod ni/gsal byed nyi mas lo tog smin par byed/ /151
phan byed gtam gyis skyon cha sel bar byed/ /gnod byed zas kyis tshe srog 'phrog par byed/ /smyo byed chang gis rang gzhan phung bar byed/ /lta bu tshig gcig mtshungs pa dang /lhag bsam bsam dkar dgos pa med bsam bsam/ /dpag bsam bsam 'phel rang la byung bsam bsam /gang bsam bsam pa myur du bsgrub bsam bsam/ /rang bsam bsam don 'grub na dga' bsam bsam/ /lta bu tshig gnyis mtshungs pa'o/ /lnga/ mtha' thog dbus gsum gyi tshig gcig gam gnyis mtshungs pa'i dper brjod ni/zab rgyas lnga rig zab gnad 'tsho bzhin zab/ /zab cing phra ba'i zab mo'i don snyongs zab/ /zab rgu tshang ba'i zab gsal dper don zab/ /zab lam legs ston zab yang gdams pa zab /lta ba tshig gcig mtshungs pa dang /mtshar mtshar 'dren byed bcud du mtshar mtshar gnas chen bsam yas dgon mtshar mtshar/ /mtshar mtshar gling bzhi gling brgyad mtshar mtshar lcags ri phyi nang gnyis mtshar mtshar /mtshar mtshar jo bo rang byon mtshar mtshar mkhan slob chos gsum sku mtshar mtshar/ /152
mtshar mtshar gser gyi rgya phibs mtshar mtshar de bzhin gan ji ra mtshar mtshar/ /lta bu tshig gnyis mtshungs pa'o/ /drug mtha' dang thog ma'i tshig gcig sbyar ba'i zung ldan gyi dper brjod ni/rin bral mi rigs srid jus ma las lhag /lhag don tshogs chen bcu gnyis dgongs don zab/ /zab gnad yig yong drug pa'i srid jus brtan/ /brtan nying mthun sgril can bzhi'i bod gsar bskrun/ /lta bu dang /mtha' dang thog ma'i tshig gnyis sbyar ba'i dper brjod ni/rin chen rgyan gyis spud pa'i rab mdzes sku/ /mdzes sku dri med ston gyi nya zla bzhin/ /zla bzhin mig la mngar ba'i rab mdzes ma/ /mdzes ma khyed ni yid kyi chom rkun bzhin/ /lta bu/bdun/ gang rung mnyam du bsres pa rab spel zung ldan gyi dper brjod ni/de skad snying don don bzang rtsom gyi phul/ /phul byung snyan tshig tshig phreng ro mngar ba/ /ma lang rkang gnyis gnyis med mkhas grub nas/ /nas rdog ltar chung chung ngu'i blo yis bris/ /153
zhes pa lta bu'o/ /zhar byung snyan gzhung du gsung pa'i bzlas pa'i zung ldan zhes pa mi rtsom 'bri dngos la dgos pa che bar ma mthong ba ni/dper na/rkang pa lam gsum bzlas pa'i dper brjod cig na/'od kyis rnam par rgyas par byed/ /'od kyis rnam par rgyas par byed/ /'od kyis rnam par rgyas par byed/ /'od kyis rnam par rgyas par byed/ /ces pa la bsam na dgos mkho de tsam med pa tshang mas mkhyen shag red snyam mo/:rtsa ba༈bya dka' sgra rgyan nang gses drug /'dra min kun bzang 'khor los gcig /tshis gam rkang pa bzlog pas gnyis/ /nges spo bzhi bcas drug yin no/ /bya dka' ba'i sgra rgyan la bsdu na nang gses drug yod de/1 rtsom tshul mi 'dra ba'i kun bzang 'khor lo/2 tshig gam rkang pa bzlog pa'i zung ldan/3 dbyangs nges pa/4 gsal byed nges pa/5 gnas nges pa/154
6 dbyangs med par nges pa bcas so/gcig kun bzang 'khor lo zhes pa ni thun min gī rtsol rtsal la brten nas tshig gre/cig gis gcig go gnyis chod dang / gsum chod byas kyang tshig sbyor la gnod pa med par mtha' nas dkyil dang / dbus na dbus/ yang na ji ltar bklags kyang don ston nus pa'i sgra rgyan khyad par can 'ig yin/sngar kun 'khor ni dgon pa'i sgo 'phyor sogs kyi ldebs ris ngos bris pa ches mang zhing / kun 'khor gyi tha snyad 'grel tshul la yang / phyi ltar tshig gi me tog nang lta ra don gyi nor bu/gsang ba 'khor ba'i dpe ris zhes phyi nang gsal gsum gyi thog nas go ba len rgyu yod par grags/deng char la 'a sa kun 'khor sna tshogs shog bu'i steng bris nas rang khyim gyi gyang ngos su sbyar ba dang/ la 'a sa yig gzugs 'grems ston du bshams pa sogs kun 'khor ni tshang mas das 'a po byed pa'i snyan rtsom dang / ri mo gcig go gnyis chod du gyur 'dug spyir kun 'khor 'bri stangs ha cang mang po yod cing / mab/ sa pa so so 'i rtsom rtsa ya ltar kun 'khor gas ra pa'i bzo dbyibs gsar rtsom ya nga byas chog pa zhig yin mod sngon byon ma khas pas mdzad pa'i kun 'khor nang nas gru bzhi kha gang ma'i bzo dbyibs dang sgor sgor nya zla'i cha rdzogs pa gnyis shin tu mdzes par snang bas kho bo'i bsam par kun 'khor de gnyis dbon pa'i gyang ngos sam yang na shog bu'i steng bris na shin tu mdzes par mthong nges snyam/
gnyis/ tshig gam rkang pa bzlog pa'i zung ldan la gnyis yod de/dang po tshig bcad bzlog pa'i dper brjod ni/mdzes shing mdzes la g.yer zhing g.yer/ /mtshar zhing mtshar la bzad cing brjid/ /mdzes ldan shes rig lnga ldan spyod/ /spyod ldan lnga rig shes ldan mdzes/ /lta bu dang /(tshig bcad phyed bzlog pa zhig yod kyang spyir 'di dang 'dra'o/)gnyis pa/rkang pa bzlog pa'i dper brjod ni/bsam pa legs pa skyid pa bsam /bsam pa skyid pa legs pa bsam/ /yong ba mnar dang sdug pa bkod/ /bkod pa sdug dang mnar ba yong/ /lta bu'o/ /(nang gses gzhan yod kyang 'dis mtshon no/)gsum/ dbyangs nges par nang gses bzhi yod kyang dbyangs gcig nges pa kho na bya dka' bar 'dod de/dper brjod ni/tshul gsum lhun grub zung 'jug rgyu mthun sku/ /rdzu 'phrul nus mthu dug gsum bdud btul gsung / /gzhung lugs chu klung kun 'dus sgyu 'phrul thugs/ /157
yul gru kun tu phul byung sku gsung thugs / /tshes pa lta bu dbyangs u nges pa'o/ /bzhi/ gsal byed nges pa ni/ ka nas a bar gyi gsar byed sum cu gang rung gcig kho na nges pa ste/dper na/gya gyu'i grogs bsgrigs rgan gon gyong gis rgud/ /dge brgya'i grogs bsgrigs gyod sgyug rgan rgon dga'/ /gya gyur dgra grogs gad rgyangs bgad sgra dgod/ /dge brgyar dga' dga'i mgur glur rgyan gyis brgyan/ /zhes pa dang lta bu gsal byed 88ga ha kho na nges pa'o/ /('di la'ang nang gses yod kyang gsal byed gcig nges pa bya dka' bar mngon )lnga/ gnas nges pa ni/ skye gnas brgyad po gang rung nges pa ste/'di la'ang nang gses bzhi yod kyang gnas gcig tu nges pa kho na bya dka' bar 'dod dper brjod ni/dpal dpal 'phags pa'i ma smad me zlum pas/ /mang mang bod 'bangs mun par mar me spar/ /dman dman rmong pa'i smag mun rmeg med 'joms/ /'phel 'phel rnam pa'i dpag med phung po spel/ /zhes pa lta bu gnas 66mchu ga kho na nges pa'o/ /drug dbyangs med par nges par ni/ dbyangs bzhi ste/ gi gu/zhabs kyu/ 'greng po/ na ro bcas gcig kyang med pa la zer/ sngar gyi snyan 158
'grel dper brjod nang 'di la dbyangs 66a ga nges pa zhes gsungs yod kyang kho bo ni a yig dbyangs su mi 'dod pas dbyangs med par nges pa zhes brjod par 'dod/ dper brjod ni/bdag la gson dang skal bzang bsam gtan lags/ /byams pa brlag nas bar snang 'ja' ltar yal/ /gang sar btsal yang ngal ba tsam lags pas/ /lha ldan sa char nan tan blta ba bzang /zhes pa lta bu dbyangs med par nges pa'o/rtsa ba/bod yig gsal byed sum cu ste/ /ka mad ltar la brgyus pa'i phreng / /rtsom tshul dka' sla sna tshogs pa/ /bod kyi dmigs bsal sgra rgyan yin/ /rang cag bod yig gi gsal byed sum cu mu tig ltar la brgyus pa lta bu'i ka bshad ces bya ba 'di la rtsom tshul bya dka' ba dang / sla ba// 'bring ba sogs sna tshogs yod pa dang / de ni gangs can bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sgra rgyan khyad par can 'ig yin pas 'di sgra rgyan gyi kha skong du nges par 'jug dgos snyam/'on kyang mkhas dbang la las 'di sgra rgyan min par bzhed cing / de'i grub byed du 66'di sgra rgyan gzhan dang mi 'dra ba rta de bkod gnang mdzad 'dug kyang de ltar na snyan gzhung las bstan pa'i sgra rgyan gyi nang gses phan tshun yang khyad par chen po yod pa tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar yin pas mi 'dra 159
ba tsam gyis de'i khongs su mi tshud pa ga la khyab/ dper na/ gdong ris dang gzugs stobs che chung mi 'dra ba'i mi kun mi'i khongs su tshud dang mi tshud la bsam na des spyi dang bye brag gi dbye ba shes pa gyur ro/ /des na spyir ka bshad ces pa ka mad sum cu rim bzhin tshig rkang re'i thog mar bkod pa la zer yang phyis mkhas pa so so'i thugs rtsal las 'khrungs pa'i rtsom tshul ci rigs spyad yod pas nang gses shin tu mang yang 'dir dpe mtshon tsam bkod na/ka nas a bar ka phreng bsgrigs pa'i snyan tshig phreng ba ka ni ka /kha ljongs ha lo'i kha 'bras bzhin du rnam par bkra ba'i ge sar kha/ /ga ler sa steng gu sar khyab pa'i kun slong 'gog med chu gang ga /nga yis sha dzes da cag gzhon nu'i mgrin tshab ma skul rang mos nga/ /zhes pa lta bu bya dka' ba'i ka bshad do/ /rtsa ba/de ltar sgra rgyan mu tig phreng / /rtsom gyi mgul du ches mdzes kyang / /tshig sbyor snyan zhing 'jibs pa las/ /rdo chag btsan sgrig byed mi rung / /de ltar sgra rgyan zhes pa'i rtsom tshul mu tig phreng ba lta bu 'di ni snyam rtsom bu mo'i mgul du ches cher mdzes kyang nges par du tshig sbyor snyan zhing 'jebs pa dgos pa las sgra rgyan u tshugs kyis sbyar mi rung zhing / gal te sbyar na gzhan gyis klog dus rna bar mi snyan pa ma zad skabs re don yang 'khrul bar 'gyur ro/ / 160
rtsa ba/gab tshig ces pa sgra yi rgyan/ /dngos min rig pa'i dri tshig tsam/ / dbye ba bcu drug gsungs na yang / /bsdu dang dka' dang sla ba gnyis/ /spyir gab tshig 'di bzhin snyan ngag le'u gsum pa'i khongs su yod kyang de ni sgra rgyan dngos min par rig pa'i 'dri tshig tsam yin/gzhan yang 'di la nang gses dbye ba bcu drug yod par gsungs kyang bsdu na bya dka' ba'i gab tshig dang / bya sla ba'i gab tshig gnyis las ma 'das shing / de dag kyang sgra rgyan min par don rgyan du 'dod pas 'dir dper brjod 'god pa'i ngal ba ma byas so/ /rtsa ba/ skyon sel le'u dang po'i khongs/ /bzhag na 'os shing mtshams pa ste/ /tshig rgyan gang dang gang la yang / /thog mar skyon sel shes pa gal/ /kho bo'i bsam par snyan gzhung nang le'u gsum par 'khod pa'i skyon sel zhes pa de le'u dang po'i khongs su bzhag na 'os shing mtshams par mthong ba ste/ rgyu mtshan ni/ tshig rgyan gang dang gang la'ang nges par du skyon sel dgos pas snyan ngag sbyong mkhan las dang po ba rnams kyis thog mar snyan ngag gi dge skyon shes na phan pa che bar bsams nas kho bos 'di le'u dang po'i khongs su bzhag yod kyang 'dir rgyu mtshan brjod pa skabs su ma babs pas 161
rjes su kho bo'i brtsam byar gzigs gnang yod pa zhu/rtsa ba/de skad sgra rgyan chu phran brgya/ /'du ba'i gser zam gsar pa'i steng / /tshig rgyan rig pa'i sku mgron rnams/ /mgyogs nas myur du phebs par smon/ /de skad sgra yi rgyan chu phran brgya phrag dang brgya phrag gcig tu 'dra ba'i gser gyi zam pa gsar pa 'di yi steng tshig rgyan rig pa la dgyes pa'i sku mgron rnams mgyogs nas myur du phebs te gangs can snyan ngag gi bstan pa sngar las dar zhing rgyas par smon no/ zhes sgo gsum gus pa'i smon pa dang bcas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /smras pa/sngon sbyang shes rab bdag la ga la yod/ /da ltar 'bri klog sbyang pa'ang mthar ma son/ /'on te mig mthong lag zin dgos dbang la/ /ga'i gas nas sngon med gsar spros kho bos byas/ /:rdzogs so/ /162
〈gling sgrung 〉gi mi sna gtso bo gi sar rgyal po'i gzugs brnyan de bas 'thus tshang du gtong rgyu'i skor gyi dran 'char thor bu/yod med ma nges pa'i las dbang zhig gis kho bo rtsom rig sga thang chen nas srid 'dzin gyi lam la glo bur du ded/'on kyang lo ngo nyi shu'i ring gi bag chags zab mo skad cig tsam yang ga la brjed/khom pa yod tshad la thos pa 'tshol bzhin myong tshor 'bri ba rbad de lang du shor/ma gzhi blo rig co ga'i rtsal gyis shes bya'i nam 'phang mi chod pa sngar nas rtogs zin mod/gangs ljongs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal de bas dar rgyas gong 'phel dang / de bas phun sum tshogs su phyin na ci ma rung snyam pa'i kun slong ni/ dkar gsal zla ba min yang zla ba las nag pa med la/ dwangs bsil bdud rdzi min yang bdud tsi las rnyog pa med/de yang snyan pa'i grags pa 'dzam gling yul gru kun la khyab pa'i rang cag bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus snyan ngag ring po 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉 ni 'dzam gling thog ches ring shos dang / ches phun sum tshogs pa'i lo rgyus snyan 163
ngag cig yin pas/ rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉'tshol bsdu dang / myur skyob/ dpar bskrun/ zhib 'jug sogs kyi bya bar mthong ha cang chen po gnang ba'i 'og ngo mtshar gsang ba dpog par dka' ba'i sgrung pa mkhas can mang po'i zhal rgyun gyi gangs ri las 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉gi chu rgyun 'dzad med du babs nas sna kha dang ring thung mi gcig pa'i sgrung deb ha cang mang po zhig par skrun 'grems spel gnang dang gnang mus yin la/ dus mtshungs mkhas dbang mang pos zhib 'jug gnad 'khel gnang ba'i dpyad rtsom yang grangs las 'das pa zhig rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu ngoms rgyu yod pa ni ches dga' 'os pa'i grub 'bras shig yin pa bsnyon du med/tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉ni lo rgyus kyi snyan ngag ring po zhig yin la/ snyan ngag gi brtsams sgrung ring po zhig kyang yin pas sgrung de'i nang gson nyams ldan pa'i mi sna ha cang mang po zhig gsar bzhings byas yod pa de dag yod do cog gi nang nas mi sna gtso bo ni gling ge sar rgyal po kho na yin pa mkhas brgya rtsod med mgrin gcig yin pa smos ga la dgos/'on kyang gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed 〉stod cha'i nang du 66 rgyal mchog nor bu dgra 'dul de nyid kyis bdud klu btsan la thod mda' sprad nas lo gnyis dang zla ba gsum song / mdzad pa 'phrin las phyi yol ma byung phyin/ lo gnyis la gling du phyag phebs rgyu gnang mod/ me bza' klu 'bum skyid kyis bzhes/ 'khrungs la mun chu dwangs med ril bu btab nas skyems su gsol bas/ snga rabs phyis 'byung thams cad bsnyel te 164
nag thom me ba'i ngang du bdud mkhar la lta khang bzhengs rgyu bdud sde bran la rtsis su 'debs rgyu mtha' dag 'phro can du lus te/ ci yin 'di min du lo gnyis dang zla ba bcu song 'dug ga gces 'khod yod pa 'dis 〈gling sgrung 〉nang gi mi sna gtso bo gling ge sar rgyal po'i rlabs che ba'i gzugs brnyan de phran bu'i nyams dmas su btang 'dug snyam/gang lags she na/ 〈gling sgrung 〉 nang gi mi sna gtso bo gling ge sar rgyal po 86snga rabs phyis 'byung thams cad bsnyel te nag thom me ba'i ngang ci yin 'di min du lo gnyis dang zla ba bcu song 'dug ha ces zer na de'i ring gi 〈gling sgrung 〉la mi sna gtso bo ge sar rgyal po med par gyur pa dang gcig gling ge sar rgyal po'i gzugs brnyan ni mi phyed lha phyed cig yin pas rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes la thogs pa med pa zhig yin na/ bzhes 'khrungs la mun chu dwangs med ril bu btab pa'i gsang ba ji bzhin mkhyen thub pa ma zad/ ril bu de 'dra zhig gis sku lus la gnod pa'ang gtong mi thub pa dang gnyis/ gal te ge sar rgyal po'ang skye bo gzhan dang 'dra bas mun chu dwangs med ril bus gnod thub zer na 〈gling sgrung 〉gzhan tshang ma'i nang du yod pa'i gling ge sar rgyal po'i rdzu 'phrul dang mdzad pa mtha' dag rdzun du 'gyur ba dang gsum sogs 'gal tshig lo 'dab mang po'i rtsa ba 'di kho nar thug pa ma zad/ sgyu rtsal kho na'i steng nas bshad na'ang mi sna gtso bo bag la nyal ba ni cung zad mi rung bar sems so/'on kyang gling ge sar rgyal po bdud yul du bzhugs ring me bza' 'bum skyed kyis mun chu dwangs med ril bu btab nas snga rabs dang phyis 'byung gi bya ba thams cad brjed de bdud yul du yun ring bzhugs pa'i ring ༷ 165
la hor gyis seng lcam 'brug mo btsan 'phrog byas pa'i skor de ni yig thog dang / kha rgyun gnyis gar yongs su grags pa'i 〈gling sgrung 〉zhig yin pas lo rgyus kyi snyan ngag ring shos sam/ snyan ngag gi brtsams sgrung ring shos 'dzam gling kun tu snyan grags ldan pa der sus kyang bzo bcos rgyag mi phod la rgyag kyang mi rung ba mgo nag kun gyis shes gsal lags na/ ji ltar byas te 〈gling sgrung nyinang gi mi sna gtso bo gling ge sar rgyal po'i gzugs brnyan de bas gson nyams dod pa zhig gsar bzhengs dang / ji ltar byas te 〈gling sgrung 〉 re gnyis nang mi sna gtso bo nus med du gyur pa kha gsab bya dgos she na/ bya ba de ni rnyog dra dang dka' ngal ches che ba zhig yin zhing de ni rig pa 'di la spyan dkyus ring ba'i mkhas dbang rnam pa'i bgo skal kho na yin pa las blo dman bdag lta bus the jus bya yul ga la yin/ 'on kyang ring nas yid kyi chu mtshor 'gog med gsal ba'i rmongs 'char zhig kun la dpyad gzhir 'bul 'dod kyi kun slong gis sor rtse dbang med du bskul ba 'di lta ste/nga tshos mig mda' sna rtser 'phangs te mno bsam zhib tu btang na/tshad mas grub pa'i gzhung lugs gcig dang / gnad la 'khel ba'i srid jus gcig yang na yid dbang 'phrog pa'i sgyu rtsal gcig dang / phul du byung ba'i rtsom rig gcig sogs tshang ma spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang / spyi tshogs kyi lag len nang nas rim bzhin 'thus sgo tshang du song ba dang / rim bzhin je legs je rgyas su song ba zhig yin pa las thog ma nyid nas ches yang dag pa dang / ches cha tshang ba zhig med pa ni/ dper na/ 'dzam gling thog sus kyang 'gran par mi nus pa'i dpa' bo zhig la cha mtshon na'ang / dpa' bo de thog mar bltams pa'i dus nas drag rtsal gyi kho lag yongs su rdzogs pa zhig 'byung 166

dpyad rtsom bung ba'i mgrin glu/ba〈dpyad brjod mkhas pa 'dzum shor 〉la dpyad pa/skal ldan yid mgu'i gzhung lugs rgyab ri brtan/ /bzang po'i dus mthun gsar gtod mdun lam yangs/ /ye bral phyogs ris kun slong ston gyi zla/ /shes rab rgya mtsho'i klong rdol 'jig rten mig /bsil ljongs rtsom rig nor 'dzin yangs po na/ /sna tshogs brtsams bya'i chu klung yod do cog /dwangs bar byed pa'i nor bu'i mchog gyur ni/ /dpyad brjod ke ta ka las gzhan du gang / /mdzes pa yid 'phrog lha mo'i zhal ras dang / /mi sdug spre'u rgan mo'i ngo gdong gnyis/ /nga mdzes khyed mdzes zer nas rtsod don ci/ /dpyad brjod me long nang nas lham mer gsal/ /ring nas 'chad pa las kyang rtsod pa dka'/ /242
