mdor na kho bo'i lta bar snyan ngag dang rtsom rig ni spyi dang bye brag yin par 'dod/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa/ snyan rtsom 〈lha ldan bar bskor gyi mthong thos 〉zhes par dpyad pa/snyan ngag mkhan po tshe rdor lags kyis mdzad pa'i snyan rtsom 〈lha ldan bar bskor gyi mthong thos 〉 zhes pa der thun mong laṃ yin pa'i khyad chos shig 'dug pa ni/ snyan rtsom hril po go dka' ba'i brda rnying dang mngon brjod kyis ma bcings par brjod pa bde la rna bar snyan pa/ brjod bya'i don dwangs chu'i nang gi rde'u ji bzhin gsal ba'i khyad chos mngon gyin 'dug de yang phul du byung ba'i snyan rtsom zhig gi brjod don ngo ma dang / de'i rgyab ljongs/ de'i dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos dang dmigs 'ben sogs ji ma ji bzhin brjod par shin tu dka' yang kho bos thol byung gis snyan rtsom 'di'i dge mtshan rang gis mthong ba rnams ri mo'i lam du 'god par bya ste/1 de yang snyan rtsom 'di'i brjod don ni kha byang du gsal ba ltar rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba'i khor yug tu gnas pa'i 〈lha ldan bar bskor gyi mthong thos 〉ngo ma yin zhing / 88mthong thos 93 zhes pa'i yig 'bru gnyis po de ni ha cang gnad la 'khel ba'i tha snyad cig yim te/ 66mthong nya zhes pa ni rtsom pa pos dngos su gzigs myong ba/ dper na/ bar bskor gyi khrom ra dang /phyag 'tshal skor sbyong byed mkhan/ lo rgyus don snying ldan pa'i khang bzang sogs dang / 88thos nyag zhes pa ni rtsom pa pos dngos su gzigs myong med kyang rgyal po'i gzim shag yin pa dang / gtsug lag khang gi sa rdo lhag mas bskrun 336
par grags pa'i dpal rab khang gsar/ jus yag dar chen lta bu'o/ /snyan rtsom 'dir khyon sho lo ka brgya yod pa las thog ma'i sho lo ka sa nyis te/88mtha' bzhi gangs ris bskor ba bho ṭa'i yul/ /sa mtho rlung gtsang chu klung chen po'i 'go/ /rab dkar gangs ris mthon thing nam mkha' 'de ṭa/ /bgrang yas mtshe'u maṇḍal gcal lta ra bkrams/ /cing thang gshin po nam/ mkha'i khyon yangs por/ /khyung dkar mdzo phos rgod po'i rtsal la 'gran/ ༈mu med rtswa thang g.yu yi gzhong pa ru/ /dkar nag phyugs zog mdzes pa'i phra rgyan btabs/ / rtagzhes pa 'di gnyis ni gleng slong ba'i gzhi ma'i tshul du rang cag bod kha ba can gyi ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i yul ljongs dang / nor bu'i gter dang 'dra ba'i zhing 'brog thon skyed kyi che ba brjod pa yin pa dang / de nas 88kha ba'i ljongs kyi nya lcebs khog yangs por nya〉 zhes pa nas 66rab mdzes tshon snas lha ldan grong khyer brgyan ga zhes pa'i bar gyi sho lo ka bcu gsum 'di dag gis lha sa grong khyer gyi khor yug gam nang khul du gnas pa'i skyed chu sngon mo dang / pho brang po ta la sogs lha sa spyi'i thun min che ba brjod pa dang / de nas 66rgyu skar dbus su rgyu skar rgyal po nyid ha: zhes pa nas 88sa gzhi chen po nyi ma'i 'od kyis drod lta 'es pa'i bar gyi sho lo ka bdun cus bar bskor khor yug gi mthong thos ji ma ji bzhin 'ib cing phra bar brjod mthar mjug rtsom sho lo ka gcig ste/88nyin mos mtshan mthud mtshan mos nyin mor sbrel/ /337
mkhas grub kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod bdam sa sgrig————nyin zla lo yi srad bur brgyus pa yi/ /bar bskor khrom gyi lo rgyus phreng ba dag /lce brgyar sprul yang ma 'u sa brjod par dka'/ / :jizhes phul byung gi rgyan spyad de mjug bsdu gnang mdzad/ /de ltar rtsom pa pos ri bong tshang nas don pa lta bu'i glo bur ma yin par mtsho mjal gyi rlabs ris zhal khebs dal bus phye ba ltar thog mar bod spyi dang / de nas lha sa grong khyer spyi/ de nas brjod don ngo ma bar bskor gyi mthong thos gsal bar bstan/ da dung mjug rtsom nang gong du bshad pa des kyang mi tshad bshad nas bshad tshar rgyu med ces mi rnams de bas bar bskor gyi snod bcud la ha las su bcug pa dang / rang gi 'chad rgyur lus pa rnams bshad ma tshar ba'i khongs su bsdus pa ni ches khyad du 'phags pa'i rtsom rtsal zhig yin par mngon no/ /2 tsom pa pos yun ring zhib tshags ngang bar bskor khrom rwa'i skar tshogs thang la bkrams pa lta bu'i dngos zog dang / tshong pa so so'i khyad chos dang / sems khams sogs la nyam/sa zhib nan tan gnang nas bcos ma'i g.ya' dang bral ba'i bar bskor gyi khrom rwa zhig kun la me long nang nas bstan pa bzhin ngo sprod gnang 'dug pa/: dper na/66shad ma spu phrug snam bu ther ma dang / /gos chen dru'u tse tog se 'bu yi ras/ /skra snum skra tshos sha gso sa dri zhim chu/ /lag 'dub sor gdub skra sping rna yi rgyan/ /rgya gling dung chen dril bu sbub chal dang / /338
dpe cha phyag phreng thang ga gser zangs sku/ /mchod kong mchod ting mda' dar lha reg spos/ /yung dkar dza ti dmar stsa tig ta tir/ /zhog khog 'a phug tshag sha zho 'o ma/ /'bri mar sog mar shing mar kring gi mar/ /bod ja mngar ja spi rag nas kyi chang / /bod thug sha mog sha 'bras sha kha tsha/ / ga zhes pa sogs bza' bca' dang / gyon chas / nyer mkho'i dngos po sogs bar skor khrom gzhung du yod pa'i rgya zog bod zog grangs gis mi langs pa dag snyan ngag mkhan po'i sor rtses rigs so so 'ib par dbye nas brjod bde'i ngag gi phreng ba la bkod pa'i tshe na gcig nas snyan ngag mkhan po de nyid bar skor khrom gzhung la rgyus mnga' gting zab yod pa'i tshor snang zhig dang / gnyis nas snyan rtsom sho lo ka so so'i nang du tshud pa'i dngos zog gi go rim sgrig stangs la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan zhing mtshams 'dir rang bzhin brjod pa'i snyan ngag rgyan gyi ngo mtshar khyad yon ma lus legs par thon 'dug snyam pa lags/thag ring rgya nag yul gyi tshong pa tshos/ /rgya zog lag tu thogs te bar skor bskor/ /sgra mi dag pa'i bod skad tshig re gnyis/ /kha nas 'don te tshong zog brin thabs byas/ /yul 'dir skyes pa'i tshong pa lha sa bas/ /tshong khang phye ste tshong zog sgrom du bcug / 339
tshong zog brin min snang 'jog cher med par/ /ca co'i gtam la g.yeng nas dus 'da'o/ /zhes pa'i tshig bcad sho lo ka gnyis kyis bar bskor khrom gzhung du gnas pa'i rgya rigs tshong pa dang / lha sa ba tshong pa so so'i tshong rgyag stangs zhib par bkod pa las tshong pa sna tshogs kyi snang brnyan gson po zhig tshig nyung ngus bskrun bzhengs thub 'dug pa de yang snyan ngag mkhan po'i rig pa'i rtsal las 'khrungs pa'i 'bras bzang yin pa smos med thog bar bskor khrom gzhung du gnas pa'i bem po'i zog nas gang zag skye bo 'ib 'bri gnang de don che don chung snga phyi go mi ldog cing / snyan ngag sho lo ka de gnyis snyan ngag rtsom hril po khri 'phang mthon por 'dzegs par skas kyi gdang bu 'phar ma/ 'ig bsnan pa lta bu'i nus pa thon 'dug go/2 bar skor khrom lam ni 'dzam gling yang rtser gnas pa'i gna' bo'i grong khyer lha sa'i rgyan lta bu zhig yin 'dug na 'dir rgyal khongs dang mi rigs mi gcig pa'i tshong pa dang / gzigs bskor ba mang po 'dzoms te khrom gzhung 'khrugs po zhig tu gyur yod pas yul 'dir kha rtsod lag rtsod dang / rkun ma de bzhin las mi 'dod pa'i slong mo ba/ za za'i chos kyis 'tsho thabs byed po sogs tshul min yod srid kyang / snyan ngag mkhan pos gnas mchog lha sa zhes pa ni ming don mtshungs pa'i gnas khyad par can zhig yin pa dang / bod mi rigs ni las la brtson zhing / shes rig bkra ba/ ya rabs bzang spyod/byams snying rje bla na med pas rang rgyud dul ba zhig yin pa'i tshad mtho'i ngos 'dzin sa zhig nas gzigs te tshul min spyod tshul de dag la dma' mi 'byin par drangs phyogs kyi thog nas zhib par bkod 'bri gnang yod pa de la dge 340
dpyad rtsom mdzub mo ri ston/———— ————mtshan gang legs ldan mo snyam ste 'dir sho lo ka gsum drangs pa 'di lta ste/88lha sa'i bar skor khrom/ lam 'di'i steng du/rgyal khongs mi gcig mi rigs tha dad pa'i/tshong pa 'dzoms kyang kha rtsod 'thab mo'i rigs /rig rgyu dkon la tham sa cad 'i bar gnas/khrom lam dkyil du dge 'dun bsod snyoms bas/rnga spubs dkrol te 'al ton bar med byed/bar skor skor mkhan dad ldan bod mi tshos/dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur gya nom byas/dbang po mi tshang na so cher rgas pa/lto gos phongs te nyam thag gnas la lhung /mthe bong ker nas slo/nga mo'i gral la bzhugs/byang sems can tshos kho tsho bor mi bya/lta zhes pa la sogs ni kho bo'i bas ma par bar skor dang mi rigs kyi che ba brjod pa tsam ma zad shin tu 'jam pa'i legs bshad go rgyu mang po yod pa 'ig yin pas ngan shor ba rnams la dma' 'bebs dang zur za byas pa las 'jam po'i blo 'gugs byas na nus pa che ba thon par nges snyam/ de ya nga yin te/ji skad du/'jam pos 'jam po 'dul ba yin / /'jam pos rtsub po('ang 'dul ba yin/ /thes pa ltar ro/ /
mkhas grub kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod bdams sgrigwa sneb———— ——ge ge ge wa—bge ge ——wa ngag wawa4 snyan rtsom 'di'i nang rtsom pa pos da dung gling chen bdun la snyan pa 'phur ba'i lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang / gser gyi/ lhun po lta bur brdzid pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne/ rin bral lo rgyus kyi dpang po sring ching rdo ring / shod srol ngo mtshar can jo bo dbu skra/ lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i dar chen dang mchod rten/ grags can bzhugs mkhar bla brang rnying pa dang bsam grub pho brang sogs lo rgyus don snying ldan pa'i gna' shul skad grags can mang po 'ig ngo sprod gnang ba dang chabs cig grags can mi sna 'ga' zhig gi bzhugs yul dang / mdzad rjes la dran gso gnang ba ma zad rtsom pa po rang nyid bar skor nang khyim rten btsubs pa'i lo rgyus ches mdor bsdus su bkod pas snyan rtsom 'di nyid 66shel brag mtho ba'i sga nga la/ sprin bzang dkar po'i rgya phebs/ o rgyan mtshar ba'i/ sgang la rin chen o rgyan pad zhwa nya zhes pa ltar rjod byed tshig sbyor snyan pa'i steng la brjod bya'i nang don shin tu phun sum/ tshogs pas snyan rtsom de ni ro brgya'i zas dang bdud rtsi'i btung ba ji ba'i na spyad de ngoms pa med pa lta bu zhig snang ngo / /4 snyan rtsom 〈lha ldan bar bskor gyi ma thong thos 〉zhes pa 'di'i rjod byed tshig sbyor ni gong du zhus pa lta ra kha gsal la go bde ba/ tshig sbyo ra spu gra snyom pa ma zad rtsom gshis thad skabs 'gar rgya rigs kyi gzhas ma gtam 〈mgyogs bshad nyi dang / bod rigs kyi ga 'as ma gtam 〈'bras dkar 〉rtsom tshul gyi khyad chos kyang lda na 'dug pa dper na/ snyan rtsom 'di'i nang /66'bri mar sog mar shing mar kring gi mar/ /bod thug sha mog sha 'bras sha kha tsha/ /myang zhwa wa zhwa lpags zhwa rgya gar zhwa/ /342
ko ltam 'gyigs lham ras lham spu ma 'i lham/ / ’zhes pa'i brjod tshig 'di dag ngag bde pos dbyangs su gyer na snya/na 'ing dgos bro ba gzhas ma gtam gyi khyad chos mngon gsal can 'ig thon par nges /ga 'an yang snyan rtsom 'di'i nang snyan gzhung nang gsal rgyan yang ha cang ma nga po 'ig spyar sa nang ma dzad 'dug pa/ dper na/ma/tha' bzhi gangs ris bskor ba bho ṭa'i yul/ /sa ma tho rlung gtsang chu klung chen po'i 'go/ / lta bu rang ba'i na brjod pa'i rgyan dang / /gtsang chab sngon po skyed ma'i nu 'o ba'i na/ /ring ro/ nyid nas bdag cag drin gyis bskyangs/ /lta bu dpe rgyan dang /bsgyur bcos sgo dbye'i srid jus nyin byed gsal/ /ra nga dbang ljongs rgyu'i pad dkar 'dab ma grol/ /lta bu gzugs rgyan dang /nyin mo las la brel ba'i bar skor yang / /ngal bas dub ste rim bzhin gnyid la yur/ /lta bu rab btags kyi rgyan dang /kham sa nas yong pa'i a pho tshong pa tsho/ /gzugs stobs che 'ing phrom gyi dkyil du langs / /lta bu nyams ldan gyi rgyan dang /lha sa zhes bya gna' bo'i grong 'di la/ /
gna' bo'i shul rdzas mang bas grags pa che/ /bar skor khrom gyi lo rgyus phreng ba dag /lce brgyar sprul yang ma lus brjod par dka'/ /lta bu phul byung gi rgyan dang / ga a na yang gsal byed kyi rgyan dang /rab spel gyi rgyan sogs mang du mchis shing / de dag kyang rdo chag btsan sgrig byas pa lta bu ma yin par tshig gi phreng ba tshar du dngar ba kun gyi 'dren byed dgyes pa'i bdud tsir 'khums /'o na snyan rtsom 'dir zhan cha spu tsam yang med dam 'e na/ de 'dra gtan nas yin mi srid kyang kho bo'i rnam/ dpyod kyi me long mi gtsang bas ji tsam bltas kyang zhan cha'i gzugs brnyan mi gsal/ 'om te kho bos 'ol tshod byas na snyan rtsom 'di'i nang gi/88thag ring rgya nag yul gī tshong pa tshos/ /rgya zog lag tu thogs te bar skor bskor/ /sgra mi dag pa'i bod skad tshig re gnyis/ /kha nas 'don te tshong phrog brin thabs byas/ / nyanyazhes pa'i nang gi tshig rkang gsum pa 86 sgra mi dag pa'i bod skad tshig re gnyis 〉〉 zhes pa de snyan ngag gi skyon bcu'i nang gses bdun pa gcod mtshams nyams pa'i skyon du mthong ste/ji skad du/ngal gso yod med lugs dang 'gal/ /de ni gcod mtshams nyams pa'i skyon/ ༈zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/344
gyel na yang /64lo ngo stong gcig sum rgya tsam gong du/ /rgya bza' bal bza' srong btsan khab tu bcos/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar ba'i jo bo'i sku/ /lha sa'i gtsug lag khang ge rten du 'dren/ / ji zhes pa'i nang gi tshig rkang bzhi pa'i tshig bar mtha' ma'i 88'dren nya zhes pa dus gsum 'chol ba'i skyon du mthong bas 'das tshig ste 88 drangs lta yin dgos snyam/'on kyang de dag rtsom pa pos mi mkhyen pa ga la srid kyang thugs g.yeng du shor ba'am yang na par skyon yin pa'ang srid/ ma zad kho bor smra rgyu gzhan ma rnyed pas sa bcad ma stong tsam du bris pa 'di dag kyang yin min cha 'tshal bas bzod par gsol zhes snyim pa brang khar zum ste zhu'o/ /bzhi pa/ bod kyi snga rtsom 〈gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod 〉la dpyad pa zhes pa'i rtsom yi ga bltas rjes kyi myong tshor/dpyad rtsom 'di ni rtsom pa pos snyan ngag gi rgyan tshar du dngar zhing /sdeb legs tshig phreng mu tig star la brgyus pa lta bu'i grags can gyi snga rtsom 〈gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod 〉la dpyad pa gnang ba zhig yin pas kho bo'i bsam par dpyad rtsom 'di lebs nyes ji 'dra zhig yin min la ma bstod par thog mar rtsom pa pos rtogs brjod 'di la dpyad pa gnang ba ni gnang rin yod pa zhig yin par sems/1 de yang rtsom pa pos sngon du rtogs brjod 'di rgya gzhung yin dang /345
mkhas grub kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod bdams sgrigwa bgo——— ——wa 4 4 zla— —wa gob—yang na bod sa zhung yin min dpyad pa gnang ba ste 8 rtogs brjod kyi ma jug byang du rtsom pa po 'di snyad rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta u ma ja/ ti yin ches gros la por 'khod pa tsam ma zad/ brjod bya'i nang don la zhib par lta dus rtsogs brjod nang gsal 'tsho bar rang re gangs ljongs su gnas pa'i bod mi'i 'tsho ba'i nyam sa snang phra mo tsam ya nga rig rgyu med ga ces dang / yang 66 de ba'in rtogs brjod nang gsal shing rigs tsandan dang / rgya shug dang / dza ti'i shing 'a sogs pa dang / me tog utpal dang / ku mud da dang / pad ma dkar po la so gros pa/ 'dab chags rma bya dang / shang shang dang / ka ta lan ka la sogs pa/ sems can glang po che la sogs pa de dag bod kyi yul 'dir sa skyes rdo skyes yin zhing / tshe gang bod kyi sa khul las 'gro myong med pa'i bod mi rgan po zhig la bka' 'dri zhus na khong la gsung rgyu e yod ha ces pa la so gas rtogs brjod 'di rgya gzhung yin pa'i sprub byed gsungs pa ni shin tu bden par 9)khums/'on te rig pa smra ba 'ga' res bod yu 'a du mthong rgyu med pa'i shing dang / me tog sems can sogs 'khod pa tsam gyis bod gzhung yin par ma khyab ste/ bod rtsom 〈gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud 〉sogs nang du'ang de 'ja byi do tru mang ba'i phyir ga zhes brjod srid kyang bod rtsom 〈gzhon nu zla med kyi gu ta ma rgyud 〉 nang gi brjod bya'i don mthar thug 'khor bar yid 'byung ste dben pa'i nas sa su bskyod pa dang / de bzhin bod yul du mthong rgyu med pa'i shing dang / me tog sems can sogs kyi ming mang du byung ba ni gtam rgyud 'di'i rtsom pa pos bod kyi snga rtsom spyi dang / khyad par du 〈gzhon nu drug ge rtogs brjod 〉la dpe bltas pa'am lad mo gnang ba zhig yin pa gsal 346
por mngon pas des 〈gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod 〉bod gzhung yin par ga la grub/ des na kho bo ni dpyad rtsom 'di'i rtsom pa po'i ba'e da pa ltar rtogs brjod 'di rgya gzhung yin par 'dod kyang rgya gzhung yin na lo tsā ba su zhig yin min dang / dus nam zhig la brtsams min sogs zhu bar ma spobs/ pas mkhas dbang rnam pas da dung dpyad par 'tshal/2 tsom pa pos rtogs brjod 'di'i rtsom 'bri'i khyad yon la dpyad pa gnang ba ste/ 66bod kyi snga rtsom phal mo che brtsam bya'i nang don sgrig ga'i gsum las grub ste/ thog mar dge ba klad kyi don/ bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/mtha' mar dge ba mjug gi don bcas so/ /rtogs brjod 'dzi yang rtsom srol 'di las mi 'gal bar sgrig gzhi 'di rang ga'i ra ba 'ag gis 'grub pa gsham gsal rtogs brjod kyis dge ba klad kyi don gyi sa bcad du mtshon don smos pa dang / phyag bya ba/ shis brjod dang /mnyan par gdams pa/ dngos po nges par bsta na pa bcas so/ dngos po nges par bstan pa'i brjod bya ni rtogs brjod kyi brjod don snying po yin par snyam/ga zhes dpyad pa gnang ba ma zad da dung 88 rtogs brjod 'di rab byed bdun las grub ste/ rab byed song 'og 'brel mthud 'tshams shing / brjod bya kha bral thar thor du song med khar/ brjod bya'i nang don gom pa rim bgrod kyis mthar yang rtse'i gnas su bsnyegs te mjug sgril bar byas yod pa de ni bzo rtsal phun sum tshogs pa'i gser gyi bum pa la zhabs dang lto ba/ kha bcas che chung 'tshams shing ran pa/ bltas na yid dbang rab tu 'phrog pa lta bu'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i khyad yon du ma ldan no ga zhes rtogs brjod 'di'i khyad du 'phags pa'i rtsom 'bri'i khyad yon la bsngags pa ches cher — 347
mkhas grub kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjoX da bdam sa sgrigbrjod pa dang / yang ma jug tu 8 sngon byon rtsom pa po'i blo gros kyi yang rtsal ma nga dag cig brtsam bya'i sgrig gzhi 'di la brten nas yang dag par mtshon pa byas yod stabs/ deng rabs rtsom pa pos mi rigs kyi rtsom srol rgyud 'dzin bya rgyur med du mi rung ba'i dpyad gzhi'i rgyur gyu/ra ba yin no lta zhes nga tshos mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig rgyud 'dzin dang / 'phel rgyas gtong rgyur 'gran zla bral ba'i bod kyi snga rtsom 〈gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod 〉'di ni med du mi rung ba zhig yin pa'i gdams ngag khyad par can zhig gnang 'dug go〈 rtsom pa pos rtogs brjod 'di'i brjod don snying por dpyad pa gnang ba ste/ 88'khor ba pa rnams ni sdug bsngal dpag tu med kyi de ba'i na gshegs pa'i snying po rgyas par 'gyur ba'i ribs dad pa dang / snying rje dang /shes rab ldan pa dag theg pa chen po'i lam 'dir pha rol du phyin pa drug la spyad pas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyang rnyed par dka' ba ma yin no/ de phyir byang chub sems pa'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba la yongs su bslab par bya'o ga ha'es rtogs brjod 'di'i don gyi snying po la dpyad nga/ gnad du 'khol ba zhig gnang 'dug de yang rig rtsom ji 'dra zhig yin rung de'i brjod don snying po ni rig rtsom de brtsams dus kyi dus rabs dang / spyi tshogs kyi khor yug 'jig rten lta tshul bcas dang 'brel ba zab mo yod pas 〈 gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod 〉kyi brjod don snying po'ang shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa drug la brten nas nyon mongs la sa rnam par rgyal te mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi don du thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa byed dgos par bstan pa ni skabs de'i spyi tshogs ngos nas bshad na kun gyi yid la 'thad pa'i brjod don rlabs che 'ing / slob gso'i nus pa che ba 'ig yin/348
mkhyen gsal ltar rtogs brjod 'dir rab tu byed pa bdun yod pa las/ byed pa dang po ni gleng slong ngam rtogs brjod nang gi rang gshis mi 'dra ba'i mi sna gtso bo drug po ngo sprod gnang ba zhig yin par mngon pa dang /rab byed gnyis par sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi che ba brjod pa/ rab byed lnga par brtson 'grus phar phyin gyi che ba brjod pa/ rab byed bzhi par bzod pa'i phar phyin gyi che ba brjod pa/ rab byed gsum par tshul khrims phar phyin gyi che ba brjod pa/ rab byed drug par bsam gtan phar phyin gyi che ba brjod pa/rab byed bdun par shes rab phar phyin gyi che ba brjod pa zhig yin pas rtogs brjod 'di ni kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i 〈gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar 〉sogs dang 'dra bar rig rtsom gyi sgyu rtsal la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs slob khrid dam khyab bsgrags byas pa zhig yin par sems/de yang yin te/ nang pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan par yang dag zhugs mkhan zhig la mtshon na shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa drug ni a yod nang gi da yod dang / sgo nga'i nang gi ser ril lta bu yin pa rgyal sras zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i 〈spyod 'jug 〉sogs las gsal por mthong thub/ der ma zad rtogs brjod de'i nang 88ji ltar dag ja ྅ mkhar yang glo bur gyi/ sprin tshogs stug por rab 'khrigs kha dog dbyibs/ sna tshogs snang yang de yis gos min zhing /mkha' dang chu 'dzin tha dad gyur pa med/ de bcin dag pa'i sems las glo bur gyi/ ma rig las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal tshogs/ med ba'i na sna nga mod snang bzhin yongs ma grub/ chos dbyings 'gyur med de dang tha dad med ha ces pa sogs ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i dpe dang bcas brjod bya'i snying po 'khrul snang sgyu ma lta bu'i 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho dang /349
'dus byas thams cad bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i zhi ba bcas bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi ste/ nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba su yang de las 'da' mi rung shugs kyis bsta na pa sogs mdor na 〈gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod 〉kyi brjod bya'i snying ngo ni rtsom pa po tshe rdor lags kyis gsungs pa ltar nang pa'i chos lugs kyi ྅ ba bo na yin par 'khums so/ /4 rtsom pa pos 〈gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod 〉kyi sgyu rtsal khyad yon la dpyad pa gnang 'bras gtso bo khrag gnyis te/ gcig ni dpyad rtsom nang 88rtogs brjod 'di'i bskrun bya'i gtso gyur mi sna drug por rang rang la thun mong ma yin pa'i gshis ka ldan 'ong / khong tshor 'phrad pa'i 'gal zla gcig gyur yi na rung der ngos 'dzin dang thag gcod byed stangs mi 'dra bar bkod yod nya ces pas mtshon te rtogs brjod nang gi mi sna so so'i lta spyod tha dad pa'i mi sna'i snang brnyan bskrun thabs la bsngags pa brjod pa dang / cig shos ni dpyad rtsom nang 66 de bzhin yul ljongs dang / nam dus / mi sna'i rnam pa bkod 'bri byed stangs zhib tshags shing / gnad 'a 'drags pa/ kha gsal ba/gzugs can gyi bags chags zab po 'gog thub pa/ rtogs brjod 'di bklags pa (dang ) chabs cig tu yid la de dang 'brel ba'i 'char snang cig shos skye thub pa bcas kyi sgyu rtsal gyi khyad yon khyad du 'phags pa ldan 'dug nyanyaces rtogs brjod 'di'i nang gi yul ljongs dang / nam dus/ mi sna'i rnam pa bkod 'bri byed stangs la bsngags pa brjod gnang mdzad pa ni thugs shin tu mad pa'i gtam du mthong / rgyu mtshan ni/ rtogs brjod 'di'i rtsom pa pos phul du byung ba'i rtsom rtsal la brten nas nam dus dang / yul ljongs/lam kha'i gnas tshul sogs snyan ngag gi lam nas glog brnyan bstan pa ltar 350
kun gyi 'dren byed yul du gzigs mor bshams yod pa ma zad khyad par du mi sna'i snang brnyan mtha' dag 'jim bzos 'dra sku lta bu ma yin par rtsa thams cad snying dang 'brel ba ltar yod tshad rang gi brjod bya'i snying po dang 'brel ba'i khar da dung rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi bsam pa'i brtse dung ngam zhe 'dod zab mo shugs su bstan pa sogs rtogs brjod 'di'i rtsom 'bri'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad yon ni dus da lta'ang hang sangs dgos pa zhig yin par smos ci/mdor na rtsom pa po tshe rdor lags kyis mdzad pa'i dpyad gtam bod kyi snga rtsom 〈ga 'on nu drug gi rtogs brjod 〉la dbya da pa zhes bya ba 'di ni cung zhib tshags pa dang / gnad la 'khel ba'i tshan rig gi rang bzhin ldan pa'i dpyad rtsom zhig tu snang / 'on te blo phangs dgos pa zhig ni khong gis rtogs brjod 'di'i thun min tshig gi sbyor ba dang / rgyan sbyar stangs sogs la dpyad pa zhib phra ma gnang ba'ang yang na dpyad pa gnang mi 'dug kho bo'i bsam par rtogs brjod 'di'i tshig sbyor dang / rgyan sbyar stangs ni gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa snga rtsom skar tshogs dbus kyi zla ba lta bu 'ig yin par sems/de'i skor rtogs brjod 'di'i mjug byang nang du'ang /snyan tshig me long don rgyan so lnga dang / /le'u dang po sgra rgyan zung ldan sogs/ /ltade dag rnam grangs ma tshang med pa'i mdzod/ /ces bsngags pa che cher mdzad 'dug la tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar rtogs brjod 'di'i ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i tshig gi sbyor ba dang / zhwa dang mgo bo yongs su mthun pa'i snyan ngag gi rgyan sbyar stangs la dpyad pa bya rgyu ni gal chen zhig red snyam/ 'on te mjug byang nang 88le'u dang po sgra rgyan 351
zung ldan sogs/ de dag rnam grangs ma tshang med pa'i mdzod nya ces pa ni cung don la mi gnas par mthong ngo /lnga pa/ 〈lha sa'i kha che 〉zhes par rags tsam dpyad pa/rtsom pa po tshe rdor lags kyis mdzad pa'i 〈lha sa'i kha che 〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig der rgya che'i klog pa po tshos ha cang dga' po byed kyi 'dug kho bo'i bsam par der rgyu mtshan mang po yod srid kyang gtso bo ni khong gi brtsam bya de'i brjod bya'i nang don gsar la don dngos dang mthun pa dang / rjod byed tshig sbyor go bde la rna bar snyan pa zhig yod pas rtsom yig des klog pa po'i yid dbang 'phrog thub pa byung ba red snyam/de yang khong gi rtsom yig de'i mjug tu 66lha sa'i shes rig gong 'phel 'gro ba'i lo rgyus shig gleng dgos na lha sa'i kha che'i gnas tshul ma gleng ka med red snyam/ de gnyis po spyi dang bye brag lus dang yan lag sdong po dang yal ga'i tshul du 'khod nas sa mtho'i grong khyer 'di'i thog lo rgyus kyi gzhal med khang bzang 'ig bskrun phyir cha shas su gtogs pa'i rig gnas 'di rigs la snang chung hod rgyugs ma yin par mang mang chu bo'i rgyun ltar chad med mjal rgyu'i spyan 'dren tsam du kho bos 'dir shod rgyun gyi tshul du song ba'i yig thung 'di nyid spel nas lhag bsam dkar pos mkhyen ldan klog pa po'i spyan sngar gsol ba lags so nya zhes bkod gnang mdzad pa des khong gis ched mngags brjod bya 'di 'dra zhig gdams ka gnang dgos pa gsal por bstan gnang mdzad 'dug 〈lha sa'i kha che 〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig de'i nang rtsom pa pos lha sa'i kha che'i lo rgyus dang / chos lugs / dus chen/ sgyu rtsal sogs 352
zhib cing phra ba'i ngang ri mor bkod gnang mdzad 'dug pas khong gi rtsom yig 'dir sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang tsam ma tshad lo rgyus shes bya'i rin thang nges can zhig ldan 'dug pa ni/1 khong gi rtsom yig nang 88lha sa ba tshos kha che rigs gnyis su dbye srol yod/ gcig ni bar skor gyi kha che ste/ mang che ba bar skor nang tshong gnyer 'tsho sdod byed/ kho tsho ha lam pha yul ka shi rmir phyir log zin te deng sang mthong dkon pa yin/gcig shos ni wa pā gling gi kha che ste/ gna' bo'i grong khyer lha sa'i shar lho'i mtshams su rub sdod byed mkhan yul mi yin/ lo rgyus la phyir mig bltas tshe sngar lha sa skyed chu ni kha che'i phyag 'tshal khang gi 'gram nas nub tu rgyug 'gro yi yod pas chu rags kyi byang ngos su 'tsho sdod byed mkhan kha che de tshor lha sa ba tshos wa pā gling ( wa pā zhes pa rgya skad kyi zur chag ste chu rags kyi don no ) kha che 'es 'bod srol yod 〉〉 ces lha sa'i kha che'i 'o rgyus dang / dbye ba/ gnas yul sogs ngo sprod gnang ba ma zad 86wa pā gling lta zhes pa'i ming la 'grel ba yang gnang ba dang /2 de bzhin rtsom yig nang 86i si lam chos lugs la dad pa byed pa ni lha sa'i kha che'i mtshon rtags mngon che shos yin 'ing / ༷ i si lam chos lugs la rtsa ba'i blang bya khrag lnga yod/ dad ldan tshos rtsa ba'i blang bya lnga po de rang gi mig 'bras bzhin gces srung thub na chos pa rnam dag zhig tu rtsi'o ’zhes pa la sogs kha che'i chos lugs nang lta spyo da gnyis kur rang rtogs kyis sdom khrims srung dgos pa dang / de yang rang mos yin tshul sogs ngo sprod gnang ba dang /353
〈 rtsom yi ga nang da dung 88lo gcig la kha che'i dus chen khrag dgu gtong srol yod/ dus chen dgu por de dag chos lugs dang 'brel ba med pa gcig kyang med/ snyung gnas lo gsar ni dus chen rgyas shos yin/ ༷ gor pan dus chen de yang dgod bro po zhig red nya ces pa la sogs kha che'i yul goms gshis lugs sam chos lugs dang zung du 'brel ba'i dus chen gtong srol ngo sprod gnang ba dang /4 gzhan yang rtsom yig nang 88 lha sa'i kha che tsho tshal dang shing 'bras 'debs gso bya rgyur nang byan chud pa 'ig red/༷ lta sa'i kha che'i khrod 'tsho rten dras 'tshem lag rtsal yin pa mang po yod grong khyer lha sar ( rgya mi'i gro zhib nya dar ba'i skor shod dgos byung na de'ang kha che'i gro khang ma gleng ka med red ༷ ༷kho tsho ni las la brtson zhing / rnam rig bkra ba dang / tshogs pa'i skyed sdug ge la rgya shin tu zab pas them dud dbul po tshor nang khul nas skyob gso sprod kyi yod/ der brten lha sa'i khrom gzhung thog kha che'i sprang po gcig kyang mthong rgyu med ha ces pa la sogs dngos yod mang po zhig drangs nas lha sa'i kha che ni rang gi chos la dad mos zab pa dang mi rigs kyi la rgya ldan pa/las la brtson zhing shes rig bkra ba zhig yin pa ngo sprod gnang ba dang /5 da dung rtsom yig nang 88sgyu rtsal dang lha sa'i dbar la las smon mtshams sbyor zab mos 'brel ba lta bu lo rabs brgyad cu nas dgu bcu'i bar bod rigs kyi glu gzhas dang / mdzes ris/ 'jim bzo bcas kyi sgyu rtsal nang grub 'bras thon pa'i kha che shes ldan mi sna 'ga' shas thon yod/ ༷༷ lha sa'i kha che'i khrod du bod kyi gso ba rig pa dang / rkang rtsed spo lo/ chu rkyal/kye rim rol rtsed la sogs pa'i byed sgo'i nang phul byung ge mi sna mang dag cig 354
thon yod pa de tsho lha sa ba tsho'i thugs la gsal po red lta ces lo rgyus tsam ma zad deng ge char las rigs khrag thog phyag las gnang bzhin pa'i lha sa'i kha che ba sgyu rtsal mkhas can 'ga' zhig ngo sprod gnang ba sogs 〈lha sa'i kha che 〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig 'di'i brjod bya'i don dang / rjod byed tshig gnyis bar gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i thun min gyi khyad chos yo da pa gong zhus ltar ro/ /'on te rtsom yig 'di'i nang 88la che ha zhes pa bod skad nang i si lam chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan tshor go dgos shing zhes gsal 'dug pas kho bo'i bsam par i si lam/ chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan yod do cog 88kha che nya e yin snyam/ma/dor na rtsom pa po tshe rdor lags kyis mdzad pa'i rig rtsom gyi deb 〈skyed ma 'i bka' drin 〉zhes pa'i nang gi brtsam bya mtha' dag tshig gi lo mas changs pa ma yin par don gyi 'bras bus yongs su dud pa/ rgyud 'dzin gyi la rgya zab pa dang / gsar gtod kyi phugs bsam yangs pa/ blang byar blo mig bkra la/ dor byar blo khog che ba sogs da lta'i dus rabs kyi rig rtsom dgos 'dun dang ha cang mthun pa zhig yin pas des bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gra rgyas phun sum tshos sa par gtong rgyur gzhan gyis tshab mtshon mi thub pa'i nus pa thon rgyu yin zhing / bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mkhyen 'dod na 〈skyed ma'i bka' drin 〉zhes pa'i rig rtsom deb chung der gzigs na lam tsam rtogs thub snyam/ gang lags she na deb chung de'i rtsom pa po ni bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig shes byar ched mngags gsar sbyang gnang myong ba ma zad/ rgya rigs dang phyi rgyal gyi rtsom rig shes byar yang slob sbyong gnang myong yod cing / gsar rtsom tsam ma/ zad rtsom rig yig sgyur thad 355
phyag las gnang ste grub 'bras bzang po thon myong yod thog gtso che mi lo bcu bzhi lhag tsam bod yig rig rtsom gyi rtsom sgrig pa'i phyag las gnang yod pa bcas kyi rgyu mang po zhig tshogs yod pas khong gi rtsom deb der rtsom deb gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos ldan yod pa de tsho'ang rgyu mtshan de 'dra zhig la thug 'dug snyam/'on te rig rtsom gyi dge skyon gleng ba'i bya ba de ni skye bo so so'i 'dren lam du tshon brgya byugs pa'i shel gyi gong bu 'char ba bzhin kha dog sna tshogs ci yang snang srid pas der 85 me tog mnyam bzhad dang mkhas brgya 'gram gleng lta gi srid jus 'dzin dgos pa de ni don la gnas pa yin/ 〈skyed ma'i bka' drin 〉gyi me tog gi bcud la ro myangs te brjod pa'i bung ba bdag gi tshig ge phreng ba de dag la 'gal 'khrul chad gsum gang yang yong srid pas gzur gnas mkhas dbang rnam pa'i bka' slob thob phyir 'dir ri mo'i lam du bkod de spyan sngar gsol ba lags so/ /
〈bzhad gad dpyid kyi pho nyar 〉bltas rjes kyi myong tshor 'dod yon sna lnga/sman ljongs sgyu rtsal kun gsal lha lam dbyings/ /thun min tho rengs skar chen ga'as ma gtam/ /grags pa nyi zla'i 'od ltar ma yod kyang / /zhing 'brog skar tshogs bye ba'i yid dbang 'phrog /bltas na 'dren byed dgyes pa'i dga' ston dang / /nyan na 'dzum dkar sbas kyang dbang med gsal/ /bsam na slob gso'i dwangs chus kun slong 'khru/ /gcig go bcu chod gzhas ma gtam 'dir 'khums/ /de phyir rnam dpyod mkhyen brtse'i rigs rgyud las/ /'khrungs pa'i 〈dpyid kyi pho nya 〉ri dwags mig /bdag yid nya mo 'gugs pa'i kyo ba la/ /bstod dbyangs snying gi mdza' 'phrin 'bul bar spro/ /zhes pa'i tshig gis sngon bsus ste gangs ljongs gzhas ma gtam gyi rig pa la spyan dkyus ring ba'i sku zhabs bsod tshe lags kyis mdzad pa'i 〈bzhad 357
ma khas grub kyi rtsom rig dbya da brjod bdams sgri gagobo tre za———————wa wa——— bo bo ————————————gad dpyid kyi pho nya 〉zhes pa la bltas rjes kyi dran 'char ches mdor bsdus su 'god par bya ba la nang gses lnga /dang ngo / rtsom nga po ma chog dang 'brel 'dris yang ya nga zhus rjes kyi myong tshor/kho bo ni sku zhabs bsod tshe lags kyi slob ma zhig yin la phan tshun zhal shob zhu res yod pa'i grogs po zhig kyang yin/ 'o red/ ༷ ༷ khong thog mar ma jal ba'i dus tshod ni 1982lo ste/ rgyal yongs lho phyogs sa khul ched las ga las ma gtam 'gran tshogs su zhugs ma khan grong khyer lha sa glu gar tshogs pa'i rgan thub bstan lags dang mig dam/ra lags so gas grags can gyi gzhas ma gtam 'khrab ston pa rnam sa dang lha na du nga rang yang ltad mo'am slob sbyong 'gro rgyu'i skal bzang thob/nga tsho'i rlangs 'khor lha sa nas gong dkar gnam gru thang du thon khar sku zhabs bso da tshe lags kyang dga' skyel zhu bar phebs 'dug khong gis nga lho kha nas yin pa mkhyen rjes las ka dang lo so gas bka' 'dri gnang ba dang /khyed rang 'o chung chung yin pas sgyu rtsal gyi shes bya gang la'ang 'bad brtson bya dgos 'u gas sogs bslab bya gnang ba dang / da dung 88 da res stobs rgyal lags phebs med dam/ zhes bka' 'dri gnang byung / mkhyen gsal ltar stobs rgyal lags ni lho kha sa khul rig rtsal tshogs pa'i glu gzhas mkhas can zhig yin la gzhas ma gtam gyi 'khyab ston pa bgres gras shig kyang yin pas khong gis gzhas ma gtam gyi bya ba byed mkhan tshang mar mnyes po dang thugs khur gnang gi yod pa de ngas lam seng shes byung / lhag par du skabs de'i 358
rgyal yongs ched las gzhas ma gtam 'gran sdur nang khong gi brtsams byar bya dga' rim pa dang po dang / gnyis pa sogs thob nas skad grags chod pas nga khong gi sku yon la de bas yid smo na chen po skyes/de nas bzung kho bo lta sar tshogs 'du 'am/ 'gran sdur/ yang na sger don sogs gang gi ched du bskyod skabs kyang kho rang mjal bar bskyod cing /rim bzhin khong dge rgan du bsten pas kho bor sgyu rtsal gyi myong ba mang po zhig thob byung bas khong ni bdag nga drin du che ba'i las zhor gyi bshes gnyen zhig yin par yi rang zhu yi yod/ de rjes khong phyag las don du rtsed thang la'ang thengs kha shas phebs shing / lhag par du 1993lor lho la sa khul rig gnas mnyam 'brel tshogs pas gdan zhus ltar khong dang rgan byams pa ro na tan lags mchog gis lho kha'i ched las dang / las zhor gyi sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom pa dang / 'khyab ston pa mi nyi shu lhag tsam la dus yun nyin bcu'i ring gzhas ma gtam dang / gtam brjod chung ba sogs 'khyab stangs dang 'khrab 'khrid/gsar rtsom byed stangs slob 'khrid gnang /mdor na ngas khong dang yang yang 'brel 'dris zhus rjes khong gi thugs gshis dang bka' mol sogs las nga la myong tshor mang po 'ig byung ba thams cad ri mor 'god thabs bral yang 'dir chu brgya zam 'dus kyis brjod par bya ste/de yang phyogs gcig nas bshad na khong ni sems rtsa 'khol zhing khengs skyung gnang mkhan zhig red/ khong gis nga tsho ga 'as ma gtam gyi bya ba byed mkhan su 'dra 'ig yin rung spro ba chen pos bsu ba gnang ba dang / spo bas sems med par bka' rmo la gsungs pa/ skabs 'gar mnyam du lbi rag kyang 359
mchod de zhal shob gnang ba sogs 'dra mnyam gyi spyod tshul 'dzin pa las khong rang nyid gzhan las mtho tsam mam mkhas tsam yod bsam pa gtan nas gnang gi mi 'dugde las ldog ste khong rang nyid kyis dma' sa bzung nas nga tshor 88khyed tsho sa khul khag la bzhugs mkhan tshor zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i rgyus mnga' nga tsho las zhe drag mang gi red/ de ni cha rkyen legs shos shig yin nga/ga nges par du brjod bya gsar pa dang / 'tsho ba dngos mtshon pa'i 'khyab tshan gang mang 'bri dgos/:: zhes gsungs pa ma zad brtsams bya 'ga' thig la bsngags brjod yang yang gnang ste/ 66 dngos gnas rtsom rtsal byang chub pa red bzhag 'ga' zhig gi sar nga tshos kyang slob sbyong zhu dgos pa 'dugces khengs skyung ngang gsungs kyi 'dugde yang yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/gzhon yang rgan pa'i nye bar zhig la dga'/ /mkhas par gyur kyang shes pa'i nga rgyal med/ /gzi brjid che yang bzod cing des pa'i ngang / /je mthor phyin yang nga rgyal dregs pa med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ yang phyogs gzhan thig nas zhus na khong ni blo khog chen pos gsar rtsom gnang phod mkhan zhis dang / gsar rtsom gnang mkhas pa/ blo rgya che zheng rnam dpyod bkra ba/ lhag par du mi rigs kyi sgyu rtsal 'phel rgyas ched du phyi nang gi shes bya sna mang slob sbyong gnang rgyur snying rus che ba zhig red/khong gis rtag tu nga tshor 66nga tsho bod mi rigs la phul du byung ba'i srol 360
rgyun gyi rig gnas dang sgyu rtsal sna mang phun sum tshogs po zhig yod pa ni spobs pa byed 'os pa zhig lags/'on te de kho nas blo yid tshims nas bsdad na spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho skong mi thub pa dang / dus rabs kyi rjes zin mi thub pas nges par du mi rigs gzhan gyi phul byung rig gnas dang sgyu rtsa'/ slob sbyong byed dgos pa dang /blo khog chen pos gsar rtsom byed dgos/ mi rigs gzhan dag gis byed thub pa tshang ma nga tshos kyang byed thub nges red/ gro tso bo ni snying rus la rag las yod/ dper na/ 〈dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〉 ches pa de sngar bod du med kyang da lta sa khyab rdo khyab tu dar yod pa lta bu red/nga rang rang nyid nas kyang blo khog chen pos gtam brjod zlos gar dang /dgod bro'i gtam gleng sogs bod yig gi thog nas gsar rtsom byas pas de dag yig rigs ga 'an thog nas brtsams pa las zhan pa rang byung mi 'dugrig pa bsgrims na nga tsho bod yig rtsom 'bri mkhan tsho las sla po rang yog ma red dā nya zhes spobs pa chen pos gsung gin 'dugde yang yin te/chos kyi grags pas/shes rab can ni phyogs kyi glang po ste/ /tsand+ra go mi brjod pa rnam par dag /snyan ngag dpa' bo las byung ldeb sbyor mkhas/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba nga min su/ /ces gsu ngas pa ltar ro/ /361
mkhas grub kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod bdam sa sgrigge go ge ge go go : —ge ge —wa wa —gnyis pa/ 'bras dkar khag 'a bltas pa'i myong tshor/'bras dkar ni bod mi rigs kyi sa zhas ma gtam lu gu lag skyes shig yin 'ing / tha snyad 'di la 'bri sta ngas mi 'dra ba 'bras dkar dang / bgres dkar/ 'be dkar sogs yod par mthong yang snga ma ches dag par sem sa/de'i grub byed ni sgyu rtsal 'di bkra shis rten 'brel mtshon byed cig yi na pas de'i sa tso don 'bras bu dkar po ste/ 'bras bu bzang po thig thob rgyu'i smo na mdun kho na las ma 'das / gzhan yang kho bos de sngon 'bras dkar lag bris dpe rnying thig mthong myong ba de'i nang 〈lho brag dkar gzhung gi 'bras bshad 〉ces bris ('dug sku zhabs bsod tshe la gas nas kyang 〈'bras dkar 〉 ces 'bri rkyang mdzad pa ni thugs shin tu mad do/ /de yang sngon lugs rnying dus 'bras dkar gyi sgyu rtsal la brten nas 'tsho thabs byed mkhan ya nga yo da ro/da deng char /'bras dkar 'di ba'i na gar stegs kyi sgyu rtsal la 'gyur nas rgya che'i ma nga tshogs kyi bas ma pa'i bdud tsir mkho ba gzigs te sku zhabs bsod tshe lags kyi brjod bya gsar zhing / rnam pa 'dra min gyi 'bras dkar gsar rtsom ji snyed cig gnang 'dug par dge ma tshan nam khyad chos du ma zhig 'dug par mthong bas 'dir gtso bo 'ga' 'ig zhus na/gcig brjod bya don gyi steng nas zhus na khong gis brtsams pa'i 'bras dkar gyi nang don ni dus rabs kyi rnam pa dang / spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang yongs su mthun pa zhig yin la 'tsho ba dngos mtshon pa'i me long zhig kyang red ces bshad chog pa 'dug snyam/362
dper na/ 'bras dal ra 〈 bkra shis bshad pa 〉 zhis pa'i nang /88bdug rtsub can gyi mi bzhis tang gi mi rigs srid jus gtor bshig gtong ba'i skabs la ༷ 'bras dkar nga yis khrom sto da nas khrom smad la bltas pas/ spo bo lags gcig gi lag tu gro so phye mar bskur nas/ rmongs dad red zer bshad nas ( de ) khrom skor la 'khrid song / lags/ 'bras dkar nga yis khrom smad nas khrom stod la gcig bltas pas/ rmo'o lags gcig gi la ga tu kha btags 'khyer du bcug nas 'u gas rnying red zer bshad nas ( de )dgag brgyab ( rgyag ) pa ma thong byung / ska bas der 'bras dkar bsam pa'i don grub nga'i sems par bshad mi tshar ba'i skyo po dang sdug po byung song ha ha lags/ da cha tang kru dbyang gi thugs 'khur zab bzhes 'og mi/ rigs srid jus don 'khyol dang tang sga rlabs chen 'od zer yang bskyar rbad du 'phros nas nga tshor yang bskyar skyed pa'i nyi ma shar song 88zhes pa lta bu mi ba'i shog khag gi nag nyes ther 'don dang / tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun gyi yang dag srid jus la rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi mgrin tshab zhus te bstod bsngags gnang ba dang /yang 'bras dkar 〈mi rigs mthun sgril la bstod pa 〉 zhes pa'i nang 88nyi ma dang zla ba bral thabs med/ skye dngos dang nyi 'od bral thabs med/chu dang nya mo bral thabs med/ me rigs mthun sgril bral thabs med nya ces pa lta bu mi rigs mthun sgril la bsngags pa dang /'bras dkar 〈 dga' ston rten 'brel 〉 zhes pa'i nang na ru ba'i sa btegs pa'i rgya lcog gru bzhi'i stong du/ bas ma don 'grub pa'i 'al gro'i 'bo zhig mthong byung / gro 'bo'i steng du mnga' thang longs spyod rgyas pa'i rten 363
'brel gyi dar tshon sna lnga'i mda' dar btsugs pa mthong byung / rin chen sna lngas grub pa'i khrung phor khrung rgyan mthong byung / gla spu'i 'bol gdan sgang la/rgya rum gtsang rum btings shag ( bzhag ) dpe sgam gsar pa'i steng la/gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin bsgrigs shag ( bzhag ) gnyer tshang nang la bltas pas/ 'bru rigs bang ba brgyangs shag ( 6zhag ) lta bu mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas phyin tshul bstan pa dang / yang 'bras dkar de nyid las/66lag rtsal 'jem ( 'jon ) thang med bzhin du/ smra lce kho na g.yug mkhan dang / 'bol thog chu rkya la rgyag mi tsho/ nga gnyis 'phya smod byed sa yin/tha shal lag tu 'dzin mkhan dang / las med le lo can rnams ni/ nga gnyis zur za phyed sa yin/ thon skyed ngal rtsol la dga' ba/ rang gi pha yul la gces pa/ blo mthun bar la mthun sgril bzang ba/ bod gsar 'dzugs skrun la legs skyes che tsam 'bul mkhan ni 'bras dkar nga gnyis kyi bstod pa 'bul mkhan yin nyag zhes pa lta bu slob gso'i don snying ldan pa dang / yang 'bras dkar 〈bkra shis rten 'brel kha btags 〉zhes pa las 66'bras dkar po nga yis tshong las byed/ ( byas ) rgya la phyin nas rgya zog bsgrubs/ bod la yong nas yul zog bsgrubs/ ༷ 'bras dkar po nga yis skyel 'dren las ka byas/ shar rlung rtags can rlangs 'khor bdag gis btang /'bras dkar po nga yis zhabs zhu'i las ka byas/ na ning nga yis za khang chu khang brgyab/ da lo nga yis ja khang chang khang brgyab/ ༷ ༷ 'bras dkar nga yis 'dzugs skrun las ka byed ( byas ) rdo las shing las lcags las dang / rgya khang bod khang las khang dang / las grwa'i thig tshad nga ras shes zhes pa sogs bod ljongs sa khul khag gi rgya che'i mang tshogs ༷ 364
tshos sgyur bcos sgo dbye'i mtho rlabs nang rang gi lag pa sgul ba dang / rang rang gi khyad chos dang 'jon thang spyad de phyug po'i lam du bskyod bzhin yod pa gsal por bstan pa sogs mtshar na khong gis brtsams pa'i 'bras dkar khag gi brjod bya'i nang don ni gser gzhong nor bus bkang ba dang gnyis su ma mchis so/ /gnyis/ rjod byed tshig gi steng nas zhus na khong gis brtsams pa'i 'bras dkar ni srol rgyun gyi 'bras dkar rmang ga'i ra bzung nas 'phel rgyas btang ba zhig yin pas ming tshig gsar pa mang la rna bar 'jibs pa de dag kyang zlos skyon med pa mu tig phreng bar brgyus pa dang 'dra zhing da dung kha gsal la go bde ba sogs spyi yi dge mtshan du ma dang ldan pa ma zad bye brag snyan ngag gi rgyan mang po zhig kyang zhor la ngang ngam shugs kyis thon par mthong ba ni/ dper na/dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas mtha' nas bskor ba/ /chab chu bo rnam bzhi g.yas su 'khyil ba/ /rtswa rtsi shing me tog 'dab ma mdzes pa/ /lta bu rang ba'i na brjod pa'i rgyan dang / /'bras dkar bsam pa'i don grub nga / /sems pa dkar po dar zho 'dra/ /gzugs po dkar po gangs ri 'dra/ /gtam bzang dkar po 'o ma 'dra/ / zhes pa dang /yang /nam mkhar mtshams sprin shar ba 'dra/ 365
sa gzhir pad ma rgyas pa 'dra/ /rma byas dbu gdugs phub pa 'dra/ /lta bu dpe rgyan ha cang mang ba dang / /'bras rgyug skar ma khra chung 'di/ /dgong mo nyal ba'i nyal grogs / /'ogs pa langs ba'i langs grogs / /la 'a 'gro ba'i rta pho/ /chu la 'gro ba'i zam pa/ /lta bu gzugs rgyan dang /pho rog nag chung min rung / /grogs skad 'don ba'i na yong yod/ /khu byug sngon mo min rung / /drug 'gyur len bzhin yong yod/ /skya ka khra mo min rung / /gshog 'gyur rgyag bzhin yong yod/ /lta bu khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan dang /nyi ma zla ba bral thabs med/ /skye dngos nyi 'od bral thabs med/ /chu dang nya mo bral thabs med/ /mi rigs mthun sgril bral thabs med/ /lta bu zung ldan gyi rgyan dang /gos kyi phyi sha bcu lor yin/ / 366
gos kyi rgyab sha brgya lor yin/ /lta bu phul byung gi rgyan dang/ /khri gdugs nyi ma/'i 'od dang gcig /zla ba dkar po'i 'od dang gnyis/ /srid jus bzang po'i 'od dang gsum/ /lta bu rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan dang ( 'di me long dang cung mi mthun )'bol thog chu rkyal rgyag mi tsho/ /nga tshos 'phya smo da byed sa yin/ /lta bu ba 'ad gad kyi nyams dang /sems skyed skyed de ring 'a sa skyed pa/ /nyi ma dro dro de ring las dro ba/ / ༷ a ma sgrol mas dga' ba'i mdzum mdangs ston pa mthong byung /spo bo rig 'dzin gyis skyed pa'i 'bas bro rgyag pa mthong byung /a lcag tshe brtan gyis dga' ba'i glu dbyangs len pa mthong byung /lta bu dga' ba'i nyams dang /bsnyun gzhi med pa'i bkra shis shog /tshe thag ring ba'i bkra shis shog /bde zhing skyed pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis mi 'gyur bkra shis shog /lta bu shis brjod kyi rgyan sogs ched du snyan ngag gi rgyan ma sbyar yang rtsom pa po'i rnam dpyod kyi sor rtse las tshar du dngar ba'i snyan ngag gi rgyan ci ༷ 367
mkhas grub kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod bdams sgrigrigs thon yod pa de dag kyang kha gsal go bde dwangs chu'i nang gi rde'u bang 'dra'o/ /gsum/ dbye ba rnam pa'i steng nas zhus na'ang khong gis brtsam sa pa'i 'bras dkar khag ni sna mang phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin te/ dper na/〈bkra shis bshad pa 〉lta bu mi gcig gis shod pa'i srol rgyun 'bras dkar rgyun 'dzin gnang zhing gtso bo bkra shis smon tshig gi rnam pa ldan pa/〈bkra shis dgyes ston 〉lta bu mi gcig gi 'bras dkar gtso bo bshad pa'i rnam pa ldan pa 〈dga' ston rten 'brel 〉 lta bu mi gnyis kyis 'bras dkar dang da dung sgra snyan zhabs bro'am yod pa phan tshun gzhogs 'degs kyi rnam pa ldan pa/ /〈bkra shis smon tshig 〉 lta bu mi bzhi'i 'bras dkar dang da dung rol cha'ang 'ga' 'ig yod pa mnyam rub kyis sgyu rtsal rnam pa ldan pa/ /〈bkra shes kha btags 〉lta bu mi drug gi 'bras dkar rang rang gi khyad chos sam che ba brjod pa 'gran sdur gyi rnam pa ldan pa sogs sku 'bas bsod tshe lags kyis srol rgyun 'bras dkar rmang gzhir bzung nas 'phel rgyas sam gsar gtod chen po zhig gnang yod pas/ des phyis 'bras dkar gsar rtsom la de bas yangs pa'i lam zhig bstan gnang mdzad yod do/ /gsu ma pa/ dgod bro'i gtam gleng khag bltas rjes kyi myong tshor/sku 'bas bsod tshe lags kyis bod yig thog nas brtsams gnang ba'i dgod bro'i gtam gleng ni ljongs phyi nang gang sar skad grags ha cang chen po yod cing / kho bos khong gi dgod bro'i gtam gleng phal mo che 'khrab ston gyi 368
skabs mthong myong bas de dag gi sgyu rtsal dang / nang don mang po zhig rdo la ri mo brkos pa ltar sems la gnang shing / lhag par du 'di lo khong gi ljags rtsom 〈bzhad gad dpyid kyi pho nya 〉la bltas rjes khong gi brtsams bya'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos dang brjod bya'i nang don de bas zhib cing phra ba kho bo'i yid ngor 'jags pa dang lhan cig myong tshor 'ga' 'ig byung ba tshig gi lo mas ma sgrib par smras na khong gi dgod bro'i gtam gleng ni/(1 )brjod bya'i nang don kun phan bzang drug lta bu dang /(2)sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur za 'og gsar pa'i ri mo lta bu'o/gcig sku zhabs bsod tshe lags kyis dus yun ring po'i nang spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho bar zhib 'jug nan po gnang nas 'tsho ba dngos gson por mtshon pa dang / za 'phrug langs sa de rang la 'phur 'phur byed thub pa'i dgod bro'i gtam gleng mang po zhig brtsams gnang bar rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis ha cang dga' po byed kyi yod cing / brtsams bya'i nang don yang sna mang phun sum tshogs po yod pa ni/ dper na/phul du byung ba'i bod mi rigs kyi dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal gyi che ba brjod pa dang / dmangs khrod kyi sgyu rtsal de dag myur skyob dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gtong dgos lugs skor gyi dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈glu gar gyi rgya mtsho 〉lta bu dang / thon skyed 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs lag bltar byas pa nas bzung bod mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba nyin bzhin legs su phyin te tshang mas tang gi srid jus la bstod dbyangs 'bul ba'i dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈dbul bcos phyug 'gyur 〉lta bu/las la brtson zhing dpa' ngar che ba shes rig ldan pa'i bod mi dmangs ༷ 369
mkhas grub kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod bdams sgrig— trekyis blo gros snying bcud las 'khrungs pa'i khyad du 'phags pa'i gna' bo'i bzo skrun dang / rin thang bral ba'i rig dngos sogs ngo sprod byed pa'i dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈gnas chen po ta la 〉lta bu/ 'byung 'gyur mes rgyal khang bzang 'degs pa'i ka ba blo gsal byis pa tshos bzang po gsum ldan gyi slob phrug cig byed dgos lugs slob gso'i skor gyi dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈nga chen po chags 'dug gam 〉lta bu/bod mi rigs kyi sa mtho'i khyad chos ldan pa'i yul goms gshis lugs dang / dmangs srol shes bya ngo sprod byed pa'i dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈kha btags 〉lta bu/mi rigs kyi sa khul du mi rigs kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/de ba'i na pha skad ma skad shes pa bya rgyu'i skor gyi zur za'i dgod bro'i gtam gleng phur ma lug nyidang 〈rngo lo 'phyar ba 〉la sogs mdor na khong gis brtsams pa'i dgod bro'i gtam gleng khag gi brjod bya'i nang don ni nad rigs kun la phan pa'i bzang drug yin par 'khums so/ /gnyis/ sku zhabs bso da tshe lags ni bod yig tsam ma zad rgya'i skab dang yi ge la'ang byang chub nga 'ig yin pas khong gis rgya'i dgod bro'i gtam gleng gi sgyu rtsal phab rgyun de bod skad dgod bro'i gtam gleng gi dkar mo nas la btab pas da gzod gzhi nas thams cad shin tu dga' ba'i bdud rtsi'i mchod chang zhig 'khrungs/de yang dgod bro'i gtam gleng zhes pa'i sgyu rtsal 'di ni bzhad gad slong dgos la don yang brjod dgos pa zhig yin pas 'di la rtsom rig gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i gzhung lugs shig yod cing / bzhad gad slong ba de yang gus 370
zhabs dang ngo tsha bral ba'i gtam zhig min par rang nyid kyi sbyang stobs dang /blo gros la brten nas byung ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi nyams las gad mo dgod pa dang /'dzum pa dang / thal mo rdeb pa sogs kyi nus pa thon pa zhig dgos pa ltar sku zhabs bsod tshe lags kyis brtsams gnang mdzad pa'i dgod bro'i gtam gleng khag nang / sgyu rtsal la brten nas ba 'ad gad slong thabs mang po gnang 'dug pa ni/ dper na/ dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈glu gar gyi rgya mtsho 〉zhes pa las/ka pa/ dper na dbus kyi nang ma dang / ( ha cang mgyogs pos )gtsang gi stod gzhas/ lho kha'i sgor gzhas/ chab mdo'i bro gzhas/ mon pa'i gzhas/ shar pa'i gzhas/ lho pa'i ga 'as/ 'ba' ga 'as/ tshig rgyag gzhas chen/ rnam thar/ ri glu/ sgrung glu/ 'brog glu/ skyo glu/ mgur glu/ lta bu kha rtsal gyi steng nas gzhad gad slong ba dang /dgod bro'i gtam gleng kur ma lug 〉ces pa las/ka pa/ ༷ phal skad/kha pa/ phag pa'i skad/ka pa/ log skad/kha pa/ 'o ga spyod pa'i skad/lta bu sgra 'dra'i steng nas gzhad gad slong ba/ yang de nyid las/ka pa/ a ma'i ro/ mo spa se btsong mkhan yo lce de/ 66tha'o yan lta ya ma rgyang mkhan zhig 'dugkha pa/ a ni da ga red pas/ngas spa se 8 krung can 99 der btsong rogs zer lab pas mos kyag kyag byas te nya span span 88der btsongs byung /371
mo yang sbog byed gag byed as/ ༷ lta bu ska da rigs 'dres ma'i steng nas gzhad gad slong ba/ yang dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈nga chen po chags 'dug gam 〉zhes pa las/ka pa/ bod yig yig tshad bya de'i sgo nga gnyis dang kho'i tse ya gcigang rtsis yig tshad yā rtse'i sgo nga gnyis dang o sun rkang gciglta bu gam tshig gi steng nas gzhad gad slong ba/de bzhin dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈lha sa'i bshad pa 〉zhes pa las/kha pa/ da g.yug bzhag gnang / sde pa gzhung gi jus gtogs sde srid mgo leb kyis byed kyi red/ka pa/ de las gdan skyag (bkyag ) 'og gi 9chang snod de la thugs 'khur gnang ba dga' yi red/lta bu gtam dpe'i steng nas gzhang gad slong ba/yang dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈ja chang gi rtsod gzhi 〉zhes pa las/ka pa/ da byas na de ja 'thung ba'i (btungs pa'i ) nor 'khrul red pas/kha pa/ a las/ da byas na de chang 'thung ba'i (btungs pa'i ) nor 'khrul red pas/ka pa/ ja'i nor 'khrul red pas/kha pa/ chang gi nor 'khrul red pas/lta bu rtsod pa'i steng nas bzhad gad slong ba/yang dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈gna' grong li/ ༷re phe 'gyur 〉 zhes pa las/ka pa/ nga tsho bod mi dmangs kyi blo gros snying bcud mtshon pa'i bzo skrun 372
chen po pho brang po ta lar gzigs dang / gser 'od chem chem/kha pa/ gser 'od chem chem/ka pa/ yang lo ngo stong phrag song ba'i ra sa'i gtsug lag khang la gzigs dang / gser 'od chem chem/kha pa/ gser 'od chem chem/ka pa/ lhun grub dga' tshal nor gling khams gsum zil gnon ( hab thob kyis ) gser 'od chem chem/lta bu lad zlos sam bskyar zlos kyi steng nas bzhad gad slong ba/ yang dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈klu gar gyi rgya mtsho 〉zhes pa las/ ka pa/ (ga 'as )phar la mig gcig bltas pas/ tshur la spyan gcig gzigs byung / spyan mig kri ba'i 'og nas/ las 'gro'i ('phro'i ) mdud pa thebs song / kha pa/(bu mo yin khul gyis ) sems pa dkar ba zhig dang / mnyam du 'gro rgyu byung na/ lham la dog pa med kyang / sim sim sim la phyin chog lta bu ga 'as dang rnam 'gyur steng nas bzhad gad slong ba sogs mdor na khong gis brtsams gnang ba'i gzhas ma gtam gsar pa dgod bro'i gtam gleng gi sgyu rtsal ni za 'og gsar pa'i ri mo ji bzhin rnam par bkra ba'o/ /bzhi pa/ 'khrab gzhas khrag bltas rjes kyi myo nga tshor/sku zhabs bsod tshe lags kyis mdzad pa'i 〈bzhad gad dpyid kyi pho nya 〉zhes pa'i dus deb nang sgra snyan dkrol gtong 〈rnam pa bzang 〉zhes pa dang 'khyab gzhas 〈gtam bzang 〉zhes pa/ de bzhin smyug rol mgyogs gtam 〈lha sa skor ba 〉zhes pa bcas sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba gsum 'dug kyang 373
'dir 〈'brab ga 'as 〉ches brjod pa yig rdzob nyung ba'i phyir yin pa mkhyen par mdzod/de yang khong gis brtsams gnang ba'i 'khrab bzhas de dag 'khrab sto na gnang ba kho bo'i 'dren byed yul du ma gyur yang 'khyab gzhung ri mor zhib tu bltas dzes kho bor myong tshor byung ba 'khyab tshan re re bzhin brjod na 'di lta ste/gcig sgra snyan dkrol gtong 〈rnam pa bzang 〉 zhes pa'i brjod bya'i don ni/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'dzom sa gros tshogs thengs gsu ma pa 'tshogs tshun mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad yar ngo'i zla bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel yod pa bstan pa ste/ 'khyab gzhung nang /tang gi tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs gsum pa'i rjes/rgyal yongs rnam pa nyin bzhin 'phel rgyas bzang /bod lco ngas sa ma tho'i 'thab phyogs khag rnams kyang /ngo mtshar ldan pa'i rnam pa kun las bzang / zhes pas mtshon pa lta bu'o/ /'khyab tshan 'di'i rnam pa'i thad phul du byung ba'i bod mi rigs kyi rol cha sgra snyan te/ ming gzhan la tam bu ra'am rgyud mangs sogs brjod pa 'di bzhin gangs ljongs spyi dang khyad par du gtsang dang dbus su de bas dar khyab che ba 'di nyid bed spyod gnang te gcig nas sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur dang /gnyis nas mi rigs kyi khyad chos/ gsum nas gsar rtsom gyi rang ba'i na ldan pa bcas gnang bar mngon no/ /gnyis/ 'khyab ga 'as 〈gtam bzang 〉zhes pa'i nang don gtso bo ni nga 374
tshos nges par du rang stobs rang spel dang dkar spyad 'bad brtson gyis dngos po'i dpal yon dar ba bya rgyu dang lhan cig bas ma pa'i dpal yon dar ba bya rgyu de ni de bas gal che ba 'ig yin pa bstan pa ni 'khyab gzhung nang /spyi tshogs ring lugs bsam pa'i dpal yon ni/spyi tshogs ring lugs gal che'i khyad chos yin/bsam pa'i dpal yon de la brten nas ni/dngos po'i dpal yon dar bar skul 'ded gyis/ zhes pas mtshon pa lta bu'o/'khyab tshan 'di'i rnam pa'i thad khyad chos gtso bo mi sna bkod sgrig yag po gnang yo da pa ste/ 'ing pa dang / 'brog pa/ 'thab 'dzing pa/ slob phrug bcas kyis rang rang gi las gnas sam/ phugs 'dun skor phan tshun gleng mol byas nas thun mong thog 'bad brtson byed dgos pa'i skul ma btang ba shugs las rtogs pa'o/ /gsum/ smyug rol mgyogs gtam 〈lha sa skor ba 〉zhes pa'i brjod bya'i nang don gtso bo ni gangs can spyi dang bye brag lha sa'i 'gyur ldog mngon mngon rjen rjen par rgyag mkhas can gyis par brgyab pa ba'i na kun gyi 'dren byed gzigs mor bshams yod do/ /'khrab tshan 'di'i rnam pa'i thad khyad du 'phags pa'am 'bur du thon pa'i mi sna gtso bo gsar 'god pa'i snang brnyan zhig bzhings yod pa ni sgyu rtsal gyi tshad ga'i mtho tsam yin par mngon/ mdor na khong gis brtsams pa'i 'a srib ga 'as gsum po ni ha las pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi 'khyab tshan red ces brjod par mi nus kyang thab chung yang me tsha ba'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin par 'dod do/ /375
lnga pa/ khong gi snying rus la slob ljong byed dgos pa'i myong tshor/sku zhabs bsod tshe lags kyis mdzad pa'i 〈bzhad gad dpyid kyi pho nya 〉zhes pa ni gangs can lo rgyus thog gzhag ma gtam rkyang pa'i deb dang po de yin zhing / kho bos 〈gzhad gad dpyid kyi pho nya 〉la bltas rjes sku zhabs khong gis bod kyi sgyu rtsal spyi dang / khyad par du gzhas ma gtam sgyu rtsal dar rgya shu ge kyi don du dus yun ring po'i nang snying rus chen pos gna' rtsom la zhib 'jug dang / snying rus chen pos 'tsho bar zhib 'jug snying rus chen pos skad yig la zhib 'jug bcas gnang nas snying rus chen pos gsar rtsom gnang yo da pa ni khong gi brtsams bya'i nang nas mthong thub pa ni/ dper na/ dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈nga chang gi rtsod gzhi 〉 zhes pa ni grags can gyi gna' rtsom 〈ja chang lha mo'i bstan bcos 〉 gzhir bzung nas snon 'phri gnang bar mngon/gal srid rtsom pa pos gna' rtsom la zhib 'jug ma gnang tshe 'di 'dra'i brtsams bya legs po yong ba shin tu dka'/ yang dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈gnas chen po ta la 〉zhes pa ni/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi dkar chag 〉sogs 'brel yod lo rgyus la zhib 'jug nan tan gnang nas brtsams bya legs grub byung bar nges/gal te de ltar ma gnang na po ta la bzhings mkhan las bzo'i gla phogs mang nyung zhib phra sogs gtan nas 'bri mi thub/ de bzhin khong gis snying rus chen pos 'tsho bar zhib 'jug ma gnang na dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈dbul bcos phyug 'gyur 〉zhes pa dang 'bras dkar 〈dga' ston rten 'brel 〉zhes pa/ da dung 'khyab gzhas 〈gtam bzang 〉zhes pa sogs kyi brtsam bya legs 376
po de 'dra yong mi thub cing / gzhan yang khong gis rgya skad dang bod skad kyis gtsos skad rigs khrag la snying rus chen pos zhib 'jug ma gnang na dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈ra ma lug 〉ces pa dang 〈rngo lo 'phyar ba 〉zhes pa sogs kyi brtsams bya gtan nas yong mi srid/ da dung khong gis dmangs khrod kyi rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal la snying rus chen pos slob sbyong ma gnang na dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈glu gar gyi rgya mtsho 〉zhes pa dang 〈gtam dpe'i rgya mtsho 〉zhes pa da dung 'bras dkar sna tshogs sogs kyang yong bar dka'o/ /des na nga'i bsam par nga tshos nges par du khong gis snying rus chen pos gna' rtsom la 'ib 'jug dang / snying rus chen pos 'tsho bar zhib 'jugsnying rus chen pos skad yig la zhib 'jug bcas gnang te blo khog chen pos sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom gnang ba'i snying stobs dang / snying rus la slob sbyong nges par du byed dgos pa'i myong tshor ha cang zab mo zhig byung ngo / /mdor na sku zhabs bsod tshe lags kyis mdzad pa'i 〈bzhad gad dpyid kyi pho nya 〉zhes pa par skrun gnang ba ni gangs can gzhas ma gtam sgyu rtsal 'thab phyogs kyi bkra shis pa'i bya ba zhig yin pa dang / phyis gzhas ma gtam gyi ched bsgrigs deb gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis thon rgyur lam yag po zhig bstan gnang yod cing /'di yi dge bas gangs can gzhas ma gtam sgyu rtsal gyi bstan pa sngar bas dar zhing rgyas pa dang / 'dzam gling yang rtse'i gnas mchog tu ched las ga 'as ma gtam tshogs pa zhig mi ring bar 'dzugs thub rgyu'i smon 'dun bcas 〈bzhad gad dpyid kyi pho nya 〉 bltas rjes kyi myong tshor zhes pa'i rtsom thung de re zhig rdzogs so/ /377
〈sprin gyi sgra dbyangs 〉bltas rjes kyi dran 'char phran bu gangs can rtsom rig kun gsal sgeg mo'i ngos/ /rtson/ sna rgyu skar bye ba bkra ba'i dbus / /ring nas tho rangs skar chen 'od ('dzin pa/ /snyan rtsom mig gi dga' ston srid na rgyal / /mdzes pa yid 'phrog lha mo'i mchor sgeg dang / /snyan pa dri za'i bu mo'i pi wang sgra/ /dpa' bo ge sar rgyal po'i sku brnyan sogs/ /kun kyang snyan rtsom me long nang na gsal/ /khyad par dus kyi cang shes rta pho yi/ /gom pa'i 'gros dang mthun pa'i snyan ngag rtsom/ /brjod bya rjod byed gsar pa'i rna rgyan des/ /snyan rtsom mdzes mar mtshar sdug 'phar ma bsnan/ /mkhas pa'i yon tan rin chen gser ba'i na brin/ /btsun pa'i yon tan pad ma'i spubs bzhin gtsang / /bzang po'i yon tan tsan dan dri bzhin bsil/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum rsha rlo rtsom 'di la dgyes/ /de phyir deng rtsom 'o mtsho bsrubs pa las/ /'khrungs pa'i snyan rtsom sprin gyi sgra dbyangs la/ /378
bltas pa'i dran 'char rgya mtsho'i chu thigs tsam/ /jus med jus 'khri bdag gis 'di na gtor/ /zhes pa'i mgo rtsom sho lo ka lnga tshar gcig gis mdun bsus nas 'dir thog mar gleng slong ba'i ga'i ma thung ngu zhig bri bar bya ste/de yang lo shas gong nas sbrang char rtsom sgrig khang gis gus par bla na med pa'i thugs khur gnang ste bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs deb bzhi bskur gnang mdzad 'dug kho bos de dag la 'ib tu bltas rjes ngo ma/ dga' tshor ha cang chen po byung / de'i rgyu mtshan ni gcig nas da cha rang cag bod kyi rtsom rig de chu tshad 'di 'dra zhig la slebs pa dang / gnyis nas dpe tshogs nang rang gi rtsom yig kyang gnyis dang phyed ka ( phyed ka ni don grub rgyal gyi rtsom 'phro kho bos brtsams pa re yin ) yang 'dug pas so/ /dpe tshos sa de dag li thog mar blo mthun sa ngas rgyas skya bas kyis sngon 'gro'i gtam 'ig mdzad 'dug pa rni rang re bod yig rtsom rig las don pa rnams kyi ma/dun skyo da lam sto na spro na me/ ngo mar 'khums/ sngon 'gro'i gtam de'i nang meg sngar rang res byed dgos pa'i kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi bya ba ma nga po zhig rgyu ma tshan dang bcas sa sungs 'dug pas kho bor yang skul ma ha cang chen po thebs shing / lhag par du khong gi sngon 'gro'i gtam nang ba dum/ bu gcig ste/ 88rig rtsal dpya da 'jog ni rtsom rig gsar rtsom bya 'gul nang gi las tshan gal chen 'ig yin la/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal las don dar rgyas gong 'phel du gtong ba'i sgu la shugs chen po cig kyang yin/ ris rtsal gsar rtsom/ yod na rig rtsal dpyad 'jog yod nges te/ de gnyis ni phan tshun brten nas 'byung ba dang / phan tshun grogs byed pa'i rtsod sgrub kyi 'brel ba yin/379
'on kyang mig sngar gyi gnas tshul dngos ltar na/ nga tsho'i rig rtsal gsar rtsom dang / rig rtsal dpyad 'jog gi las ka ni da dung do mi mnyam pa'i gnas su/ lus shing / rig rtsal dpyad 'jog ni rig rtsal gsar rtsom gyi rjes su lus te bod kyi deng rabs sgyu rtsal bya ba'i 'phrul 'khor hril po'i nang gi lhu tshigs nas med cig tu gyur 'dug lnga ces gsungs pa ni thugs shin tu mad pa'i gtam mo/ma gzhi khong gi bka' mol de ni rig pa'i gnas la spyan dkyus ring ba'i mkhas pa tshor rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dar rgyas yong ched dpyad rtsom mang tsam mdzad rgyu'i thugs re gnang ba zhig yin pa las blo dman bdag lta bur gsungs pa zhig ga la yin mod/ khong gi bka' mol dum bu des nga la stobs shugs sam blo khog chen po zhig sprad gnang byung bas/ kho bo'i bsam par snyan rtsom ched bsgrigs 〈sprin gyi sgra dbyangs 〉zhes par rang blos gang dpog gi dpyad rtsom thung ngu zhig 'bri bar 'dod nas snyan rtsom re re bzhin zhib tu bltas shing / bltas dzes kyi myong tshor zin bris brgyab zin mod bar lam stong brel gyi chom po tra dus kyi nor phyogs pas bya ba de da lta'i bar nar 'grangs su lus/dang po/ snyan rtsom gyi kha byang khag la bltas pa'i myong tshor/de yang 〈sprin gyi sgra dbyangs sminang gi dkar chag ltar na snyan rtsom gyi kha byang 89yod pa las ring shos yig 'bru sum cu byas pa 〈blo dang spobs pa'i stobs la 'jus nas gyi nar ma 'dug ldang zhig ces/ 'jig rten shing rta kun gyi mar gyur ma pham g.yu mtshos 'di skad gsungs 〉zhes pa de dang / kha byang thung shos yig 'bru gnyis byas pa 〈ri bong snya dang / 〈glog sgron 〉 〈snying gtam 〉lta bu kha shas 'dug380
de dag kyang sgrig pa pos phul du byung ba'i blo rtsal la brten nas thog mar deb kyi kha byang 〈sprin gyi sgra dbyangs 〉 zhes bkod gnang mdzad pa ni ched bsgrigs 'di'i nang gi snyan rtsom gyi kha byang 〈bod kyi yi ge la bsngags pa lhag bsam sprin gyi sgra dbyangs 〉zhes pa las drangs par mngon/da dung snyan rtsom gzhan rnam tra ge kyang 〈dpyid kyi bdag mo lha las babs pa nyidang / 〈dngul gyi me tog 〉〈bsngags smon zla ba 'bum gyi snang ba 〉〈zhu 'phrin bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 〉bcas khrag bzhi ru dbye gnang mdzad 'dug pas gong gsal kha byang bzhi bo dang deb kyi kha byang ni ches phul du byung ba'i kha byang yin par nges la/ de dag las kyang 〈dpyed kyi bdag mo lha las babs pa 〉zhes pa'i kha byang la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos 'dug da dung 〈sprin gyi sgra dbyangs snyanang gi kha byang 〈lhod kyis 'phangs pa'i nyag phran nyidang /〈dung sems kyi 'char snang 〉〈sprin gyi sa 'dzin 〉〈skyed mos tshal gyi dri ba 〉sogs kyang sgyu rtsal gyi tshad gzhi mtho la kha byang gsar ba yin pas klog pa pos dkar chag mthong ma thag kha byang de dag gi snyan rtsom la blta nges yin/dper na/ 〈lhod kyis 'phangs pa'i nyag phran 〉zhes pa'i kha byang mthong ma thag dal bur 'phangs pa'i mda' mo 'ig zer ba go mod mda' mo de gang la 'phangs yod min dang / da dung mda' mo ni myur ba'i dpe ru 'jog kyang 'dir lhod kyis sam dal bur 'phangs pa zhes brjod dgos don gang yin nam snyam pa sogs kha byang des klog pa por dri ba zhig 'don nges red/don du rtsom pa pos brjod par 'dod pa'i dmigs bya de la mda' mo nan du 'phangs yod mod tshig thal drags pa'am dmar drags med par thabs mkhas po'am cung 'jam pos brjod yod pa ni rtsom de'i mjug gi tshig 381
rkang gcig ste/ 66tshig gi mtheb shed yongs su ma spyad lhod kyis thal lo/ zhes pas mtshon/ 'di lta'i kha byang ni dper 'os pa 'ig red snyam/gang lags she na// snyan rtsom 〈sprin gyi sgra dbyangs 〉kyi khag bzhi pa 〈zhu 'phrin bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 〉 zhes pa'i nang gi snyan rtsom tshang ma'i brjod bya slob gso las ma 'das shing / de dag gi kha 9byang 〈rkang rjes 〉zhes pa phud/gzhan dag 'dra tsam yod pa dper na 〈snying gtam nyidang / 〈snying gtam rna ba'i bdud rtsi 〉〈yar sems skul ba'i snying gtam 〉〈bden gtam gzhon nu gso ba'i bdud rtsi 〉〈rang sems gyong po 'dul ba'i gsal 'debs 〉lta bu yin pas/ 〈lhod kyis 'phangs pa'i nyag phran 〉la de dag dang mi 'dra ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ldan pa ni mngon gsal dod po ma yin nam/ gzhan〈nga yis nyi zla'i 'byung gnas 'tshog zhing snyeg 〉ces pa lta bu ni sgyu rtsal gyi tshad ches mtho ba'i kha byang du mngon/ kha byang 〈spyang rjes/ mi rjes/ rta'i rmig rjes nyidang /〈'bag sku'i zhal ras 〉lta bu ni sngar nas cung khyab che ba'i thun mong gi kha byang yin pa dang / 〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs nyidang / 〈'jar pan du slebs pa'i mthong thos 〉〈tsha chu'i byung ba brjod pa 〉sogs ni brjod bya'i don thad 'bri byas pa 'ig yin pas kha byang la bltas ma thag rtsom gyi nang don rtogs thub pa'i khyad chos ldan/ gzhan yang 〈bod ljo ngas nor 'dzin 'dzam gling spyi bo'i rgyan 〉zhes pa dang / 〈blo dang spobs pa'i stobs la 'jus nas gyi nar ma 'dug ldang zhig ces/ 'jig rten shing rta kun gyi mar gyur ma pham g.yu mtshos 'di skad gsungs 〉lta bu ni rang gi snyan rtsom nang gi don snying mtshon pa'i tshig rkang re gnyis bdams nas khu byang du bkod pa zhig yin pas/ kha byang 'di dag la dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos yod thog srol rgyun shul 'dzin byas pa zhig 382
kyang yin te/dper na/ bod kyi dmangs ga 'as phal mo che dang / tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu la sogs pa'i glu gzhas mang po zhig gi kha byang du ga a sa tshig nang nas tshig rkang re kha byang du bkod yod pa tshang mas mkhyen gsal lags /da dung 〈sprin gyi sgra dbyangs 〉 nang gi snyan rtsom gyi kha byang tshang mar rang rang gi khyad chos re yod pa smos med yin mod// re zhig yi ga rdzob la 'jigs nas rgyas par mi spro'o/ / mdor na kho bo'i bsam par rtsom yig gi kha byang yag po tshig 'dems rgyu ni shin tu gal che bar mthong bas/ nga tshos slad phyin rtsom yig gi kha byang sngar la sa sna mang phun sum tshogs pa thig yong ched/ gcig nas sngon byon mkhas dbang rnam pa'i snyan rtsom gyi kha byang / dper na/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i snyan rtsom gyi kha byang dang / blo bzang dpal ldan gyi snyan rtsom mam chab shog gi kha byang lta bur slob sbyong dang de dag rgyun 'dzin byed dgos pa dang / gnyis nas rang gi rig pa'i rtsal las thon pa'i kha byang gsar rtsom byed dgos pa/ dper na/〈sprin gyi sgra dbyangs 〉las dkar chag nang ma 'khod pa/ 〈gsar bzhad ljang bu nyidang / 〈phyi rol dang nang rol 〉〈phyi phyag 〉〈rna tso 〉〈then chags 〉〈rlabs phreng 〉lta bu'i kha byang gsar rtsom byed dgos pa dang /ri gsum nas phyi'i skad ri yig dang / lhag par du rgya yig thog nas brtsams pa'i rtsom yig gi kha byang la slob sbyong byed dgos pa/ dper na/ rgya yig gi rtsom yig ring po dang / brnyan 'phrin dang glog brnyan sogs 'ga' zhig la kha byang yig 'bru gcig las bkod med kyang don tsho 'ing grend la 'khel ba/ snyan pa sogs kyi khyad chos ldan pas de 'dra rang re'i bod yig tu med pa ga la srid/ de yang yin te/ snyan rtsom gyi kha byang la 〈'a ma nyidang /༷ 383
〈las 〉〈sems 〉〈zhen 〉〈mthu 〉lta bu gang du bkod chog par sems/ mig sngar bod yig thog nas brtsams pa'i snyan rtsom nang / 〈sprin nyidang / 〈chu 〉〈dbyar 〉lta bu kha shas mthong rgyu 'dug kyang snyan rtsom 〈sprin gyi sgra dbyangs 〉nang yig 'bru gcig byas pa'i kha byang mthong rgyu mi 'dug go /gnyis pa/ brjod bya'i don la bltas pa'i myong tshor/snyan rtsom ched bsgrigs 〈sprin gyi sgra dbyangs 〉 nang du sna kha mi 'dra ba'i brjod bya'i don phun sum tshogs po yod pa ni blangs na 'dzad mtha' med pa'i nor bu'i bang mdzod dang 'dra ste/ brjod bya 'ga' zhig yo cos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi 'bod sgra dang / 'ga' zhig mi rigs mthun sgril gyi klu dbyangs/'ga' zhig mdun skyod kyi gom sgra dang / 'ga' zhig phugs bsam 'tshol snyegda dung 'ga' zhig blun rmongs gnyid las slong ba'i dung brda dang / la la bsngags 'os bsngags pa dang smad 'os smad pa/ de bzhin 'ga' zhig pha yul gyi ri chu'i mdzes ris dang / 'ga' zhig zur za za sar 'khrug pa'i drang srong gi lag pa sogs rin chen thang mar brdal ba dang 'dra ba bgrang gis mi langs yang / 'dir dpe mtshon tsam du brjod bya'i nang don khyad du 'phags pa'i snyan rtsom 〈ka rtsom gnod sbyin pho brang dkrug pa'i 'phrul 'khor 〉dang / 〈son 'debs 〉zhes pa gnyis kyi nang don la bltas rjes kyi myong tshor 'ga' zhig gleng bar bya'o/ /de yang / 〈ka rtsom gnod sbyin pho brang dkrug nga/'i 'phrul 'khor 〉zhes pa de ni snyan ngag gi rgyan dang brda rnying / mngon brjod sogs kyis bcings pa zhig ma yin par/ rang re bod yig gi thun min rtsom srol ka rtsom mam ka 384
bshad shin tu go bde ba'i tshig gi lam nas drangs pa zhig yin yang / ka rtsom de'i brjod bya'i don da lta'i 'tsho ba gson po mtshon thub pa zhig yin pas/des klog pa po'i yid dbang med du 'gugs thub pa byung 'dug /deng gi char tshang mas dngul gyi don du 'bad brtson byed kyi yod pa dang /dngul med na bya ba ci yang sgrub mi thub pa zhig yin mod/ rang nyid kyi lag gnyis dang blo gros la brten nas dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyis dngul gsog dgos pa las/ dngul gyi ched du srid jus dang bca' khrims la 'gal ba dang / mi rigs kyi la rgya dor ba/ las rgyu 'bras mi brtsi ba sogs ni ches tha shal zhig yin pa las bsgyur bcos kyi 'bras bu zhig ga la yin/ der brten rtsom yig 'di'i rtsom pa pos mig sngar spyi tshogs thog gi mi nyung shas shig gis dngul byung na 88 pha'i mgo bo'ang 'tshong phrod pa/sa lta bu'i gnas tshul gzigs dus thugs kyis ma bzod par rtsom 'di 'bri gnang mdzad pa yin shas che/de ltar yin pa ni rtsom yig 'di'i rtsom pa po'i rtsom mang che ba zhig ni rab btags sam yang na cung zad sbas pa'am bskor ba'i thabs kyis brjod par snang yang / 〈ka rtsom gnod sbyin pho brang dkrug pa'i 'phrul 'khor 〉gyi brjod bya ni ches gsal por brjod pa des mtshon la/ da dung rtsom yig 'di'i mjug tu((snyug thogs pa 'ju skal bzang du 'bod pas da lta thams cad sgor mo sgor mo zer ba 'dis yid sun nas khams dang snang ba mi dwangs pa'i nyin 'og la gna' mkhar zi ling grong gi gru ga zhig tu shar mar bris/nya zhes 'al sangs nas gsungs 'dugde yang ma gzhi ka rtsom 'di'i khu byang la 〈gnod sbyin pho brang dkrug pa'i ༷ 385
mkhas grub kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod bdams sgrig——— ——bab——tsho —4ge go rtse rtse ༅ —'phrul 'khor 〉 zhes bkod pa ltar rtsom 'di gzhan la sun 'byin gnang ba zhig yin mod/ khong ge brtsams chos kyi nang don ni btang snyoms shig yin pa las chags sdang ci yang med de/ dper na/ 88 ka ba bum pa zer ba'i grwa pa tshos rigs la ma mi rtsod sgor mo rtsod/ kha ton dge sbyor byed pa'i a mtshad dag dge ba mi gsog sgor mo gso ga nya ces pa sogs chos byed rna khan dang /88ka kha ga nga slob pa'i byis pa tshos dbyangs gas la mi klog sgo ra mo klog / kha rog ma ṇi 'don ran rgas 'khogs dag phreng ba mi bgrang sgor mo bgrang / / 99'es pa byis pa dang rgan rgon/ 66 ja chang hab thob byed pa'i mgo 'dren pas gsar brje'i bden don sgor mo rnyed/ / lta nya mo mgo bder 'khyug pa'i tang yon dag rgyang ring dmigs 'ben sgor mo rnyed/ 8 ces mgo khrid dang tang yon/ de bzhin 'ing pa dang 'brog pa so gas mdor na bya ba'am las rigs thams cad kyi nang du spyod tshul ngan pa ste/ dngul kho na gas gang yang mi sems mkhan yo da par sun 'byin gnang ba dang / lhag par du tha dad skad yig mi shes tshong 'khyams tsho sgor mo yod na lam yig yin/ da ning btson nas btang ba'i nyes can rnams sgo ra mo yod na gzi brjid yin/ / nya zhes pa 'di ni de bas shin tu bden pa'i gtam yin te/ de 'dra spyi tshogs thog dngos su mthong rgyu mang po zhig yod pa bzhin red/ de bas/ rtsom pa pos mjug tu 66ha lam de ltar lags kyang chos pa tsho yod tshad de 'dra ga la yin/ /a cang ku re yin mod a khu rnams phal cher de tshod yin pa 'dra/ / ha cang zhib mor dpyad na khyim pa tsho 'ga' zhig de 'dra min las che/ / sa zhes gsungs yod pas khong gis mi nyung shas shig la sun 'byin gnang ba las/ /thams cad la gsungs pa zhig min pas 66yod na yo srang dang / med na dogs 386
zon 99 phyed dgos pa'i slob gso gnang ba zhig go /de ba'i na du snyan rtsom 〈so na 'debs 〉 tshes pa der sho lo ka ba'i dang /yig 'bru dgu bcu go drug las med kyang / brjod bya'i nang ngon ni gzugs chung yang gser si mde'u thes pa dang yongs su mtshungs/rtsom yis 'di'i brjod bu'i snying ngo/ mi/ 66phyi yi bras la sa ba/ka ra sa so la ba la sa / / nang gi mchod kong mar khus brgyangs pa dga'/: / nya ches pa de dang 'dra ba'am snyam/ rtsom yis 'di'i nang rtsom pa pos thugs tha gro chod pos 88 rgya lcang 'debs blo mi 'dug nya ces gsu ngas pa ni 'bras bu med pa 'i bya ba 'ig bya 'dod mi 'dug ces gsungs pa yin nam snyam/ de yang rgyu ma tshan med par((rgya lcang 'debs blo mi 'dug 86 ces gsungs pa ga la yin te/ na ning mi ga a na la lad zlos kyis gshong te sa cha dam 'a sa 'ig la ke'u tshe btab kyang de ni 'bras bu ma smin gong rwa pho gyang nas mchongs te lo ma bzas pas ngal ba 'bras med du gyur pa dang / da lo sa cha 'bur 'bur te mtho sa zhig la kun dong btab kyang de yang khyim mtshes kyi bya pho bya mos sdong bu rtsa ba nas bcad de slar yang ngal ba 'bras med du gyur pas/ da ni rjes ma'i lo ste dus sang nas66rgya lcang 'debs blo mi 'dug ces gsungs so/ / gang yin zhe na/ gong gsal gyi nyams myong la sa rgya lcang btab kyang yal ga'i kho 'a ga rdzogs dus rang la dbang tshod med pa shes thub pas so/ / da 'o na lag pa bskums nas sdod dgos sam zhe na/ de ltar ga la yin/ de las gangs rir log ste dbyar dgun dbye ba med pa'i thang shing sngon mo legs par bskyangs na/ 'o kha shas phyin rjes gdung 'degs ka ba yo nga nges yin ches phugs bsam/ 'tshol rnyeg gnang yod do/ / de yang kho bos tshod dpag byas pa nor med na/ rtsom yig 387
