mkhas pa'i dbang po chab spel tsho brtan phun tshogs mchog gi snyan rtsom 〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs 〉zhes pa'i skor cung zad gleng ba/gleng gzhi/mtho mtho gangs ri'i snyan ngag rgyal po ste/ /mkhas mkhas chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyis/ /snyan snyan ljags rtsom bltas pa'i myong tshor 'ga'/ /'khyug 'khyug ri mo'i lam nas bdag gis spro/ /e ma ho/ deng gi char sman ljongs bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhal med khang bzang 'degs pa'i 'gyur med ka ba ltar 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po rgyu skar bye ba'i khrod snyan grags kyi gzi 'od nya gang zla ba ltar chol kha gsum las brgal te yangs pa'i 'dzam gling kun tu ches cher 'phro ba'i nges pa don gyi mkhas grub gnyis ldan chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs mchog ni bod kyi rig pa'i gnas kun la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa mnga' ba zhig yin la/ khyad par du khong gis mdzad pa'i ljags rtsom ni skad yig sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad mtho zhing / brjod don 'bras bus dud pa/ lta ba shel ltar gsal la thun min gyi khyad chos ldan la rin thang bral ba sha stag yin pa ni mkhas rgu 405
mkhas grub kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod bdams sgrigwa tre bon wa cig ci rtse — ——wa bgowamgrin gcig yin/:de yang yod med ma nges pa'i las dbang zhig gis smyug 'dzin pa kho bo dang mkhas dbang khong thog mar gser 'al mjal ba'i bskal pa bzang po'i dus ni 1981lo ste/ lo der gus pa lho kha sa khul gra nang rdzong rgyal gling shang gi dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal pa'i 'thus mi'i ming thog nas ( de dus shang gi las zhor lha mo tshogs pa'i 'khrab ston pa dang gzhung shod mkhan yin ) bod rang skyong ljongs rig gnas sgyu rtsal mnyam 'brel tshogs pa'i tshogs chen thengs dang por zhugs dus mkhas dbang chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs mchog dang /mkhas dbang hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar mchog sogs dngos su mjal 'ing byams brtse'i gsung gi bdud rtsi thob pas than gdung lnga nga pa ra sbrang char babs pa lta bu'i yid dga' bas myo sa te de sngon rang gis bris pa'i don rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod cig yo da par bzo bcos phran bu byas te chab spel lags mchog la spyan bltar zhus pas mdzad brel shin tu che na'ang tshogs 'du ma grol gong nas/ legs bcos 'ib phra gnang ba ma zad/ ji ltar byas te snyan rtsom de bas chu tshad mtho ba'am spus ka legs pa 'bri thabs skor bka' slob gnang ba dang sbrags snyan gzhung me lo nga gi dper brjod cha tshang 'ig 'bri dgos pa'i las 'gan yang gnang / de rjes lho kha sa khul rig rtsal lhan tshogs dbu brnyes pa dang 〈lho kha'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 gsar du bton zhing /thengs dang po'i lho kha'i bod yig rtsom 'bri sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa gnyer nas rang ljongs kyi grags dbang mkhas can dung dal ra rin po che mchog dang /mkhas dbang chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs mchos de bzhin mkhas dbang dpal 'byor lags dang stobs rgyal la gas sogs gdan drangs nas slob 406
'khrid zla phyed la nye ba gnang cing / slob mjug 'gril ba'i slob ma tsho'i rang rang yig rgyugs rtsom yig dpyad bsdur nang mkhas dbang rnam pa dang / khyad par du chab spel lags mchos nas kho bo'i snyan rtsom la gdeng 'jog dang bstod bsngags chen po gnang ba des gus par sngar med rtsom yig 'bri ba'i sems shugs dang snying sto bas shig 'khrungs te de nas bzung rtsom yig chad med bris pa dus deb dang tshags par khag thog 'god thub pa byung ba ma zad snga phyir ched bsgrigs deb brgyad kyang par bskrun 'grems spel byed thub pa byung ba mi mkhas dbang chab spel mchog gi bka' drin dang kha bral thabs med pas ngas ga dus yin rung khong gi bka' drin snying bcangs dang / khong la dad gus tshad med zhu ba'i na yo da/dang po/ khong gi snyan rtsom 〈bsi la dus kyi bod ljongs 〉zhes par bltas rjes kyi myong tshor/tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar khong gi snyan rtsom 〈 bsil dus kyi bod ljongs 〉zhes pa de ni ljongs phyi nang gang sar ska da grags yod pa dang / rim pa mtho ba'i bya dga' gzengs bstod mang po thob myong ba ma zad ljongs dang 'ing chen lnga'i gcig 'gyur bod yig slob deb thog ba bod nas blo gsar stong phrag du ma'i snyan ngag gas ra rtsom gyi blo sgo yangs por phye dang 'bye bzhin yod pas bsngags brjod kyi me tog mi gtor mkhan mkhas pa su yang med/ des na blo dman kho bos kyang khong gi snyan rtsom/ de thog mar 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉thog bkod pa nas bzung dus da lta bar khong gi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs yi na na'ang 'dra/ slob deb thog bkod pa yin na'ang 'dra/ gang ltar yang 407
nas yang du bltas shing zhib tu phra bar brtag pas da cha spyir na ched du ngag skyor ma btang yang yid la 'jags yod pas kho bos gsham du khong gi snyan rtsom 〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs 〉kyi dge mtshan dang khyad chos skor nang gses dum chung lnga'i thog nas gleng bar 'dod pa ni mkhas dbang khong la phul ba'i drin gso'i mchod sprin bsngags brjod kyi me tog dang / mkhas dbang khong 'bas pad rdo rje ltar brtan pa'i lhag bsam gyi gsol smon tsam yin pa las sa steng skye bo'i lag rtses mkha' yi zla bar lag rtsed rtse 'dod pa ltar mi 'jon 'jon mdog dang sangs rgyas la ka kha bsgron pa ni gtan nas min pas lhan rgyas kyis rgyal ba lnga pa dang zla ba lnga pa go nor med pa ci nas kyang mkhyen/gnyis pa/ snyan rtsom de'i kha byang gi skor/rtsom yig gang 'dra zhig yin yang thog mar kha byang 'bri dgos pa dang /kha byang yag po zhig 'dems rgyu ni rtsom de yag po yong ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin zhing / rtsom yig hril po'i nang don yang kha byang gi lte ba byas pa'i khor yug zhe gcig yin dgos/ des na rtsom yig kha byang ni ring po med kyang don mtshon pa dang / gsal po yod kyang sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad mtho ba/ mi sems thog mar yid dbang 'phrog thub pa mdzes ma'i bzhin ras lta bu zhig dgos pas kha byang yag po zhig 'bri rgyu ni gal che la dka' ngal yang cung che ba zhig yin/'on kyang mig sngar gsar skyes rtsom pa po 'ga' zhig gis rtsom yig gi kha byang 'dems rgyur do snang mi byed pa ma zad tha na kha shas kyis rtsom yig bris tshar rjes gzhi nas kha byang 'bri gi yod pa de dag la bltos nas bshad na mkhas dbang chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs rwa chog gi 〈bsil dus kyi bod 408
ljongs 〉zhes pa sogs kha byang 'dems gnang mdzad stangs la nges par du slob sbyong zhu dgos pa smos mi dgos pa thig red/de yang mkhas dbang khong gis thog mar snyan rtsom gyi kha byang 〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs 〉ched mngags 'dems gnang mdzad dgos don ci yin the na/ kho bo'i ngos 'dzin la mkhas dbang khong ni bod kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag ches byang chub pa zhig yin pa'i 'byung khungs sam cha rkyen gtso bo ni gre/cis nas khong la thun min gyi blo ris dang rtsom rtsal 'ig yod nga/ dang / gnyis nas dka' spyad snying rus kyi blo sto bas dang srol bzang 'ig yod pa/ gro su ma nas spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i nyams myong phun sum tshogs po yo da pa/ bzhi nas snyan ngag gsar rtsom la ha cang mnyes po yod pa/ lnga nas grags can gyi rtsom yig gzigs rgyur dgyes pa'i goms gshis ha cang bzang po 'ig yod pa bcas las byung ba'i 'bras bu zhig yin pas khong gis thog mar grags can rtsom yig mang po gzigs nas de dag gis kha byang la dpyad gzhi gnang yo da pa dper na/khong gis snyan gzhung me long le'u gsum ka dang / khyad par du me long mang gī dper brjod yul ljongs la bsngags pa dang / nyi zla 'char nub la bsngags pa/dus bzhir bsngags pa sogs la sbyangs pa mthar phyin gnang nas nge dag gi zla byang dpyad gzhi gnang ba dang / dus mtshungs grags can gyi rtsom yig 〈bsngags 'os bsngags pa nyidang / 〈gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod/〉 〈ra ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod/〉 〈tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu 〉sogs la zhib tu gzigs nas de dag gi kha byang dpyad ga'i ra gnang ba dang / de bzhin cha mang phun sum tshogs pa'i bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig la zhib 'jug nan tan gnang nas de dag gi kha byang la dpyad gzhi gnang ba sogs kyi khyad chos 409
'bur du thon pa'i ched du snyan rtsom de'i kha byang 〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs 〉zhes pa de gdam ga gnang ba red snyam/gsum pa/ snyan rtsom de'i brjod don gyi skor/gcig snyan rtsom de'i brjod don ni/ tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar bsil dus kyi bod ljongs te dgun dus kyi pod ljongs sa mtho'i phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang / nang skye bo'i rtsol ba par du btab pa bzhin yi ge'i lam nas kun la gzigs mor bshams pa de yin/de yang khong gis brjod don de 'dra zhig 'dems gnang mdzad dgos don ci yin zhe na/ de ni rtsom pa po sku ngo mas ma gtos sa la na cha tshang 'debs mi thub pa zhig yin mod/ kho bos gang bsam de rang gleng bar bya ste/ khong gis brjod don de 'dra zhig 'dems gnang mdzad dgos don ni/ gcig nas 〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs 〉zhes pa'i nang gi bsil dus ni dgun dus kyi mngon brjod yin zhing / mngon brjod de ltar sbyar dgos pa'am 'dogs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bod ljongs sa mtho 'di bzhin spyir na gnam gshis bsil ba'i ljongs yin pas bod ljongs kyi mngon brjod la'ang bsil ljongs zer/ lha ga par du bod kyi dgun dus ni gnam gshis de bas grang 'a /gangs babs shugs che ba dang babs rgyun ring bas ring nas bod ljongs la bsil ljongs zhes kun tu grags pa de ni don dngos dang yongs su mthun pa'i mngon brjod zhig ste/ rang cag 'dzam gling yang rtse'i rgya/ phibs g.yar po'i pha yul gangs can sa mtho'i mtha' bzhi gangs ri dkar pos yongs su bskor ba dang / ri mgo mtho ba thams cad kyi dbu la gangs kyi dbu zhwa bzhes yod pa de 410
ni bod kyi dmigs bsal khyad chos shig yin pas snyan rtsom 〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs 〉zhes pa'i brjod don ni dgun dus zhes pa 'dzam gling yul gru kun la yo da kyang bod kyi dgun dus kyi dmigs bsal khyad chos dam du bzung gnang mdzad yod pa ni dper na snyan rtsom de'i nang 88ka shi'i ras kyi mdzes pa rab 'phrog dgun dus bod kyi yu la ljo ngas ni/ / kha ba'i zegs mas yongs su klub ( bklubs ) pa'i ke la sha ring kun nas bskor/ / ga bur rdul gyis dbyig 'dzin sgeg mo'i ba'i na gyi ra ri ma lus bkrus/ / nga cag mes rgyal ma tha' ma tshams 'di ni rab dkar ba so 'i gzhong pa 'dra/ / lta zhes dgun dus kyi rbad ljongs sa mtho khyon yongs kyi phyi snod rang byung gi mdzes ljongs ji ma ji bzhin gsal bar bstan pa dang / 88tsa ko ra ltar grang ngar zil gnon zhum med dpa' bo'i mi dmangs rnams/ / tsha grang 'gyur ldog che ba'i gnam gshis gang la'ang mi 'jigs se nga se lta ro/ / dza drag brtan lhong zhing 'bros las rigs thon skyed 'dzugs skrun ri ku' ga nang / / wa ler deng bzhi snying 'a bcangs bzhin rgyang skyod gsar par gom chen spo/ / zhwa gos pags pa'i gra 'i rab rgyas dga' spro'i glu sgras bar sna nga 'gengs/ / za btung bcud ldan rlo mar ja chang ci dgar rol ba'i 'tsho ba bskrun/ ( skrun) 'a kur 'drud 'then 'khor lo sna tshogs las grwa'i phyogs mtshams kun tu rgyu/ / ya mtshan rdzas me'i 'bar gas shugs kyis rang byung ri brag mgo bo dud/ / ga ces dgun dus kyi nang bcud kyi skye 'gro'i rtsol ba gsal bar bstan pa dang ༈lhag par du snyan rtsom 〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs nyi nang / 88ca gas rab bskyangs gsar du btsugs pa'i 'bras ldan shing dang skyed mos tshal cha shas yul gyi gdod ma'i nags dang 'dzam gling yang rtser sngar med kyi/ / ja 411
shing 9ro sobs rkang 'thung kun kyang sring bal las byas 'khri shing la/ / nya rgyas zla ba'i 'od kyis spud ba'i na ('dren byed zim bus blta la 'god/lta ces dang /88 ta ma las g.yogs chu shel can bzhin dgun brgal skyes dngos sna tshogs kyang / / tha ram grang ba'i reg bya 'gog ched gangs dkar phying pa'i mal chas gyon/ / da dung dwangs bsil yan lag brgyad ldan chu dang chu phran thams cad kyang / / na chung gser mig can dang lhag cig 'khyags rom g.yang ṭi'i khang par nyal/ / lta zhes pa'i sho lo ka sngon mas dgun dus bod ljongs kyi 'bras ldan shing dang / skyes mos tshal/ gdod ma'i nas sa sogs rkang 'thung yod do cog srin bal las byas pa'am srin bal gyis bzos pa'i 'khri shing dkar po la/nya rgyas zla ba'i 'od kyis spud pa ste zla 'od 'phros pas de bas dkar por gyur nga gas la por bstan pa dang / sho lo ka phyi mas dgun dus bod ljongs kyi yangs pa'i sa ga'i chen pos grang ngar 'a gog ched phying pa dkar po'i mal chas ste/ gangs dkar gyi mal gzan gyon pa dang / dwangs bsil yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu bo dag kyang rang gi brtse grogs nya chung gser mig can dang lhag cig g.yang ṭi'i khang ste/ 'khyags pa'i khang pa'i nang bde bar nyal zhes dgun dus bod kyi sa ga'i dang gtsang chu sogs glog brnyan nang nas bstan pa ltar dpe don rab tu mtshungs shing rna bar snyan la go bde'i tshig sbyor gyi lam nas gsal bar bstan pa dang / de bzhin 66ra ltar 'gying ba'i ri khug rnams su gting dpag dka' ba'i chu mdzod bskrun/ / la dang lung pa sa 'khod snyoms nas pha mtha' yas pa'i zhing thang bcos/ / sha 'od than zhod rang byung gnod 'tshe'i g.yul 'a sa rnam par rgyal byas nas/ / sa rgod dag kyang deng rabs bzhi'i ched 'bru rigs sna lnga 'bul du 'jug ces dang 66ha las 412
mtha' med rtswa thang khyon du'ang le dbar stong ldan rtswa ra bskor/ / ha lam ri klung gang sar khyab pa'i phyugs rigs dkar nag khyu dang khyu/ / a ho nam mkha'i mi ltung phreng ba sa gzhi'i ngos su 'phos ltar mdzes/ / a la la zhes 'dzam gling yang rtser deng rabs can gyi bod gsar 'dzugs zhes pa'i sho lo ka sngon mas dgun dus bod kyi zhing khul du chu mdzod bskrun pa dang / zhing thang gi sa rgyu legs bcos byed pa/ rang byung gi gnod 'tshe 'gog pa sogs kyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin pa gsal bar bstan pa dang / sho lo ka phyi mas dgun dus bod kyi 'brog khul du rtswa ra bskor ba dang / phyugs rigs dkar nag 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i rba rlabs 'phyur ba sogs gsal por bstan yod pas mtshon snyan rtsom 〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs 〉la khyon sho lo ka dgu las med kyang brjod don ha cang mang po zhig chu brgya zam 'dus kyis gsal por bstan yod/gnyis/ snyan rtsom 〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs 〉ni lo rabs brgyad bcu shar ma thag brtsams gnang mdzad pa zhig yin pas de'i brjod don nang skabs de dus kyi bod khul gyi dngos yod gnas tshul na gsal dod tsam yod pa dper na snyan rtsom de'i nang 66'a 'ur 'drud 'then 'khor lo sna tshogs las grwa'i phyogs mtshams kun tu rgyu/ / ya mtshan rdzas me'i 'bar gas shugs kyis rang byung ri brag mgo bo dud/ / nya ces par mtshon na skabs de dus sam de'i gong du bod kyi zhing grong khul du rlangs 'khor che gras nyo mkhan nam nyo thub mkhan ches nyung zhing dar so che shos ni lag skyor 'drud 'then 'khor lo yin pas snyan rtsom de'i nang skabs de dang de'i gong gi gnas tshul dngos te lag skyor 'drud 'then 'khor lo las grwa khag gi phyogs su brel brel 'tshub 'tshub 413

dgos pa zhig red/gal srid bod kyi rtsom rig spyi dang / lhag par du bod yig thog nas brtsams pa'i rtsom yig la bod kyi khyad chos med na rtsom yig de ni sa mtho'i 'tsho ba dngos dang / sa mtho'i rig gnas sgyu rtsal/ de bzhin sa mtho'i mi rigs kyi thun min dri bsung 'thul ba'i me tog sos pa zhig ma yin par phyi mdzes nang stong 'gyig gi me tog byis pa'i ma bo bo 'khor lo ltar bskor phyed cig red ces kho bos mgrin pa gzengs su btegs nas smra bar bya'o/ /drug pa/ snyan rtsom de'i rtsom 'go dang rtsom 'jug gi skor/kho bos zhib tu brtag pa na snyan rtsom 〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs 〉kyi rtsom 'go 'dzugs stangs dang / lhag par du rtsom mjug bsdu stangs thun mong ma yin pa zhig tu mthong ba dper na/ thog mar rtsom 'go'i tshigs bcad sho lo kha gcig ste/ 88ka shi'i ras kyi mdzes pa rab 'phrog dgun dus bod kyi yul ljongs ni/ kha ba'i zegs mas yongs su klub pa'i ke la sha ris kun nas bskor/ ga bur rdul gyis dbyig 'dzin sgeg mo'i bzhin gyi ra ri ma lus bkrus/nga cag mes rgyal mtha' mtshams 'di ni rab dkar ba so'i gzhong pa 'dra/:ltazhes thugs dgongs rgya che ba dang / brjod don rgya che ba/ tshig sbyor rgya che ba bcas rgya che ba gsum gyi steng nas brjod par 'dod pa'i bod kyi dgun dus kyi mdzes ljongs gsal bar ston pa'i rtsom 'go gnam gru'i babs thang ltar shin tu yangs por phye rjes rim bzhin mtsho mjal gyi zhal khebs phye ba ltar sa mtho'i dgun dus kyi yangs pa'i nor 'dzin dpal mo dang / rtswa dang rtsi shing / chu dang chu phran sogs glog brnyan nang nas bstan pa ltar bkod yod/418
lhag par du ma jug tu rtsom yig 'di'i rtsom mjug bsdu stangs ni kho rbas bltas na thun mong ma yin pa zhig 'dug pa tshig gcig tu bsdus nas bshad na 66rtsom mjug nyis brtsegs bsdus pa nya de yin/ de yang gus pas sngon med gsar bzos byas pa'i tha snyad 86rtsom mjug nyis brtsegs bsdus pa lta thes pa de ni sngon la rtsom yig gi mjug bsdus zin yang slar gal po che la nan tan gyi dpe ltar rtsom mjug bskyar ma zhig bsdus par zer/gus pas de ltar berjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni snyan rtsom 〈bsil dus kyi bod ljongs sminang / rtsom mjug sngon ma ste 66a la la zhes 'dzam gling yang rtser deng rabs can gyi bod gsar 'dzugs nya zhes tshig gi steng nas ka mad sum cu'i a yig gis mjug bsdus pa dang / don gyi steng nas sa mtho'i dgun dus kyi mdzes ljongs yongs su bstan zin rjes mdzes ljongs de lta bu'i steng na (6deng rabs can gyi bod gsar 'dzugs lta zhes mjug yongs su bsdus rjes slar yang 64dus bzhir tha mar grags pa'i dgun dus kyang / 'di lta'i yid 'ong lta na sdug pa'i yul/ me tog dus dang char ldan 'bras bu'i dud/ mdzes sdug rmad byung su yis brjod par nus/nya zhes rtsom mjug bskyar ma bsdus pa'i brjod don ni de bas rgya che ba zhig yin te/ dus bzhi'i tha mar grags pa'i dgun dus kyang bod ljongs sa mtho de 'dra'i mdzes shing lta na sdug pa yod na/dpyid dbyar ston gyi dus su de bas mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba ni smos mi dgos pa zhig red ces snyan rtsom 'di'i brjod bya dngos dgun dus kyi bod ljongs sa mtho'i mdzes ljongs la bsngags pa las ches cher brgal te dus bzhi'i bod ljongs la bsngags pa brjod de rtsom mjug bskyar ma bsdus pa de ni rtsom pa po'i thun min blo gros las 'khrungs pa'i thun min gyi rtsom mjug bsdu 419

bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i skor cung zad gleng ba/bsil ljongs kun gsal lha lam yangs po'i ngos/ /dmangs khrod rtsom rig rgyu skar bye ba'i khrod/ /tshig nyung don zab 'od mdangs 'tsher ba yi/ /ngag rgyun gtam dpe tho rengs skar chen bzhin/ /gdams na nags rigs kun 'joms bzang drug sman/ /rtsod na phas rgol glang 'dul gdong lnga'i dbang / /smad na zur za'i spu gris snying khams dkrugs/ /gar btang go chod dmangs khrod gtam dpe nyid/ /zas la tsha med brgya zas cang cang dang / /gtam la dpe med byis pa'i ca cor mtshungs/ /des na 'dzad med gtam dpe'i chu gter la/ /rtsen 'dod gser nya'i tshogs rnams 'dir byon cigde yang rang cag bod kyi gtam dpe ni rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis yun ring 'tsho ba'i nang gsar rtsom byas pa'i dmangs khrod kyi rtsom rig phul du byung ba zhig yin pas bod mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i zhing sa yangs po'i steng ring nas rtsa ba brtan po tshugs yod stabs sa mtho'i thun min yul srol 421
goms gshis dang / bsam pa'i 'khyer so/ rig gnas 'tsho ba/ rgyun spyod skad cha sogs dang 'brel ba ches dam po yod pa ma zad skad cha'i sgyu rtsal yang ha cang mtho po yod pa sogs bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dper/ thun min khyad chos dang dge ma tshan ji snyed cig yod par mthong bas 'dir kho bos rang gi bsam tshul lam/ myong tshor 'ga' zhig brjod par 'dod/( 1 )gtam dpe ni tshig nyung yang don zab pa dang / rig pa'i dpal gyis phyug pa/ don gsal zhing go sla ba/ mtho sgang gi khyad chos ldan pa bcas yin pas kun gyis/ chang kha la zhim po bdud rtsi yin/ tshig rna bar snyan pa gtam dpe yin/ zhes zer ba don la gnas shing / gna' snga mo nas da lta bar rgya che'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs khrod du gtam dpe dar so shin tu che/(2 )gtam dpe mkhas pas bshad pa'i skad char tshang mas nyan 'dod byed pa dang / ji tsam nyan pa de tsam bro ba ldan zhing de tsam dgod bro ba 'ig yong ge yod pa red/ yang skabs 'gar phan tshun kha rtsod 'dra shor skabs rang rang gi rgyu mtshan dang mtshungs pa'i gtam dpe shod kyi yod cing / sus gtam dpe mang ba shod thub kyang gnas skabs de la rtsod pa thob pa lta bu'i 'char snang yong gi yod/ yang 'ga' zhig gi sems nang ma 'dod pa'am blo ma khengs pa yod kyang kha thug gam thad par bshad na mi 'tsham pa'i skabs bskor ba'i gtam dpe bshad nas gzhan la phog thabs byed pa dang / yang 'ga' zhig la bden pa yod kyang shod dbang med pa'i tshe zur za'i gtam dpe bshad nas snying tshims thabs byed kyi yod pa sogs mdor na bod kyi gtam dper legs nyes spang blang gi cha dang dga' skyo bstod smad kyi 'du shes nges can zhig 'dus yod/422
(3)gtam dpe ni gos sogs 'tshem dus skud pas 'drub pa dang zang gnyis sbyor dus rdzas kyi tsha la byed pa ba'i na skad cha phan tshun mthud pa'i mtshams sbyor pho nya dang skad cha'i snying bcud lta bu yin la nang don gang 'dra zhig yin yang de la dpag pa'i gtam dpe re shod rgyu yod pas gtam dpes skad cha'i sgyu rtsal lam bro ba che ru gtong rgyur phan ha cang chen po thogs kyi yod pa dper na/ de sngon nga tshos dmangs khrod gtam dpe 'tshol bsdu byed skabs bgres song tshos bka' mol ma gsungs na gtam dpe rkyang pa kha shas las gsungs mi thub cing / phan tshun bka' mol mang tsam zhus na gzhi nas gtam dpe mang po don yong gi yod pa de'i thog nas gtam dpe ni sngar nas skad cha dang yongs su 'dres shing sa khyab rdo khyab tu dar yod pa shes thub/(4)gtam dpe ni rtsom rig bco lnga'i mchod pa bzhings pa'i mar rgyan lta bu zhig yin pa ni dper na/ grags can gyi rtsom rig 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉dang / 〈bya sprel gtam rgyud/〉 〈mi ro rtse sgrung 〉 sogs kyi nang du gtam dpe ha cang mang po drangs nas don gyi snying po ston gyin yod pa dang /deng rabs kyi gsar rtsom nang du'ang gtam dpe bkod na brjod bya phun sum tshogs pa dang / tshig sbyor ha cang snyan po yo da pas rgya che'i klog pa pos ji tsam bltas pa de tsam gyis snyan po yod pas rgya che'i klog pa pos ji tsam bltas pa de tsam gyis bsngags brjod byed kyi yod/(5) dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe 'ga' zhig legs bshad dang / chu shing bstan bcos sogs dang 'dra po yod pa'am yang na phan tshun 'dres yod pa de la brtag cing dpyad na ya mtshan mi dgos te/ legs bshad dang bstan bcos sogs kyang thog mar rtsom pa pos dmangs khrod kyi ngag rgyun rtsom rig 423
gtam dpe sogs rmang gzhir byas te brtsams pa yin srid pas tshig rkang kha snon tsam las don la khyad par chen po med cing / phyis de dag sngar bzhin dmangs khrod du dar bas de dag dmangs khrod gtam dper bzhag kyang mi 'os pa med/ 'on te legs bshad dang bstan bcos mang che ba gtam dpe yin mi srid/( 6)rang cag bod kyi gtam dper sa khul so so'i khyad chos rang ba'i ra ldan yod cing / gtam dpe gcig la'ang shod srol gnyis gsum yod pa ni dper na/ gtam 'dod bong bur bshad na/ zhes pa'i gtam dpe de la 'ga' zhig gis/ gtam 'dod bong bur bshad na/ rkang mthil sa la hrag yong / zer ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis/ gtam 'dod bong bur bzhin na/rkang mthil sa la hrag yong / zer ba de gnyis dbar yig 'bru gcig las khyad par med na'ang don la khyad par chen po yod de/ snga mas bong bur bzhon yang rkang pa spo mi dgos pa yong zer ba dang / phyi mas bong bur bzhon pa las rkang thang phyin na dga' zer ba lta bu'o/mdor na gtam dpe ni dus yun ring por dmangs khrod kha rgyun du gnas yod pa dang rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dang sha khrag lta bu'i 'brel ba yod cing / go dka' ba'i tshig gis ma bcings par yul skad dang yo ngas su mthun pas skye bo sus kyang gtam dpe gang 'dra cis/ bshed kyang de'i go don ngal ba med par rtogs thub pas blo la nges bde ba'i khyad chos dang rgya khyab rang bzhin ldan yod pa ma zad deng char gsar skyes gzhon nu mang pos blang dor gyi dpe ston rang bzhin gyi gtam dpe mang po sems la bzung nas rang so'i kun spyod kyi dge rgan du bsten gyin yod pas/ gtam dper legs 424
bshad dang bstan bcos sogs dang 'dra bar slob gso'i nas pa ha cang chen po yod pa sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i gtam dpe'i dge ma tshan de dag gis kho bo'i yid dbang cig car 'phrog pas 'dir rang cag bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i skor chu brgya zam 'dus kyis gleng ba la nang gses don tshan che ba gnyis te dang po/ snyan zhing 'jibs pa'i tshig sbyor dang / gnyis pa/ phun sum tshogs pa'i nang don no/ /dang po/ snyan zhing 'dzebs pa'i tshig sbyor/gcig dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe ni tshig sbyor snyan zhing 'jebs la go bde ba/ lhag par du dpe don zhwa dang mgo bo yongs su mthun pa ha las dgos pa zhig yod pa ni/ dper na gtam dpe/ gtor ma mdzu gu tsam la/bshad pa ri rab tsam zhes par mtshon na/ gtor ma'i dngos yod kyi che chung gi dpe la mdzu gu bkod pa dang / bshad pa'i ham pa che chung gi dpe la ri rib de snyan gzhung me long nang gi phul byung gi rgyan dang 'dra bar 'ud chen pos brjod pas tshig sbyor snyan zhing sgyu rtsal gyi tshad mtho por slebs pa dang /dgong mo mi nyal khyi dang 'dra/ zhogs pa mi langs ba dang 'dra/ zhes par mtshon na/ dgong mo mi nyal ba'am ha cang phyi po ma gtogs pa'i mi nyal ba'i mi'i dpe la khyi bkod pa dang / zhogs pa mi langs ba'am phyi po ma gtogs mi langs pa'i mi'i dpe la ba bkod pa ni 'tsho ba'i gtan tshig dang mthun pa'i go bde'i gtam dpe tshig sbyor shin tu snyan pa zhig la gyur yod pa dang / don gcig yod na dpe gcig shod/ dpe don sgang bu mgo sbrel yin/zhes par mtshon na/ skad cha'i nang don dang dpe ha cang mtshams pa lhang bu 425
mgo sbrel ltar red ces pa'i dpe de ni ha cang gson nyams ldan pa zhig tu gyur yod/lag pa ya gcig gi thal mo dang / rkang pa ya gcig gi zhabs bro/ zhes par mtshon na/ dpe las brjod don dngos gsal po bkod med kyang /rogs med par rang gcig pus bya ba sgrub mi thub pa'am sgrub dka' ba la gtam dpe 'di ha cang 'jug cing / tshig sbyor yang ha cang snyan po yod la thos pa tsam gyis don bde blag rtogs nus/'tshab na lam la gdam ga med/ dbul na bza' zlar gdam ga med/ces par mtshon na/ tshig rkang snga ma dpe dang / phyi ma don yin la/ dpe don ha cang mtshams pa dang / 'tsho ba dngos dang shin tu mthun pa ste/ ji ltar skye bo ga ge mo zhig rab tu 'tshab na gang mgyogs slebs ched lam la gdam ga med par gang byung rgyugs pa de bzhin du mi dbul po zhig la cha bzhag na bza' zlar gdam ga byed pa'i cha rkyen med pas su byung byung zhig dang gnyen sgrig byed srid ces pa ni dpe don yo ngas su mtshungs pa zhig yin/dka' las skya bas brgyab/ longs spyod za rus btang / zhes par mtshon na/ dka' las rgyag mkhan skya ba dang / longs spyod byed mkhan za ru yin pa gnyis ka dpe yin yang de'i shugs las/ gcig gis dka' las brgyab pa'i 'bras bu de/ ga 'an zhig gis longs spyod byed bzhin pa'am byas so zhes pa'i don dpe las gsal por mtshon pa'i thun min tshig sbyor gyi khyakhu ba chos ldan yod/na dran/ drag brjed/ shi 'khon zhes par mtshon na de'i nang dpe gzugs dngos su bkod med kyang gab tshig gi rgyan spyad nas de ni sman par 426
zer gyi yod pa bstan pa dang / sman par de 'dra zer dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/mi 'ig la na tsha byung dus sman pa dran pa dang / na tsha drag na sman pa'i bka' drin brjed cing / gal srid na tsha bcos thabs med par nad nga/ 'chi lam du song na sman par 'khon 'dzin byed kyi yod ces pa'i 'tsho ba dngos kyi gro/zugs brnyan gson po ji ma ji ba'i na gtam dpe yig 'bru drug nang nas gsal por bstan pa dang / mi la lab gsam lab pa la / rang la 'dzoms gsam 'dzoms dgos zhes pa dang / ra sha za dus dgod shi4ga shi4ga ra rin bsdu dus ngu lhang lha khyang / zhes pa/ da dung / za rgyu 'thung rgyu 'bel na dgu'/ lab rgyu gleng rgyu nyung na dgu'/ sogs la mtshon na snyan gzhung me long nang gi sgra rgyan sbyar ba dang / me long nang gi gzugs brnyan/ shel sgo'i nang si mog mogces pa dang / chu mo dwangs su dwangs su / nya mo gsal du gsal du lta bu gab tshig gi rgyan dang / tshong 'dus dbus su zha bo sdug bla ma'i mdun du 'on pa sdug ces pa dang / byabs chung rtug drir gu thung 'bud mkhan/ lta bu bzhad gad kyi nyams sogs rbad kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe ni tshig sbyor tshar du dngar ba'i snyan gzhung gi dper brjod po ti zhig dang yongs su mtshungs so/ /gnyis/ bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe spyir na bcad lhug spel gsum nyung yang nyung shos la yig 'bru bzhi las med pa dang / mang shos la yig 'bru bco lnga tsam yod pa'ang snyan ngag dang cha 'dra ba dper na/ khyi mthong ri 'khur dang / rkang rjes lag bsub/ wa mo kha shor/ byi 'us 'bu thub/ mgo thar dpung thar/ rta rgyugs g.yu bsdur lta bu yig 'bru bzhi can dang / bong bu'i rna bar chos / sangs rgyas la ka kha/ long bas long ba 'khrid/427
rnga la dpag pa'i 'cham/ thab chung yang me tsha/ rma sman rma thog byugs lta bu yig 'bru lnga can dang / ka bar 'jag ma'i lhan pa/ nyal sa byung na rkyongs sa/gtam kha shor rdza lag shor/ chos rar chos gzhas rar gzhas/ g.yas par spyan g.yon mar mig 'gyel ba'i sgang la rdog brdzis lta bu/ yig 'bru drug can dang / chu ma shor gong nas chu rags/ nyin mo lha dang mtshan mo 'dre/ ba bsad pa las bzhos pa dga'/ bya ma 'drog par sgo nga len/ phu phar brgyab sma ra tshur 'tshig cham par phan yang ya mar gnod lta bu yig 'bru bdun can dang / me rang shi dang du ba rang yal/ lha khang rnying par gnas bshad gsar pa/ zhim po chang yin mang po dug yin/ 'ju tshod kyi lto 'jon tshod kyi las/dang po rang gcun gnyis pa mi gcun/ thos pa brgya las mthong ba gcig dga' lta bu/ yig 'bru brgyad can dang / rgyu 'gro mi dgos pa'i lha dbu chen po/ rma la phan na khyi tshil yin yang byugs/ skyin pa chu yin yang brjed du ma 'jug zhim po byung na sbos nas shi yang shi lta bu/ yig 'bru dgu cam dzi nga /khal bong bus 'khur bar rgya lam skyed pa na/ chu 'tshog pa'i snod yod gtam 'tshog pa'i snod med/ dmangs las 'ud shob che gri las sen mo rno/ ring thung 'dom la 'jal yang lji nyag la bkyag lta bu/ yig 98bru bcu can dang /rnam sras rta pa brgya la zhabs 'dren rkang thang gcig phyi gos chen gyi rtsam khug nang sbang ma'i rtsam pa/ tsan dan gyis gu yog ( me dbyug) dang / gos chen gyi thab 'phyid/ mi kha bkag pa las rang kha btsum na dga' yong lta bu/ yig 'bru bcu gcig can dang / mi rgan pa'i kha la nyon lto zhim po'i bro bar ltos/sta re rdo la gzhus na sku gyong lcags la 'khel yong / dpon po byed par sla po/drang po byed par khrag po lta bu/ yig 'bru bcu gnyis can dang / da dung /428
zhing chung btab kyang khal gcig spun nye bzang yang am phrag gang lta bu yig 'bru bcu gsum can dang rtsam pa'i dpang po bul gyis byas/ lhags pa brgyab dus mnyam du 'khyer lta bu/ yig 'bru bcu bzhi can dang / rta rgan mi rgan mdzo rgan gsum/ nyi ma bzhud nas bzang du bzang du lta bu/ yig 'bru bco lnga can sogs spyir na gtam dpe'i yig 'bru bzhi nas bco lnga'i bar yin yang de las yig 'bru mang ba dang nyung ba med pa ni ma yin no/ /gnyis pa/ phun sum tshogs pa'i nang don/sna mang phun sum tshogs pa'i rang cag bod kyi gtam dpe'i nang don ni rgya che la gting zab pa/ dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba kun la khyab cing / kun dang yongs su mthun pa zhig yin pas gtam dpe'i nang / don mtha' dag brjod par mi lang yang 'tsho ba dang thag nye ba'am mngon gsal dod pa/ yang na khyab che ba 'ga' zhig nang gses dbye nas dpyad gzhi'i tshul du 'god par bya'o/ /( 1 )zhing las skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ ston snye mar 'gam mkhan ham can/ dgun 'bru rdog sgrug mkhan rtogs can/ zhing kha'i rka stod rka smad/mi'i tshe stod tshe smad/ ston thal rlung 'tshub 'tshub ma byas na/ dgun snum bag tshil tshil ga nas yong / 'di lo sran ma nyes res red/ sang lo sran shul legs res red/ lud ni zhing kha'i stod nas rgyag bye ma zhing kha'i smad nas rgyag zhing la chu dgos/ chu la tshad dgos/ mi phan med ston dus na/ mdzo phan med dpyid dus shi/ zhing kha btsongs nas rta pho nyos/ rta pho shri na 'ing kha shi/ dpyid lud bongs che na/ ston 'bru bongs che lta bu dang /429
(2)'brog las skor gyi gtam dpe/ ba mo dbyar zho dgun nas gso/sha g.yag ston gso da dbyar nas gso/ dpyid lug nad pa bzhin du ded/mgyogs drags na srog nyen yod/ lug rdzi skyur dad kha ba/ a pho spyang ki'i bsod nams/ chung re'u lu gu ma gsos na/ tshe ra pho lug pho yong don med/gser ldan ngang pa bla ma'i rta/ g.yu 'brug sngo nag dpon po'i rta/ ston las ba 'ag nas ston lug 'tsho/ ston lug spang gi ser khas brku/ sbyangs pa'i las ka kun la mkhas/ lug dzi dgu rdog ( 'ur rdo) rgyag la ma khan lta bu/(3 ) nags las skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ ba log bkog mang na me shing chad/ 'dzugs 'dzugs mang na gcod gcod mang / sbyar pa 'o gsum skyes kyang dga' mi dgos/ lcang ma lo gsum skam yang skyo mi dgos/ rtsa ba ma rul na lo ma mi skam/ sems pa ma 'gyur na gnyen thor mi byed/ pha yul kong po/ngoms rgyu thang shing / shing khang nang shing med kyang / rgyab ri nags kyis khengs yod lta bu/(4 ) zhor las skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ rdo bzo mkhas kyang rang mig long / shing bzo sdug kyang rang thug 'khol/ dgun a chu bsam nas btsugs phrugs dang / dbyar char pa bsam nas sbra gur btags/ mu ger khrag dkri byas/ snam bu pham tshong shor/ sle po btags nga 'i sger gsog za'am 'thung yang nga'i red/ lho tshong byang la bskyal/ byang tshong lho la bskyal/ lag dal por ma sdod lag las byos/ kha dal por ma sdod ma ṇi drongs/ nya pa sdig che/nya pa khe che lta bu/( 5 )pha yul skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ mi rgas na yul dran/ bya rgas na shing dran/ mi yul skyed kyang zhag gsum/ rang yul sdug kyang mi tshe/ lung pa 430
gang yin skad kyis shes/ pha yul gang yin chas kyis shes/ pha yul bral yang yul skad ma brjed pa dgos/ gang skyid pha yul/ su byams pha ma/ rang yul stong par bzhag gzhan yul 'od kyis rgyangs/ yul skyed po lus kyis bzo/lus skyed po sems kyis bzo/ pha yul la rta brgya tham pa/ lam du rkang thang lta bu/(6)dgra gnyen skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ sdang na dgra las gnyen sdang /gnag na gyen las thur gnag dgra phyi nang 'dres na/ rdzong chen mkhar gyis mi brten/ kha de dgra yi g.yab shing yin/ dgra da lha med kyang da lta bzo/thag ring gi gnyen las/ grong pa'i dgra dga'/ dgra rang 'og chud na bu ltar skyongs/ grogs po'i chu rkyang 'thung 'dod las/ dgra yi sbrang rtsi za mi 'dod/ dgra dang stag lpags mgo nas mnyed lta bu/(7)zur za'i skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ so yod sran ma za bar/ so med snying rlung ma langs/ 'grang po gnyid khug kyang / ltogs po gnyid mi khugsdig pa ma bsags bla mas gsu ngas/ sha tshil gang thim bla mas bzhes/ gsham thabs rtsab hral yin na'i/ dpe cha 'dra 'dra 'don gyi yod/ tshes bcu re la ra re bsad/ zangs mdog dpal ri ra ros brgyangs/ skyung khas skyung khar ma lab/ mchu to dmar po cha red/ dpal 'dzoms rtag par ngu bar/ rnam rtog ga la za/ khal bong bus 'khur bar/ rgya lam sked pa na mi dgos lta bu/( 8) dmangs khrod goms srol skor/ dga' yang nyal glu ma gtong /sdug kyang nyal zhwa ma gon/ lnga bdun bcu gnyis ma shes na/ thong mkhan mkhas por ga la brtsi/ ma reg bcu gsum ma shes na/ chu gnyer mkhas por ga la brtsi/ steng 'then 'og lhug 'tshem bu'i yon tan red/ la rtse ye nas so 431
pa yang yang bltas/ zhogs gcig khyi la rdo gzhus na/ nyin gcig bya ba yong mi 'grub/ bya de med pa'i lung par/ bong bus nam tshod byed/ dgu thug 'thung ma shes na/ lo gsar gtong ma shes lta bu/( 9) chos lugs skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ chos ma slob sems slob/sems dkar ba chos yin/ chos kyi don la dka' ba spyod mkhan nyung /byams pa'i don la zhogs chu brgal mkhan mang / kha'i de bzhin gshegs pas/lus kyi sgrib pa mi dag rang sems dkar por ltad skyon med na/ yi dam lha yi bka' chad yong don med/ thang bde por slebs dus glu a la tha la/'gag dog por slebs dus bla ma o rgyan pad ma/ bskos pa'i las la thar sa med/ dpral ba'i gnyer mar 'phyid rgyu med/ rang sems ra ro gis ma gcun na/ rde'u bcud len rang sdug rang nyos red/ dad pa byas na khyi mgor ring bsrel 'khrungs lta bu/( 10)kun spyod skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ pha ma bzang po'i bu phrug dge rgan bzang po'i dge phrug las la mi chags chang la chags/ sang gi bya ba gnangs la bskyal/ go rang gis ma chod/ 'ud pha mar bshad/ gzhan la lab gsum lab pa la/ rang la 'dzoms gsum 'dzoms pa dgos/ lta ba lha dang mnyam yang / spyod pa mi dang bstun dgos/ ya rabs phyag dang zhe sa mkhas/ ma rabs snying dang grod pa che/ a gsar rta las mgyogs pa/ gzhu gu lug las thung ba/ the'u hrang la dbang byung na/ sgo kha thal 'tshub kyis brgyangs/ sprang po'i rgyugs par yang mgo mjug yod lta bu/( 11 )slob sbyong skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ brtsom 'grus can de shes byas phyug le lo can de gnyid kyis phyug shes shes a ma'i khog nas med/ sbyangs 432
nas mi shes yon tan med/ byis pa dag yig kha nas skyor/ ma dag yi ge lag pas bris/ gzhan la 'dri bar ngo ma tsha/ ngo tsha can la shes bya med/ mi gcun par yi ge nag chung dgos/ phyugs gcun par thi gu khra khra dgos/ ri mor tshon gyis brgyan/ mi la yon tan gyis brgyan/ rmongs pa sel mkhan yi ge dang / mun pa sel mkhan sgron me/ rang ge skyon la ltos/ gzhan gyi shes byar ltos lta bu/( 12)bde skyed kyi skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ bu pha dang mnyam/ bu mo ma dang mnyam/ skyed pa'i nyi ma mkha' nas shar/ dga' ba'i me tog sa nas bzhad/ pha bsags kyi rgyu dang / ma bsags kyi zas/ rgyab ri lha shing shug pa red/ bsangs sna mi la re dgos med/ skyed na nam mkha'i bya yang 'khor/sdug na rang ge bu yang bros/ dgos rgyu spags la/ spags khu dar ra/ chos rar chos kyi bstan pa dar/ gzhas rar gzhas kyi sgo mo phye lta bu/( 13) btson bsris skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ lto la snga bzas ma byed/las la phyi bshol ma byed/ zas la za tshod byas na za rgyu rgyun mi chad/ gos la gon tshod byas na gon rgyu rgyun mi chad/ gnam gang rgyas na tshes bcu chad/tshes bcu brgyad na lha bsangs chad/ zhim de srubs ma zhim pa/ mi tshe ja thang ring ba/ gos phu thung dza dzar gon 'dod na/ kha byi khung tsam des za tshod byos/lto phyed tshod ma/ gos phyed lhan pa lta bu/( 14)sman bcos skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ bad kun smug po na na shi jus/dpon po dgra la langs na 'gro jus/ phan pa'i sman de mang mi dgos/ sha tsha'i gtam de ring mi dgos/ nad pa rgyun ring em rje yin/ mkhris nad can gyis gangs ri ser por mthong / stod ya mar phan pa zi ri nag po/ smad ༷ 433
grang gzhir phan pa dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu/ mi za mi 'thung kha la med/ a tsha u ru rgyun mi chad/ brtag pa med pa'i chu tshan brgyab/ dgos 'dod med pa'i 'ba' tshar chags/ sbal pa rma can gcig gis sbal tshang phungs lta bu/( 15)lus khams bod srung skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ zas zhim nga yang mang na rgyu ma 'khrugs/ rta bzang yang mgyogs g.yang la lhung / dbyar 'khyags pa ma shes 'khyags gcong shor/ dgun ltogs pa ma shes ltogs gcong shor/ skad cha drang por shod/ lto tsha por bzo/ mi mi gtsang ba dang /rang rang gtsang ba dgos/ gzhan la kha bsres/ rang la 'cham pa 'gos/zhim po chang yin/ mang po dug yin/ mig na ba lag pas bzos lta bu/( 14) dus tshigs skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ dbyar mgo gangs kyis btsugs/ dbyar gzhug gangs kyis bsgril/ dbyar kha chu mig gar yod/dgun kha bltas na shes yong / ri mtho na dbyar yang kha ba babs/ klung dma' na dgun yang rtsa ljang skyes/ dpyid nya rgyal por mi rag dbyar nya khyis kyang mi za/ nam mi langs ka med nyi mas ded/ sa mi rub ka med mun pas ded/ dbyar gsum so nam char gyis 'dzin/ dgun gsum zla ba rlung gis g.yo lta bu/( 15) gnam gshis skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ char sne rlung gis 'khrid/pho mo chang gis sbyor/ zhogs sprin dmar po chu yin/ dgon sprin dmar po me yin/ dpyid nyi ring por grang gsum dro gsum/ mi tshe ring por skyid gsum sdug gsum/ ljang chung ser bas brdungs na/ bang gsar gra sgrig gyis shigsprin pa byi'u tsam gyis sad thub lta bu/( 16)skar rtsis skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ dgun kha rlung la mi skrag rlung 434
bu drug char btang yong / pa sangs bya ba kun la bzang / bag ma blangs na bu mi 'byung / brgyad dang bcu drug nyi shu bdun/ de la 'gro ba'i lam tshes med/dgu pa sha pho'i sha gdan ma babs na/ dgun gyi khu byug dkyus ma ga nas yong /bcu gsum spyi yi gnam sgo la/ bya ba thams cad 'dzems par bya/ bu mo mi yul 'gro bar/ gza' dang skar ma gtso lta bu/( 17)thun mong skor gyi gtam dpe rni/ mi dmangs kyi lag de gser yin/ mi dmangs kyi kha de jus yin/ mang pos bkyag na gdung las lcang ma thang / pho rab gcig gi blo rtse las/ pho 'brang gsum gyi gros bsdur dga'/mi dmangs dkyil gyi gtam dang / bya dmangs dkyil gyi spu/ mang po blo mthun na/: lung pa skya spos byed thub lta bu/( 18) mi sger skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ rang gis btsos pa'i chang de/zhim po med kyang 'thung dgos/ nyi ma rgyal khams kun la shar/ mun pa nag po rang la 'thibs/ rang gi ltas btang / mi'i lhas mi zin/ gros mi la dris/thag rang gis gcod/ rang skal rdo yin mur dgos/ nyi ma rgyal khams thun mong yin/ rgyang mthong nyi ma sger gyi yin lta bu/( 19)mthun sgril skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ skyed la rtse'i rtswa la mnyam za/sdug sngon mo'i chu mnyam 'thung / nang bkra ma shis na/ phyi don mi 'grub/bal gyi nyag ma phra yang / thag pas seng ge bsdams/ nang dpa' bo'i dpal gral ma zhig na/ phyi ge sar dmag la skrag don ci/ rta rgyugs na mnyam rgyugs/gur brgyab na kha sprod/ g.yag brgya khyu bsgril na/ spyang brgya khu shor lta bu/(20)las ba'i skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ 'jig rten nyal na rgud/ chos pa langs na rgud/ grong par zhe sdang med na/ spags kyi rkyal pa 'dra/ skyes ༷ 435
pa'i mi la grags pa'i gtam dgos/ byas pa'i las la grub pa'i mtha' dgos/bong bu rang thog la 'khol na/ 'gros rta pho las mgyogs pa/ kha za 'dod na/lag pa lcags kyi skam pa dgos/ spyang gis sha za ba mthong / la rgyag pa ma mthong lta bu/( 21 ) gleng mol skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ brgyab tshar ba'i mda' mo/bshad tshar ba'i skad cha/ gtam rna bar 'gro tshod dang / chu yur bur gshong tshod/ gtam la mtshon cha med kyang mi sems dum bur gcod/ zas mi la bskur na nyung du nyung du/ skad cha mi la bskur na mang du mang du/ rta kha lo med na bzhon rgyu med/ tshig rtsa ba med na shod rgyu med/ blun po smra ba nyung na mdzes lta bu/(22)bslab bya'i skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ skyin pa chu yin yang / brjed du ma 'jug rang lus la dpe blangs nas/ mi lus la bshad pa rgyobs/las ka snga dro ma byas dgong dro 'gyod/ rig pa gzhon dus ma sbyangs rgas dus 'gyod/ kha rin po che/ lus bde ru chug gzhan la blta ba'i mig yod kyang /rang la blta ba'i me long dgos/ chu char pa'i skyo rogs ma byung yang / sad ser ba'i sna 'dren ma byed lta bu/ ji(23)bden don skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ thos pa brgya las mig mthong gcig dga'/ drang pos gzhung bsrangs na/ sgo ngas rta 'khyog bden pa'i las de/ dkar po'i chos yin/ bden yod la rogs mang / bden med la rogs dkon/ rdzun gyi tha ma lcags kyi rdzing bu'ang brdol/ rgyugs pa'i chu de rul rgyu med/ bden pa'i tshig la 'gyur ba med/ ma thos gong nas shod shod mang na/ ma mthong gong nas rdzun rkub brdol yong lta bu/༷ 436
( 24)lag len skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ kha bshad chu yi lbu ba/ lag len gser gyi thigs pa/ shing bzo bas lcags brdungs mi shes/ lcags bzo bas shing bzo mi shes/ bya ba gang byas phyi bltas slog phyi bltas slog na khe re thob/ bya ba thams cad dus dang bstun/ dus las yol na a re 'gyod/ bu mo bstan mi dgos/ bal khung bstan na chog pha las rgan pa'i bu med kyang /pha las rgod pa'i bu yod/ kha bshad la nyi ma shar/ lag len la mun pa rub lta bu/(25)shes bya'i skor/ lo na rgas pa rgan pa min/ shes bya rgas na rgan pa yin/ 'dod pas nam langs/ shes byas sa rub/ tsi tsi ram pa za bar/za lugs rnam pa bco brgyad/ shes rig med pa'i 'tsho ba de/ 'gyig gis bcos pa'i me tog 'dra/ mi shes bya ba ha lam med/ mthar phyin shes pa shin tu dkon/ shes yon bya ba thams cad kyi/ 'gro lam gsal ba'i sgron me yin lta bu/(26) bden rdzun skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ thag ring gtam de phyed bden phyed rdzun yin/ gcig bshad don la ma gnas na/ brgya bshad bden par ga la brtsi/ lha pa mo pa sho pa gsum/ 'jig rten thog gi rdzun rkyal gsum/drang po bshad na mi mi dga'/ rgyugs pa 'khyer na khyi mi dga'/ drang po thig la 'khol la/ sgo ngas rta 'khyog rdzun gyi tha ma lcags kyi rdzing bu'ang brdol lta bu/(27)chags sdang skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ bzang por bzang lan dang /ngan por ngan lan/ grogs rnying pa dga'/ gos gsar pa dga'/ mi ngan la chad pa/ mi bzang la bya dga'/ mkhas pa yon tan can la nga mi skrag437
blun po lkugs rtags can la nga skrag bzang dang 'grogs na bzang / ngan dang 'grogs na ngan/ 'thung res ja dang chang la/ shi 'dzing bsags pa'i nor la/ phan thogs med na kha nang so yang phud lta bu/( 28) gnas lugs skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ so med zas dang bral/nor med gnyen dang bral/ bshad nas go ba mi yi yon tan yin/ kha bde na dpon dang / lag bde na g.yog po/ mnyen drags na gug nyen yod/mkhrigs drags na chag nyen yod/ lam nor na bskor sa yod/ kha nor na bskor sa med/ mi chung la shod bde/ rta chung la bzhon bde/ ha mi go mkhan de 'ud che/ gnyid mi khug mkhan de nam ring / mi la skyon med pa dang /shing la 'dzer pa med pa med lta bu/(29)mdzes dang mi mdzes skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ zhal la pad ma'i mdangs yod kyang / thugs la sol ba'i ris gcig 'dug rang gis rang la bstod pa de/ rgyal chen yin yang ga la mdzes/ mi'i ri mo nang la yod/ stag gi ri mo phyi la yod/ la cha'i mdog la ma gzigs na/ byu ru'i spus kur gzigs shig dkyil du bzhag na phra 'dra/ zur du bzhag na rgyan 'dra/mkhas pas bris dang tshugs la blta/ blun pos rgyan dang me tog blta lta bu/(30)gral rim skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ dpon po zho ltar nyal na/ mi ser khrag ltar 'khrug yong / rgyal por brgyab na mgul 'cham/ sprang por brgyab na 'cham klud/ lha chen las lha chung mtho/ de las lug dzi'i skyag gong mtho/ stobs ldan la dgos rgyu mi shi/ dpon par dgos rgyu gyod gzhi/ wa skyes rgyal po wa la sdang lta bu/(31 )khrims lugs skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ chos khrims dar gyi mdud 438
pa 'dra/di rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing 'dra/ gser rag brdar sa ka shu ka/ bden rdzun brdar sa khrims ra/ nya khrims dpon gyis bsdams/ nya khral dpon pos bsdams/ dpon po'i khrims ra dngul gyis dkrugs/ dge 'dun 'dod/ 'dul khrims mi 'dod/ khrims len dpon gyi khrims ra na/jibshad khom nyan khom gnyis ka yod lta bu/( 32) bdag gnyer skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ phyug po'i nor la/ yi dwags kyi dkon gnyer/ dbyar kha lcags dang dgun kha rdza la ltos/ ca lag lha 'dra por/ bdag gces 'dre 'dra po/ me tog khra chil dgu chil mthong /zhogs spos dgong spos byas pa ma mthong / gos la lteb rtsis med na/ gsar pa rnying par mngon/ lto tsha sar zhog gos grang sar zhig lta bu/(33)blo gros skor gyi gtam dpe/ don gyi 'gag rtsar thug pa'i dus/gzhon pa'i shed las rgad po'i jus/ bya ma 'drogs par sgo nga len pa/ gros 'go bsod nams can gyis bton/ gros thag blo gros can gyis bcad/'phan po rig pa'i 'byung gnas la/ a khu ston pa'i dgos don med/ ri dwags rgyal po seng ge yang / blo ldan ri bong thabs kyis brtul/ bong bur nyal stangs bco brgyad yod na/ bong dzir slong stangs bcu dgu yod lta bu/(34)pha ma'i skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ mdog ngan yang drin can pha ma/skyug bro yang pha ma'i lto phor/ nyi ma snye ma a ma gsum/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi drin can gsum/ drin drin du ma shes khyi dang 'dra/ pha ma'i bka' drin mi shes khyi las lod/ pha ma bzang po'i bu phrug dge rgan bzang po'i dge phrug phru gu'i 'dzum mdangs pha ma'i bde skyid yin/ pha sems bu thog bu sems rdo thoggos dro po g.yogs na mi tshor phud na tshor/ drin pha ma bzhugs na mi tshor 439
gshegs na tshor lta bu/(35 ) blo stobs skor gyi gtam dpe ni/ g.yu 18brug rgya mtsho'i dkyil nas langs/ stag rgod nags kyi khrod nas mchongs/ mgo la nyi zla ma gtogs 'khur dgos med/ lam bar rdo la ma gtogs gzur dgos med/ gzugs chung yang gser gyi mde'u/ yan lag phra yang stong skud sing skud/ khyed rgya mtsho skam nus na/ nga nya mo shi nus/ wa rnga ma 'khyil ler bros pa las/ gzig a long 'khyil rer shi ba dga'/ de ring shi na tshe thung dang / sang nyin shi na tshe ring red/ dzer can gyi shing la/ ngar can gyi sta re lta bu/ gzhan yang da dung srog chags kyi gtam dpe dang / sgyu rtsal gyi gtam dpe/ bstod smad kyi gtam dpe/ kun slong gi gtam dpe sogs mtha' yas pa ni gong du brjod pa ltar gtam dpe'i nang ma tshud pa'i brjod don ha lam med par snang /da dung bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe 'ga' zhig mi rigs gzhan rgya gtam dpe dang ches 'dra ba dper na rgya rigs kyi sa/ta ma dpe 66145wa(5tshog:zhes pa dang bod rigs kyi gtam dpe 86me 'bar ba'i sgang la shing bshag pa/9 zhes pa gnyis don yongs su mtshungs pa dang / yang rgya rigs kyi gtam dpe 66lta lta tshotsho((tsho/] ha zhes pa dang bod rigs kyi gtam dpe ((spyang lab bshad na spyang ki slebs zhes pa yongs su mtshungs pa lta bu dang / da dung bod kyi deng dus kyi gtam dpe 'ga' zhig rgya rigs kyi gtam dpe nas bod yig du bsgyur te da lta bod yig dang bod skad nang sa khyab rdo khyab tu dar yod pa dper na/ 88mdzes ma'i mdun nas dpa' bo'ang thar bar dka'/nya zhes pa dang / 88mdog ngan sbal pas nam mkha'i lha bya dkar po'i sha za 'dod byed pa/lta lta bu rim bzhin mang du 'gro bzhin lags/ 'o na bod kyi dmangs 440
yod gtam dpe'i nang don brgya cha brgya rbad de yang dag pa yin nam zhe na/de ni yong thabs bral ba 'jig rten gī chos nyid yin pa ltar gtam dpe'i nang ches nyung shas shig 'tsho ba'am gtan tshig yang na deng gi dus rabs dang yang mi mthun pa yod pa dper na/ 88shi dgos yod na em rje'i a ma'ang shi/brlag dgos yod na rkun ma'i ba yang brlag lta bu tshan rig dang 'gal ba dang / 64 gnas ma bskor na las sgrib mi dag mi bsad na 'tsho ba mi 'khyol/lta lta bu rgyu mtshan dang 'gal ba dang / 88 4 dang bu mo brdungs na bzang /lta lta bu pho mo 'dra mnyam gyi srid jus dang 'gal ba dang / 64shig tshe zad pa dang stu kha gdangs pa kha thug 'khel/nya zhes pa lta bu ser thal shor ba sogs re gnyis yod pa'ang khas len mi byed ka med lags so/ /mjug byang /mdor na rang cag bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe ni sna mang la khyab che ba ngag thog tsam ma zad yig tho ga phul byung rtsom rig mang po'i nang du'ang rim byung mkhas pa tshos bed spyod gnang yod pa dang / deng char rtsom rig gsar rtsom 'bar gas chen po'i nang rtsom pa pa tshos brtsams sgrung dang / lhug rtsom/dpyad gtam sogs kyi nang bed spyod gnang dang gnang mus yin zhing / lhag par du gzhas ma gtam dang / gtam brjod zlos gar/ brnyan 'phrin 'khyab gzhung sogs kyi nang bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i nus pa ha las dgos pa thon yod pa kun gyis ma/khyen gsal lags /des na nga tshos sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam dper zhib 'jug dang / 'tshol bsdu/ khyab gdal/ bed spyod bcas byed 441
dgos pa ma/ zad mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang mthun pa'i gtam dpe gsar rtsom yang byas te bod kyi rtsom rig skyed tshal ldum rwa'i nang gtam dpe'i me tog 'di nyid sngar bas mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig bzhad thub pa bya rgyu ni rang ga 'an kun gī sa/la che'i bya ba zhig tu mthong nas bya ba de legs grub yong bar dmigs te 〈rbad kyi dmangs khrod gtam dpe'i skor cung zad gleng ba 〉zhes pa'i rtsom thung 'di bris pa lags so/ /
